seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Abra Chrome (u otro navegador que admita instalaciones web) y vaya a freetvgarden.com. Busque el ícono de instalación en la barra de direcciones o abra el menú del navegador y elija "Agregar a la pantalla de inicio"/"Instalar aplicación". FreeTV Garden luego se abrirá en pantalla completa desde su pantalla de inicio, como una aplicación nativa, sin necesidad de descargarla desde Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Abra freetvgarden.com en Safari. Toque el ícono Compartir y luego "Agregar a la pantalla de inicio". Esto agrega un ícono de aplicación a su iPhone o iPad que inicia el sitio en pantalla completa; no se necesita una lista de la App Store y no hay nada que mantener actualizado.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Abra el navegador integrado de su televisor y navegue hasta freetvgarden.com. Si su televisor no tiene un navegador utilizable, transmita la página desde su teléfono o computadora portátil usando Chromecast o AirPlay para verla en la pantalla grande.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Abra el navegador Silk (preinstalado en dispositivos Fire TV o gratuito en Amazon Appstore) y vaya a freetvgarden.com. Seleccione un país o categoría y comience a mirar, sin necesidad de suscripción ni aplicación adicional.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Cualquier navegador de escritorio moderno funciona; simplemente visite freetvgarden.com. seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: No. El tv.garden original cambió su nombre a Famelack en 2026 y ya no usa el nombre TV Garden. FreeTV Garden es un sitio independiente y administrado de forma independiente, no afiliado a Famelack ni al tv.garden original.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: ¿FreeTV Garden tiene las mismas características que TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.

FreeTV Garden tiene la misma experiencia de girar el mundo y elegir un país, junto con más de 84 filtros de idioma, más de 25 categorías de contenido, reproducción de imagen en imagen, favoritos que puedes destacar y volver a visitar, un botón de canal aleatorio e instalación con un solo toque directamente desde Chrome o Safari, sin necesidad de tienda de aplicaciones.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: ¿En qué se diferencia FreeTV Garden de radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.

Ofrece una interfaz más sencilla e intuitiva con una navegación más sencilla y va más allá de la radio con TV en vivo y cámaras web integradas en la misma herramienta gratuita de un solo toque.

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Se relanzó aquí. La página que solía vivir en freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden es el mismo proyecto, que ahora se ejecuta bajo su propio nombre y dominio: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: No se necesita ninguna cuenta. FreeTV Garden no solicita un correo electrónico, contraseña ni ningún dato personal para mirar.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Sí, FreeTV Garden se ejecuta en cualquier navegador móvil moderno en Android o iPhone y se puede agregar a la pantalla de inicio para acceder con un solo toque (consulte la sección Instalar más arriba).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Los canales son transmisiones en vivo provenientes de emisoras públicas, por lo que algunos se desconectan temporalmente debido a problemas con el servidor de la propia emisora. Pruebe con otro canal o vuelva a consultar más tarde; la mayoría regresa en unos minutos u horas.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden agrega transmisiones en vivo disponibles públicamente, principalmente desde el directorio de la comunidad iptv-org, y no aloja ni almacena ningún archivo de video. Consulte la sección Legal y de seguridad a continuación para obtener más información.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Se responden más preguntas en el {link1} completo.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden agrega transmisiones en vivo disponibles públicamente de fuentes públicas y gratuitas, incluido el directorio de la comunidad iptv-org. No aloja ni almacena ningún archivo de vídeo o audio y no requiere una cuenta para su uso.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: ¿Preguntas, comentarios o un canal para sugerir? Correo electrónico {link1}.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden não está na Play Store ou App Store – ele é instalado diretamente do seu navegador, em qualquer dispositivo, com apenas alguns toques.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Abra o Chrome (ou outro navegador que suporte instalações na web) e vá para freetvgarden.com . Procure o ícone de instalação na barra de endereço ou abra o menu do navegador e escolha “Adicionar à tela inicial” / “Instalar aplicativo”. FreeTV Garden abrirá em tela cheia na tela inicial, como um aplicativo nativo, sem necessidade de download na Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Abra freetvgarden.com no Safari. Toque no ícone Compartilhar e em "Adicionar à tela inicial". Isso adiciona um ícone de aplicativo ao seu iPhone ou iPad que abre o site em tela cheia – não é necessária nenhuma listagem na App Store e nada para se manter atualizado.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Abra o navegador integrado da sua TV e navegue até freetvgarden.com . Se a sua TV não tiver um navegador utilizável, transmita a página do seu telefone ou laptop usando o Chromecast ou AirPlay para assistir na tela grande.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Abra o Silk Browser (pré-instalado em dispositivos Fire TV ou gratuito na Amazon Appstore) e vá para freetvgarden.com . Selecione um país ou categoria e comece a assistir – sem necessidade de assinatura ou aplicativo adicional.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Qualquer navegador de desktop moderno funciona – basta visitar freetvgarden.com . No Chrome ou Edge, um ícone de instalação aparece na barra de endereço para adicioná-lo como um aplicativo de desktop; caso contrário, funciona bem como uma guia normal do navegador.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Sim. Não há inscrição, assinatura e pagamento em nenhum momento – basta escolher um país ou canal e começar a assistir.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden é o mesmo que FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: O tv.garden original foi renomeado para Famelack em 2026 e não usa mais o nome TV Garden. FreeTV Garden é um site separado e administrado de forma independente - não afiliado ao Famelack ou ao tv.garden original.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden tem os mesmos recursos do TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Sim, e mais. FreeTV Garden tem a mesma experiência de girar o globo e escolher um país, junto com mais de 84 filtros de idioma, mais de 25 categorias de conteúdo, reprodução picture-in-picture, favoritos que você pode marcar com estrela e revisitar, um botão de canal aleatório e instalação com um toque direto do Chrome ou Safari - sem necessidade de loja de aplicativos.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden também tem rádio e webcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Sim. FreeTV Garden também tem uma guia Rádio com estações ao vivo de gêneros como Pop, Jazz e Talk, e uma guia Webcam com imagens de câmeras ao vivo de todo o mundo. Alterne as guias acima do globo.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Como FreeTV Garden é diferente de radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden é um projeto separado e executado de forma independente – não afiliado a radio.garden . Ele oferece uma interface mais simples e intuitiva com navegação mais fácil e vai além do rádio com TV ao vivo e webcams integradas na mesma ferramenta gratuita de um toque.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: O que aconteceu com a antiga página FreeTool TV Garden no Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Foi relançado aqui. A página que ficava em freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden é o mesmo projeto, agora rodando com seu próprio nome e domínio: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Nenhuma conta é necessária. FreeTV Garden não pede e-mail, senha ou quaisquer dados pessoais para assistir.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Sim — FreeTV Garden é executado em qualquer navegador móvel moderno no Android ou iPhone e pode ser adicionado à sua tela inicial para acesso com um toque (consulte a seção Instalar acima).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Os canais são transmissões ao vivo provenientes de emissoras públicas, portanto, alguns ficam off-line temporariamente devido a problemas no servidor da própria emissora. Tente outro canal ou volte mais tarde – a maioria volta dentro de alguns minutos ou horas.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: As transmissões são legais para assistir?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden agrega transmissões ao vivo disponíveis publicamente – principalmente do diretório da comunidade iptv-org – e não hospeda nem armazena nenhum arquivo de vídeo. Consulte a seção Jurídico e Segurança abaixo para obter mais informações.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Mais perguntas são respondidas no {link1} completo.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden agrega transmissões ao vivo disponíveis publicamente de fontes públicas gratuitas, incluindo o diretório da comunidade iptv-org. Ele não hospeda ou armazena nenhum arquivo de vídeo ou áudio e não requer uma conta para uso.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Perguntas, comentários ou um canal para sugerir? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Comment regarder la télévision {countryName} sur votre appareil

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Aucune application ou compte n'est nécessaire pour regarder les chaînes {countryName}. Cette page fonctionne directement dans votre navigateur sur n'importe quel appareil - appuyez simplement sur une chaîne et appuyez sur play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Ouvrez cette page dans Chrome, appuyez sur une chaîne {countryName} pour commencer à regarder, puis utilisez le bouton plein écran pour une meilleure vue. Pour un accès rapide la prochaine fois, appuyez sur le menu Chrome et choisissez « Ajouter à l'écran d'accueil » pour créer une icône semblable à une application.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Ouvrez cette page dans Safari et appuyez sur n'importe quelle chaîne {countryName} pour démarrer la diffusion instantanément. Appuyez sur l'icône Partager et sélectionnez « Ajouter à l'écran d'accueil » pour un accès en un seul clic sans télécharger d'application depuis l'App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: N'importe quel navigateur moderne fonctionne - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ou Edge. Ouvrez une chaîne {countryName} et utilisez l'icône plein écran dans le lecteur pour une expérience visuelle sans distraction, semblable à celle d'un téléviseur.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Ouvrez cette page dans le navigateur intégré de votre téléviseur ou diffusez-la depuis votre téléphone ou ordinateur portable à l'aide de Chromecast ou AirPlay pour regarder les chaînes {countryName} sur grand écran.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Est-ce que regarder {countryName} TV sur FreeTV Garden est gratuit ?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Oui. FreeTV Garden regroupe les chaînes gratuites (FTA) accessibles au public en ligne. Aucun abonnement, compte ou application n'est requis pour regarder.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Pourquoi certains canaux {countryName} sont-ils mis en mémoire tampon ou ne parviennent-ils pas à se charger ?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Vous vous connectez directement au serveur du diffuseur, la vitesse et la fiabilité dépendent donc de leur infrastructure, pas de la nôtre. Si une chaîne ne se charge pas, essayez-en une autre dans la liste.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Puis-je regarder les chaînes d'information {countryName} en direct sur mon téléphone ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Oui, le lecteur fonctionne sur n'importe quel navigateur de téléphone sans téléchargement d'application. Ouvrez simplement cette page, appuyez sur une chaîne d'information et utilisez le plein écran pour une meilleure vue.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Flux de caméras en direct des villes, des monuments, des plages et des sites naturels du monde entier — gratuitement et sans inscription. Parcourez le {link1} ou passez à l'onglet Webcam au-dessus du globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Chaque chaîne est également organisée par langue (plus de 84 au total) afin que vous puissiez trouver quelque chose à regarder dans la langue que vous parlez réellement, et pas seulement dans le pays que vous parcourez.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Chacun des plus de 200 pays couverts par FreeTV Garden possède sa propre page de chaînes dédiée : choisissez la vôtre ci-dessous ou parcourez par continent dans la liste complète.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden n'est pas sur le Play Store ou l'App Store : il s'installe directement depuis votre navigateur, sur n'importe quel appareil, en quelques clics.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Ouvrez Chrome (ou un autre navigateur prenant en charge les installations Web) et accédez à freetvgarden.com . Recherchez l'icône d'installation dans la barre d'adresse ou ouvrez le menu du navigateur et choisissez « Ajouter à l'écran d'accueil » / « Installer l'application ». FreeTV Garden s'ouvrira alors en plein écran depuis votre écran d'accueil, tout comme une application native, sans aucun téléchargement depuis le Play Store requis.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Ouvrez freetvgarden.com dans Safari. Appuyez sur l'icône Partager, puis sur « Ajouter à l'écran d'accueil ». Cela ajoute une icône d'application à votre iPhone ou iPad qui lance le site en plein écran - aucune liste App Store n'est nécessaire et rien à tenir à jour.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Ouvrez le navigateur intégré de votre téléviseur et accédez à freetvgarden.com . Si votre téléviseur ne dispose pas d'un navigateur utilisable, diffusez la page depuis votre téléphone ou ordinateur portable à l'aide de Chromecast ou AirPlay pour la regarder sur grand écran.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Ouvrez le navigateur Silk (préinstallé sur les appareils Fire TV ou gratuit depuis l'Amazon Appstore) et accédez à freetvgarden.com . Sélectionnez un pays ou une catégorie et commencez à regarder – aucun abonnement ni application supplémentaire requis.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: N'importe quel navigateur de bureau moderne fonctionne : visitez simplement freetvgarden.com . Dans Chrome ou Edge, une icône d'installation apparaît dans la barre d'adresse pour l'ajouter en tant qu'application de bureau ; sinon, il fonctionne correctement comme un onglet de navigateur classique.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Est-ce que FreeTV Garden est vraiment gratuit ?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Oui. Il n'y a aucune inscription, aucun abonnement et aucun paiement à aucun moment : il suffit de choisir un pays ou une chaîne et de commencer à regarder.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden est-il identique à FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Non. Le tv.garden original a été renommé Famelack en 2026 et n'utilise plus le nom de TV Garden. FreeTV Garden est un site distinct et géré de manière indépendante, non affilié à Famelack ou au tv.garden d'origine.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden a-t-il les mêmes fonctionnalités que TV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Oui, et plus encore. FreeTV Garden propose la même expérience de rotation du monde et de sélection d'un pays, ainsi que plus de 84 filtres de langue, plus de 25 catégories de contenu, une lecture image dans l'image, des favoris que vous pouvez suivre et revisiter, un bouton de chaîne aléatoire et une installation en un seul clic directement depuis Chrome ou Safari - aucune boutique d'applications n'est nécessaire.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden dispose-t-il également d'une radio et de webcams ?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Oui. FreeTV Garden dispose également d'un onglet Radio avec des stations en direct dans des genres tels que la pop, le jazz et le talk, ainsi que d'un onglet Webcam avec des flux de caméras en direct du monde entier. Changez d’onglet au-dessus du globe.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: En quoi FreeTV Garden est-il différent de radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden est un projet distinct, géré de manière indépendante, non affilié à radio.garden . Il offre une interface plus simple et plus intuitive avec une navigation plus facile et va au-delà de la radio avec la télévision en direct et les webcams intégrées dans le même outil gratuit en un seul clic.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Qu'est-il arrivé à l'ancienne page FreeTool TV Garden sur Odoo ?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Il a relancé ici. La page qui se trouvait autrefois à freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden est le même projet, fonctionnant désormais sous son propre nom et domaine : FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Aucun compte n'est nécessaire. FreeTV Garden ne demande pas d'e-mail, de mot de passe ou de données personnelles à regarder.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Est-ce que ça marche sur mobile ?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Oui — FreeTV Garden fonctionne dans n'importe quel navigateur mobile moderne sur Android ou iPhone et peut être ajouté à votre écran d'accueil pour un accès en un seul clic (voir la section Installation ci-dessus).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Les chaînes sont des flux en direct provenant de diffuseurs publics, donc certaines sont temporairement hors ligne en raison de problèmes de serveur du diffuseur. Essayez une autre chaîne ou revenez plus tard : la plupart reviennent au bout de quelques minutes, voire quelques heures.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Les flux sont-ils légaux à regarder ?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden regroupe les flux en direct accessibles au public – principalement à partir du répertoire de la communauté iptv-org – et n'héberge ni ne stocke lui-même aucun fichier vidéo. Consultez la section Juridique et sécurité ci-dessous pour en savoir plus.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Plus de questions reçoivent une réponse dans le {link1} complet.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden regroupe les flux en direct accessibles au public à partir de sources publiques gratuites, y compris le répertoire de la communauté iptv-org. Il n'héberge ni ne stocke aucun fichier vidéo ou audio et ne nécessite pas de compte pour être utilisé.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Des questions, des commentaires ou une chaîne à suggérer ? Envoyez un e-mail à {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: So schauen Sie {countryName} TV auf Ihrem Gerät

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Zum Ansehen von {countryName}-Kanälen ist weder eine App noch ein Konto erforderlich. Diese Seite funktioniert direkt in Ihrem Browser auf jedem Gerät – tippen Sie einfach auf einen Kanal und drücken Sie „Play“.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Öffnen Sie diese Seite in Chrome, tippen Sie auf einen {countryName}-Kanal, um mit der Wiedergabe zu beginnen, und verwenden Sie dann die Vollbildschaltfläche für die beste Ansicht. Um beim nächsten Mal schnell darauf zuzugreifen, tippen Sie auf das Chrome-Menü und wählen Sie „Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen“, um ein App-ähnliches Symbol zu erstellen.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Öffnen Sie diese Seite in Safari und tippen Sie auf einen beliebigen {countryName}-Kanal, um sofort mit dem Streaming zu beginnen. Tippen Sie auf das Teilen-Symbol und wählen Sie „Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen“, um mit einem Fingertipp darauf zuzugreifen, ohne eine App aus dem App Store herunterladen zu müssen.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Jeder moderne Browser funktioniert – Chrome, Safari, Firefox oder Edge. Öffnen Sie einen {countryName}-Kanal und verwenden Sie das Vollbildsymbol im Player für ein ablenkungsfreies, fernsehähnliches Seherlebnis.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Öffnen Sie diese Seite im integrierten Browser Ihres Fernsehers oder übertragen Sie sie von Ihrem Telefon oder Laptop mit Chromecast oder AirPlay, um {countryName}-Kanäle auf dem großen Bildschirm anzusehen.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Warum puffern einige {countryName}-Kanäle oder können nicht geladen werden?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Sie stellen eine direkte Verbindung zum eigenen Server des Senders her, sodass Geschwindigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit von dessen Infrastruktur abhängen, nicht von unserer. Wenn ein Kanal nicht geladen wird, versuchen Sie es mit einem anderen aus der Liste.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ist nicht im Play Store oder App Store erhältlich – es wird stattdessen mit wenigen Fingertipps direkt über Ihren Browser auf jedem Gerät installiert.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Öffnen Sie Chrome (oder einen anderen Browser, der Webinstallationen unterstützt) und gehen Sie zu freetvgarden.com . Suchen Sie in der Adressleiste nach dem Installationssymbol oder öffnen Sie das Browsermenü und wählen Sie „Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen“ / „App installieren“. FreeTV Garden wird dann wie eine native App im Vollbildmodus von Ihrem Startbildschirm aus geöffnet, ohne dass ein Download aus dem Play Store erforderlich ist.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Öffnen Sie freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tippen Sie auf das Teilen-Symbol und dann auf „Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen“. Dadurch wird Ihrem iPhone oder iPad ein App-Symbol hinzugefügt, das die Website im Vollbildmodus startet – kein Eintrag im App Store erforderlich und nichts, was aktualisiert werden muss.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Öffnen Sie den integrierten Browser Ihres Fernsehers und navigieren Sie zu freetvgarden.com . Wenn Ihr Fernseher nicht über einen verwendbaren Browser verfügt, übertragen Sie die Seite stattdessen mit Chromecast oder AirPlay von Ihrem Telefon oder Laptop, um sie auf dem großen Bildschirm anzusehen.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Öffnen Sie den Silk Browser (auf Fire TV-Geräten vorinstalliert oder kostenlos im Amazon Appstore erhältlich) und gehen Sie zu freetvgarden.com . Wählen Sie ein Land oder eine Kategorie aus und beginnen Sie mit dem Anschauen – kein Abonnement oder zusätzliche App erforderlich.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Jeder moderne Desktop-Browser funktioniert – besuchen Sie einfach freetvgarden.com . In Chrome oder Edge erscheint in der Adressleiste ein Installationssymbol, um es als Desktop-App hinzuzufügen; Ansonsten läuft es einwandfrei als normaler Browser-Tab.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Es gibt keine Anmeldung, kein Abonnement und zu keinem Zeitpunkt eine Zahlung – wählen Sie einfach ein Land oder einen Kanal aus und beginnen Sie mit dem Anschauen.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ist tv.garden dasselbe wie FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nein. Der ursprüngliche tv.garden wurde 2026 in Famelack umbenannt und verwendet nicht mehr den Namen TV Garden. FreeTV Garden ist eine separate, unabhängig betriebene Website – nicht mit Famelack oder dem ursprünglichen tv.garden verbunden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Hat FreeTV Garden die gleichen Funktionen wie TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, und noch mehr. FreeTV Garden bietet das gleiche Erlebnis, den Globus zu drehen und ein Land auszuwählen, zusammen mit mehr als 84 Sprachfiltern, mehr als 25 Inhaltskategorien, Bild-in-Bild-Wiedergabe, Favoriten, die Sie markieren und erneut aufrufen können, einer Schaltfläche für zufällige Kanäle und einer One-Tap-Installation direkt aus Chrome oder Safari – kein App Store erforderlich.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Verfügt FreeTV Garden auch über Radio und Webcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden verfügt außerdem über einen Radio-Tab mit Live-Sendern verschiedener Genres wie Pop, Jazz und Talk sowie einen Webcam-Tab mit Live-Kamera-Feeds aus der ganzen Welt. Wechseln Sie die Registerkarten über dem Globus.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Wie unterscheidet sich FreeTV Garden von radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ist ein separates, unabhängig geführtes Projekt – nicht mit radio.garden verbunden. Es bietet eine einfachere, intuitivere Benutzeroberfläche mit einfacherer Navigation und geht über Radio hinaus, da Live-TV und Webcams in dasselbe kostenlose One-Tap-Tool integriert sind.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Was ist mit der alten FreeTool TV Garden-Seite auf Odoo passiert?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Es wurde hier neu gestartet. Die Seite, die sich früher unter freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden befand, ist dasselbe Projekt, das jetzt unter eigenem Namen und eigener Domain läuft: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Es ist kein Konto erforderlich. FreeTV Garden fragt nicht nach einer E-Mail-Adresse, einem Passwort oder anderen persönlichen Daten zum Ansehen.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja – FreeTV Garden läuft in jedem modernen mobilen Browser auf Android oder iPhone und kann für den Zugriff mit einem Fingertipp zu Ihrem Startbildschirm hinzugefügt werden (siehe Abschnitt „Installieren“ oben).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Warum wird bei einem Kanal „Nicht verfügbar“ angezeigt?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Bei den Kanälen handelt es sich um Livestreams, die von öffentlich-rechtlichen Sendern stammen. Einige Kanäle sind daher aufgrund von Serverproblemen des Senders vorübergehend offline. Probieren Sie einen anderen Kanal aus oder schauen Sie später noch einmal vorbei – die meisten kommen innerhalb weniger Minuten bis Stunden wieder zurück.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Ist das Ansehen der Streams legal?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden fasst öffentlich verfügbare Livestreams zusammen – hauptsächlich aus dem Community-Verzeichnis iptv-org – und hostet oder speichert selbst keine Videodateien. Weitere Informationen finden Sie weiter unten im Abschnitt „Rechtliche Hinweise und Sicherheit“.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Weitere Fragen werden im vollständigen {link1} beantwortet.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden fasst öffentlich verfügbare Live-Streams aus kostenlosen, öffentlichen Quellen zusammen, einschließlich des Community-Verzeichnisses iptv-org. Es werden keine Video- oder Audiodateien gehostet oder gespeichert und für die Nutzung ist kein Konto erforderlich.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Non è necessaria alcuna app o account per guardare i canali {countryName}. Questa pagina funziona direttamente nel tuo browser su qualsiasi dispositivo: basta toccare un canale e premere Riproduci.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden non è sul Play Store o sull'App Store: si installa invece direttamente dal tuo browser, su qualsiasi dispositivo, in pochi tocchi.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Apri Chrome (o un altro browser che supporta le installazioni Web) e vai a freetvgarden.com . Cerca l'icona di installazione nella barra degli indirizzi oppure apri il menu del browser e seleziona "Aggiungi alla schermata iniziale"/"Installa app". FreeTV Garden si aprirà quindi a schermo intero dalla schermata iniziale, proprio come un'app nativa, senza bisogno di download dal Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Apri freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tocca l'icona Condividi, quindi "Aggiungi alla schermata iniziale". Ciò aggiunge un'icona dell'app al tuo iPhone o iPad che avvia il sito a schermo intero: non è necessaria alcuna scheda nell'App Store e nulla da tenere aggiornato.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Apri il browser integrato della TV e vai a freetvgarden.com. Se la tua TV non dispone di un browser utilizzabile, trasmetti la pagina dal tuo telefono o laptop utilizzando Chromecast o AirPlay per guardarla sul grande schermo.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Apri Silk Browser (preinstallato sui dispositivi Fire TV o gratuitamente da Amazon Appstore) e vai su freetvgarden.com . Seleziona un paese o una categoria e inizia a guardare: non è richiesto alcun abbonamento o app aggiuntiva.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Funziona qualsiasi browser desktop moderno: visita semplicemente freetvgarden.com . In Chrome o Edge, nella barra degli indirizzi viene visualizzata un'icona di installazione per aggiungerla come app desktop; altrimenti funziona bene come una normale scheda del browser.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: SÌ. Non è prevista alcuna registrazione, abbonamento o pagamento in nessun momento: basta scegliere un Paese o un canale e iniziare a guardare.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden è uguale a FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: No. L'originale tv.garden è stato rinominato Famelack nel 2026 e non utilizza più il nome TV Garden. FreeTV Garden è un sito separato e gestito in modo indipendente, non affiliato con Famelack o con l'originale tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ha le stesse funzionalità di TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Sì, e altro ancora. FreeTV Garden offre la stessa esperienza di giro del mondo, scegli un paese, insieme a oltre 84 filtri linguistici, oltre 25 categorie di contenuti, riproduzione immagine nell'immagine, preferiti che puoi aggiungere a Speciali e rivisitare, un pulsante per un canale casuale e installazione con un solo tocco direttamente da Chrome o Safari: non è necessario alcun app store.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ha anche radio e webcam?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: SÌ. FreeTV Garden ha anche una scheda Radio con stazioni in diretta di generi come pop, jazz e talk, e una scheda Webcam con feed di telecamere in diretta da tutto il mondo. Cambia scheda sopra il globo.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: In che modo FreeTV Garden è diverso da radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden è un progetto separato e gestito in modo indipendente, non affiliato con radio.garden. Offre un'interfaccia più semplice e intuitiva con una navigazione più semplice e va oltre la radio con TV in diretta e webcam integrate nello stesso strumento gratuito con un solo tocco.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Cos'è successo alla vecchia pagina FreeTool TV Garden su Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: È stato rilanciato qui. La pagina che viveva su freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden è lo stesso progetto, ora eseguito con il proprio nome e dominio: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Non è necessario alcun account. FreeTV Garden non richiede email, password o altri dettagli personali per guardare.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Sì: FreeTV Garden funziona con qualsiasi browser mobile moderno su Android o iPhone e può essere aggiunto alla schermata iniziale per l'accesso con un solo tocco (vedere la sezione Installazione sopra).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: I canali sono flussi live provenienti da emittenti pubbliche, quindi alcuni vanno temporaneamente offline a causa di problemi del server dell'emittente. Prova un altro canale o riprova più tardi: la maggior parte ritorna entro pochi minuti o ore.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden aggrega i live streaming disponibili pubblicamente, principalmente dalla directory della community iptv-org, e non ospita né archivia alcun file video. Per ulteriori informazioni, vedere la sezione Legale e sicurezza di seguito.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Ad altre domande viene data risposta nella versione completa {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden aggrega i live streaming disponibili pubblicamente da fonti pubbliche gratuite, inclusa la directory della community iptv-org. Non ospita né archivia file video o audio e non richiede un account per essere utilizzato.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Domande, feedback o un canale da suggerire? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Elk kanaal is ook ingedeeld op taal (84+ in totaal), zodat u iets kunt vinden om naar te kijken in de taal die u daadwerkelijk spreekt, en niet alleen in het land waar u doorheen bladert.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Elk van de meer dan 200 landen die FreeTV Garden covers heeft, heeft zijn eigen speciale pagina met kanalen. Kies hieronder de jouwe, of blader per continent uit de volledige lijst.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden staat niet in de Play Store of App Store, maar wordt met een paar tikken rechtstreeks vanuit je browser op elk apparaat geïnstalleerd.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Open Chrome (of een andere browser die webinstallaties ondersteunt) en ga naar freetvgarden.com. Zoek naar het installatiepictogram in de adresbalk, of open het browsermenu en kies 'Toevoegen aan startscherm' / 'App installeren'. FreeTV Garden wordt dan op volledig scherm geopend vanaf uw startscherm, net als een native app, zonder dat een download uit de Play Store vereist is.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tik op het pictogram Delen en vervolgens op 'Toevoegen aan startscherm'. Hiermee wordt een app-pictogram aan uw iPhone of iPad toegevoegd waarmee de site op volledig scherm wordt geopend. Er is geen App Store-vermelding nodig en u hoeft niets up-to-date te houden.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Open de ingebouwde browser van uw tv en ga naar freetvgarden.com. Als uw tv geen bruikbare browser heeft, cast u de pagina vanaf uw telefoon of laptop met Chromecast of AirPlay om deze op het grote scherm te bekijken.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Open de Silk Browser (vooraf geïnstalleerd op Fire TV-apparaten, of gratis via de Amazon Appstore) en ga naar freetvgarden.com. Selecteer een land of categorie en begin met kijken – geen abonnement of extra app vereist.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Elke moderne desktopbrowser werkt – bezoek gewoon freetvgarden.com. In Chrome of Edge verschijnt een installatiepictogram in de adresbalk om het als desktop-app toe te voegen; anders werkt het prima als een normaal browsertabblad.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Er is geen aanmelding, geen abonnement en geen enkele betaling nodig. Kies gewoon een land of kanaal en begin met kijken.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Is tv.garden hetzelfde als FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nee. De oorspronkelijke naam tv.garden werd in 2026 omgedoopt tot Famelack en gebruikt niet langer de naam TV Garden. FreeTV Garden is een afzonderlijke, onafhankelijk beheerde site — niet gelieerd aan Famelack of de oorspronkelijke tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Heeft FreeTV Garden dezelfde functies als TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus meer. FreeTV Garden heeft dezelfde wereldomvattende, kies-een-land-ervaring, samen met meer dan 84 taalfilters, meer dan 25 inhoudscategorieën, beeld-in-beeld afspelen, favorieten die je een ster kunt geven en opnieuw kunt bezoeken, een willekeurige kanaalknop en installatie met één tik rechtstreeks vanuit Chrome of Safari - geen app store nodig.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Heeft FreeTV Garden ook radio en webcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden heeft ook een tabblad Radio met livestations in genres als Pop, Jazz en Talk, en een tabblad Webcam met live camerafeeds van over de hele wereld. Schakel tussen tabbladen boven de wereldbol.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Waarin verschilt FreeTV Garden van radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden is een afzonderlijk, onafhankelijk geleid project — niet gelieerd aan radio.garden. Het biedt een eenvoudigere, meer intuïtieve interface met eenvoudigere navigatie, en gaat verder dan radio, met live tv en webcams ingebouwd in dezelfde gratis tool met één tik.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Wat is er gebeurd met de oude FreeTool TV Garden pagina op Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Hier is het opnieuw gelanceerd. De pagina die voorheen op freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden stond, is hetzelfde project, maar draait nu onder zijn eigen naam en domein: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Er is geen account nodig. FreeTV Garden vraagt ​​niet om een ​​e-mailadres, wachtwoord of persoonlijke gegevens om te bekijken.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja – FreeTV Garden werkt in elke moderne mobiele browser op Android of iPhone en kan aan uw startscherm worden toegevoegd voor toegang met één tik (zie het gedeelte Installeren hierboven).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Waarom wordt bij een kanaal de melding 'Niet beschikbaar' weergegeven?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanalen zijn livestreams afkomstig van publieke omroepen, dus sommige gaan tijdelijk offline vanwege serverproblemen van de omroep zelf. Probeer een ander kanaal of kom later terug. De meeste komen binnen een paar minuten tot uren terug.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Zijn de streams legaal om te bekijken?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden verzamelt openbaar beschikbare livestreams (voornamelijk uit de communitydirectory iptv-org) en host of bewaart zelf geen videobestanden. Zie het gedeelte Juridisch en veiligheid hieronder voor meer informatie.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Meer vragen worden beantwoord op de volledige {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden verzamelt openbaar beschikbare livestreams van gratis, openbare bronnen, waaronder de communitydirectory iptv-org. Er worden geen video- of audiobestanden gehost of opgeslagen en er is geen account voor nodig.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Do oglądania kanałów {countryName} nie jest wymagana żadna aplikacja ani konto. Ta strona działa bezpośrednio w przeglądarce na dowolnym urządzeniu - wystarczy dotknąć kanału i nacisnąć przycisk odtwarzania.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Otwórz tę stronę w przeglądarce Safari i dotknij dowolnego kanału {countryName}, aby natychmiast rozpocząć transmisję strumieniową. seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Działa każda nowoczesna przeglądarka - Chrome, Safari, Firefox lub Edge. Otwórz kanał {countryName} i użyj ikony trybu pełnoekranowego w odtwarzaczu, aby oglądać filmy niczym na telewizorze.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.

FreeTV Garden otworzy się wówczas na pełnym ekranie z ekranu głównego, podobnie jak aplikacja natywna, bez konieczności pobierania ze Sklepu Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Otwórz freetvgarden.com w Safari. Kliknij ikonę Udostępnij, a następnie „Dodaj do ekranu głównego”. Spowoduje to dodanie ikony aplikacji do Twojego iPhone'a lub iPada, która uruchomi witrynę na pełnym ekranie — nie jest wymagana lista App Store i nie trzeba niczego aktualizować.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Otwórz wbudowaną przeglądarkę telewizora i przejdź do freetvgarden.com . Jeśli Twój telewizor nie ma działającej przeglądarki, prześlij stronę z telefonu lub laptopa za pomocą Chromecasta lub AirPlay, aby zamiast tego oglądać na dużym ekranie.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Otwórz przeglądarkę Silk (preinstalowaną na urządzeniach Fire TV lub bezpłatną z Amazon Appstore) i przejdź do freetvgarden.com. Wybierz kraj lub kategorię i zacznij oglądać — nie jest wymagana subskrypcja ani dodatkowa aplikacja.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Działa każda nowoczesna przeglądarka komputerowa — wystarczy odwiedzić freetvgarden.com. W przeglądarce Chrome lub Edge na pasku adresu pojawia się ikona instalacji, która umożliwia dodanie aplikacji jako aplikacji komputerowej; w przeciwnym razie będzie działać poprawnie jako zwykła karta przeglądarki.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden jest naprawdę darmowy?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Tak. Nie musisz się rejestrować, subskrybować ani płacić w żadnym momencie — po prostu wybierz kraj lub kanał i zacznij oglądać.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Czy tv.garden to to samo co FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nie. W 2026 r. oryginalna nazwa tv.garden została zmieniona na Famelack i nie używa już nazwy TV Garden. FreeTV Garden to osobna, niezależnie prowadzona witryna — niepowiązana z Famelack ani oryginalnym tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden ma te same funkcje co TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Tak, i jeszcze więcej. FreeTV Garden oferuje takie same możliwości obracania się po świecie i wybierania kraju, a także ponad 84 filtry językowe, ponad 25 kategorii treści, odtwarzanie obrazu w obrazie, ulubione, które możesz oznaczać gwiazdką i do których możesz powracać, przycisk losowego kanału i instalację jednym dotknięciem bezpośrednio z Chrome lub Safari – nie jest potrzebny sklep z aplikacjami.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Czy FreeTV Garden ma także radio i kamery internetowe?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Tak. FreeTV Garden ma także zakładkę Radio ze stacjami na żywo z różnych gatunków, takich jak Pop, Jazz i Talk, oraz zakładkę Kamera internetowa z transmisjami na żywo z kamer z całego świata. Przełączaj karty nad kulą ziemską.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Czym FreeTV Garden różni się od radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden to odrębny, niezależnie prowadzony projekt — niezwiązany z radio.garden. Oferuje prostszy, bardziej intuicyjny interfejs z łatwiejszą nawigacją i wykracza poza radio z telewizją na żywo i kamerami internetowymi wbudowanymi w to samo bezpłatne narzędzie obsługiwane jednym dotknięciem.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Co się stało ze starą stroną FreeTool TV Garden w Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Tutaj wznowiono. Strona, która wcześniej znajdowała się pod adresem freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden, to ten sam projekt, teraz działający pod własną nazwą i domeną: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Żadne konto nie jest potrzebne. FreeTV Garden nie prosi o adres e-mail, hasło ani żadne dane osobowe, aby móc oglądać.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Czy to działa na urządzeniach mobilnych?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Tak — FreeTV Garden działa w dowolnej nowoczesnej przeglądarce mobilnej na Androidzie lub iPhonie i można go dodać do ekranu głównego, aby uzyskać dostęp jednym dotknięciem (patrz sekcja Instalacja powyżej).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanały to transmisje na żywo pochodzące od nadawców publicznych, więc niektóre z nich tymczasowo przestają działać z powodu problemów z serwerem nadawcy. Wypróbuj inny kanał lub sprawdź później — większość wraca w ciągu kilku minut do godzin.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden agreguje publicznie dostępne transmisje na żywo — głównie z katalogu społeczności iptv-org — i sam nie hostuje ani nie przechowuje żadnych plików wideo. Aby uzyskać więcej informacji, zobacz sekcję „Prawo i bezpieczeństwo” poniżej.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Odpowiedzi na więcej pytań znajdują się w pełnym {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden gromadzi publicznie dostępne transmisje na żywo z bezpłatnych, publicznych źródeł, w tym z katalogu społeczności iptv-org. Nie hostuje ani nie przechowuje żadnych plików wideo ani audio i nie wymaga konta do użycia.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Nu este nevoie de nicio aplicație sau cont pentru a viziona {countryName} canale. Această pagină funcționează direct în browserul dvs. pe orice dispozitiv - trebuie doar să atingeți un canal și să apăsați pe redare.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.

Atingeți pictograma Partajare și selectați „Adăugați la ecranul de pornire” pentru acces cu o singură atingere fără a descărca o aplicație din App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Orice browser modern funcționează - Chrome, Safari, Firefox sau Edge. Deschideți un canal {countryName} și folosiți pictograma pe ecran complet din player pentru o experiență de vizionare fără distracție, asemănătoare unui televizor.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
