seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden nu se află în Magazinul Play sau în Magazinul de aplicații – se instalează direct din browser, pe orice dispozitiv, în câteva atingeri.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Deschideți Chrome (sau alt browser care acceptă instalări web) și accesați freetvgarden.com . Căutați pictograma de instalare în bara de adrese sau deschideți meniul browserului și alegeți „Adăugați la ecranul de pornire” / „Instalați aplicația”. FreeTV Garden se va deschide apoi pe ecran complet de pe ecranul de pornire, la fel ca o aplicație nativă, fără a fi necesară descărcarea din Magazinul Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Deschideți freetvgarden.com în Safari. Atinge pictograma Partajare, apoi „Adaugă la ecranul de pornire”. Acest lucru adaugă o pictogramă de aplicație pe iPhone sau iPad care lansează site-ul pe ecran complet - nu este necesară listarea App Store și nimic de actualizat.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Deschideți browserul încorporat al televizorului și navigați la freetvgarden.com . Dacă televizorul dvs. nu are un browser utilizabil, proiectați pagina de pe telefon sau laptop folosind Chromecast sau AirPlay pentru a viziona pe ecranul mare.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Deschideți Silk Browser (preinstalat pe dispozitivele Fire TV sau gratuit din Amazon Appstore) și accesați freetvgarden.com . Selectați o țară sau o categorie și începeți să vizionați - nu este nevoie de abonament sau aplicație suplimentară.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Orice browser modern de desktop funcționează — trebuie doar să accesați freetvgarden.com . În Chrome sau Edge, o pictogramă de instalare apare în bara de adrese pentru ao adăuga ca aplicație desktop; în caz contrar, funcționează bine ca o filă obișnuită de browser.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Este FreeTV Garden cu adevărat gratuit?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Da. Nu există nicio înscriere, nici un abonament și nicio plată în niciun moment - doar alegeți o țară sau un canal și începeți să vizionați.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Este tv.garden la fel cu FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nu. tv.garden original a devenit Famelack în 2026 și nu mai folosește numele TV Garden. FreeTV Garden este un site separat, administrat independent — nu este afiliat cu Famelack sau cu tv.garden original.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden are aceleași caracteristici ca și TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Da, plus mai mult. FreeTV Garden are aceeași experiență de învârtire a globului, alegerea unei țări, împreună cu peste 84 de filtre de limbă, peste 25 de categorii de conținut, redare imagine în imagine, favorite pe care le puteți vedea cu stea și să le revedeți, un buton pentru canal aleatoriu și o instalare cu o singură atingere direct din Chrome sau Safari - nu este nevoie de magazin de aplicații.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden are și radio și camere web?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Da. FreeTV Garden are, de asemenea, o filă Radio cu posturi live din genuri precum Pop, Jazz și Talk și o filă Cameră web cu fluxuri live ale camerelor din întreaga lume. Comutați filele deasupra globului.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Prin ce diferă FreeTV Garden de radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden este un proiect separat, condus independent — care nu este afiliat cu radio.garden . Oferă o interfață mai simplă, mai intuitivă, cu navigare mai ușoară și depășește radioul, cu TV live și camere web integrate în același instrument gratuit, cu o singură atingere.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Ce s-a întâmplat cu vechea pagină FreeTool TV Garden de pe Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: S-a relansat aici. Pagina care locuia odinioară la freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden este același proiect, care rulează acum sub propriul nume și domeniu: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Trebuie să îmi creez un cont?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Nu este nevoie de cont. FreeTV Garden nu solicită un e-mail, o parolă sau orice detalii personale de urmărit.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Da — FreeTV Garden rulează în orice browser mobil modern pe Android sau iPhone și poate fi adăugat la ecranul de pornire pentru acces cu o singură atingere (consultați secțiunea Instalare de mai sus).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Canalele sunt streamuri live provenite de la radiodifuzori publici, așa că unele sunt temporar offline din cauza problemelor proprii cu serverul radiodifuzorului. Încercați alt canal sau verificați din nou mai târziu - majoritatea revin în câteva minute sau ore.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden reunește fluxurile live disponibile public — în principal din directorul comunității iptv-org — și nu găzduiește și nu stochează niciun fișier video. Consultați secțiunea Juridic și siguranță de mai jos pentru mai multe.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: La mai multe întrebări se răspunde pe {link1} integral.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden reunește streamuri live disponibile public din surse publice gratuite, inclusiv directorul comunității iptv-org. Nu găzduiește și nu stochează niciun fișier video sau audio și nu necesită un cont pentru utilizare.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Întrebări, feedback sau un canal de sugerat? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Så här tittar du på {countryName} TV på din enhet

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Ingen app eller konto behövs för att titta på {countryName}-kanaler. Den här sidan fungerar direkt i din webbläsare på vilken enhet som helst – tryck bara på en kanal och tryck på play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Öppna den här sidan i Chrome, tryck på en {countryName}-kanal för att börja titta och använd sedan helskärmsknappen för bästa visning. För snabb åtkomst nästa gång, tryck på Chrome-menyn och välj "Lägg till på startskärmen" för att skapa en appliknande ikon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Öppna den här sidan i Safari och tryck på valfri {countryName}-kanal för att börja streama direkt. Tryck på Dela-ikonen och välj "Lägg till på startskärmen" för åtkomst med en knapptryckning utan att ladda ner en app från App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Alla moderna webbläsare fungerar - Chrome, Safari, Firefox eller Edge. Öppna en {countryName}-kanal och använd helskärmsikonen i spelaren för en TV-liknande tittarupplevelse utan distraktion.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Öppna den här sidan i TV:ns inbyggda webbläsare eller casta den från din telefon eller bärbara dator med Chromecast eller AirPlay för att titta på {countryName}-kanaler på storskärmen.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Är det gratis att titta på {countryName} TV på FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden samlar Free-to-Air-kanaler (FTA) som är allmänt tillgängliga online. Det krävs ingen prenumeration, konto eller app för att titta.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Varför buffrar vissa {countryName}-kanaler eller inte laddas?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden finns inte i Play Store eller App Store – den installeras direkt från din webbläsare istället, på vilken enhet som helst, med några få tryck.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Öppna Chrome (eller en annan webbläsare som stöder webbinstallationer) och gå till freetvgarden.com . Leta efter installationsikonen i adressfältet, eller öppna webbläsarmenyn och välj "Lägg till på startskärmen" / "Installera appen." FreeTV Garden öppnas sedan i helskärmsläge från din startskärm, precis som en inbyggd app, utan att ladda ner från Play Butik.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Öppna freetvgarden.com i Safari. Tryck på ikonen Dela och sedan på "Lägg till på startskärmen". Detta lägger till en appikon på din iPhone eller iPad som startar webbplatsen i helskärmsläge - ingen App Store-information behövs och inget att hålla uppdaterat.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Öppna TV:ns inbyggda webbläsare och navigera till freetvgarden.com . Om din TV inte har en användbar webbläsare kan du casta sidan från din telefon eller bärbara dator med Chromecast eller AirPlay för att titta på den stora skärmen istället.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Öppna Silk Browser (förinstallerad på Fire TV-enheter eller gratis från Amazon Appstore) och gå till freetvgarden.com . Välj ett land eller kategori och börja titta – ingen prenumeration eller ytterligare app krävs.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Alla moderna stationära webbläsare fungerar — besök bara freetvgarden.com . I Chrome eller Edge visas en installationsikon i adressfältet för att lägga till den som en skrivbordsapp; annars fungerar den bra som en vanlig webbläsarflik.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Det finns ingen registrering, ingen prenumeration och ingen betalning vid något tillfälle – välj bara ett land eller en kanal och börja titta.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Är tv.garden detsamma som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nej. Den ursprungliga tv.garden ändrades till Famelack 2026 och använder inte längre TV Garden-namnet. FreeTV Garden är en separat, oberoende körd webbplats — inte ansluten till Famelack eller den ursprungliga tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden samma funktioner som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus mer. FreeTV Garden har samma spin-the-globe, välj-ett-land-upplevelse, tillsammans med 84+ språkfilter, 25+ innehållskategorier, bild-i-bild-uppspelning, favoriter som du kan stjärnmärka och återbesöka, en slumpmässig kanalknapp och en-trycksinstallation direkt från Chrome eller Safari – ingen appbutik behövs.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden även radio och webbkameror?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har också en Radio-flik med live-stationer över genrer som Pop, Jazz och Talk, och en Webcam-flik med live-kameraflöden från hela världen. Byt flik ovanför jordklotet.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hur skiljer sig FreeTV Garden från radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden är ett separat, självständigt kört projekt — inte kopplat till radio.garden . Den erbjuder ett enklare, mer intuitivt gränssnitt med enklare navigering och går längre än radio med live-TV och webbkameror inbyggda i samma kostnadsfria verktyg med ett tryck.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Vad hände med den gamla FreeTool TV Garden-sidan på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Den återlanserades här. Sidan som tidigare bodde på freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden är samma projekt som nu körs under sitt eget namn och domän: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Inget konto behövs. FreeTV Garden ber inte om e-post, lösenord eller någon personlig information att titta på.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden körs i vilken modern mobil webbläsare som helst på Android eller iPhone och kan läggas till på din startskärm för åtkomst med en knapptryckning (se avsnittet Installera ovan).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler är liveströmmar som kommer från offentliga programföretag, så vissa går offline tillfälligt på grund av programföretagets egna serverproblem. Prova en annan kanal, eller kom tillbaka senare – de flesta kommer tillbaka inom några minuter till timmar.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Är strömmarna lagliga att titta på?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samlar ihop offentligt tillgängliga liveströmmar – främst från communitykatalogen iptv-org – och är inte värd för eller lagrar några videofiler själv. Se avsnittet Juridik och säkerhet nedan för mer.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Fler frågor besvaras på hela {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samlar offentligt tillgängliga liveströmmar från gratis, offentliga källor, inklusive iptv-org-gemenskapskatalogen. Det är inte värd för eller lagrar några video- eller ljudfiler och kräver inget konto för att använda.

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Hvorfor buffer eller indlæses nogle {countryName}-kanaler ikke?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Du opretter forbindelse direkte til broadcasterens egen server, så hastighed og pålidelighed afhænger af deres infrastruktur, ikke vores. Hvis en kanal ikke indlæses, kan du prøve en anden fra listen.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Kan jeg se {countryName} nyhedskanaler live på min telefon?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Ja – afspilleren fungerer på enhver telefonbrowser uden app-download. Bare åbn denne side, tryk på en nyhedskanal, og brug fuldskærm for den bedste visning.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Er dette den officielle hjemmeside for en hvilken som helst {countryName}-udsender?

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden er ikke i Play Butik eller App Store - den installeres direkte fra din browser i stedet for på enhver enhed med få tryk.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Åbn Chrome (eller en anden browser, der understøtter webinstallationer), og gå til freetvgarden.com . Se efter installationsikonet i adresselinjen, eller åbn browsermenuen og vælg "Tilføj til startskærmen" / "Installer app." FreeTV Garden åbner derefter fuld skærm fra din startskærm, ligesom en indbygget app, uden krav om download fra Play Butik.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Åbn freetvgarden.com i Safari. Tryk på Del-ikonet og derefter på "Tilføj til startskærm". Dette tilføjer et app-ikon til din iPhone eller iPad, der starter webstedet i fuld skærm - ingen App Store-fortegnelse nødvendig, og intet at holde opdateret.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Åbn dit tv's indbyggede browser, og naviger til freetvgarden.com . Hvis dit tv ikke har en brugbar browser, kan du caste siden fra din telefon eller bærbare computer ved hjælp af Chromecast eller AirPlay for at se den på den store skærm i stedet.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Åbn Silk Browser (forudinstalleret på Fire TV-enheder eller gratis fra Amazon Appstore), og gå til freetvgarden.com . Vælg et land eller en kategori, og begynd at se - intet abonnement eller yderligere app kræves.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Enhver moderne desktop-browser fungerer - bare besøg freetvgarden.com. I Chrome eller Edge vises et installationsikon i adresselinjen for at tilføje det som en desktop-app; ellers kører den fint som en almindelig browserfane.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Der er ingen tilmelding, intet abonnement og ingen betaling på noget tidspunkt - bare vælg et land eller en kanal og begynd at se.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Er tv.garden det samme som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nej. Den originale tv.garden blev omdøbt til Famelack i 2026 og bruger ikke længere TV Garden-navnet. FreeTV Garden er et separat, uafhængigt drevet websted - ikke tilknyttet Famelack eller den originale tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden de samme funktioner som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus mere. FreeTV Garden har den samme spin-the-globe, vælg-et-land-oplevelse sammen med 84+ sprogfiltre, 25+ indholdskategorier, billed-i-billede-afspilning, favoritter, du kan stjernemarkere og gense, en tilfældig kanalknap og et-tryksinstallation direkte fra Chrome eller Safari – ingen appbutik nødvendig.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden også radio og webcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har også en Radio-fane med live-stationer på tværs af genrer som Pop, Jazz og Talk og en Webcam-fane med live kamera-feeds fra hele verden. Skift faner over kloden.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hvordan er FreeTV Garden forskellig fra radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden er et separat, uafhængigt drevet projekt — ikke tilknyttet radio.garden. Det tilbyder en enklere, mere intuitiv grænseflade med lettere navigation og går ud over radio med live-tv og webcams indbygget i det samme gratis værktøj med et enkelt tryk.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Hvad skete der med den gamle FreeTool TV Garden side på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Det relancerede her. Siden, der plejede at bo på freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden, er det samme projekt, som nu kører under sit eget navn og domæne: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ingen konto er nødvendig. FreeTV Garden beder ikke om en e-mail, adgangskode eller nogen personlige detaljer for at se.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden kører i enhver moderne mobilbrowser på Android eller iPhone og kan føjes til din startskærm for adgang med et enkelt tryk (se afsnittet Installation ovenfor).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler er livestreams hentet fra offentlige tv-selskaber, så nogle går offline midlertidigt på grund af tv-stationens egne serverproblemer. Prøv en anden kanal, eller tjek tilbage senere - de fleste kommer tilbage inden for et par minutter til timer.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentligt tilgængelige livestreams - primært fra iptv-org-fællesskabsmappen - og hoster eller gemmer ikke selv videofiler. Se afsnittet Juridisk og sikkerhedsmæssigt nedenfor for mere.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Flere spørgsmål besvares på den fulde {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentligt tilgængelige livestreams fra gratis, offentlige kilder, herunder iptv-org-fællesskabskataloget. Det hoster eller gemmer ikke nogen video- eller lydfiler, og det kræver ikke en konto for at bruge.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Spørgsmål, feedback eller en kanal at foreslå? E-mail {link1} .

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Ingen app eller konto er nødvendig for å se {countryName}-kanaler. Denne siden fungerer direkte i nettleseren din på hvilken som helst enhet – bare trykk på en kanal og trykk på play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Åpne denne siden i Chrome, trykk på en {countryName}-kanal for å begynne å se, og bruk deretter fullskjerm-knappen for best mulig visning. For rask tilgang neste gang, trykk på Chrome-menyen og velg «Legg til på startskjermen» for å lage et applignende ikon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Åpne denne siden i Safari og trykk på en hvilken som helst {countryName}-kanal for å begynne å strømme umiddelbart. Trykk på Del-ikonet og velg "Legg til på startskjermen" for ett-trykks tilgang uten å laste ned en app fra App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Enhver moderne nettleser fungerer - Chrome, Safari, Firefox eller Edge. Åpne en {countryName}-kanal og bruk fullskjermikonet i spilleren for en distraksjonsfri, TV-lignende seeropplevelse.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Åpne denne siden i TV-ens innebygde nettleser, eller cast den fra telefonen eller den bærbare datamaskinen med Chromecast eller AirPlay for å se {countryName}-kanaler på storskjerm.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Er det gratis å se {countryName} TV på FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden samler Free-to-Air-kanaler (FTA) som er offentlig tilgjengelig på nettet. Det kreves ikke noe abonnement, konto eller app for å se.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountQ.translated: Hvor mange {countryName} kanaler har FreeTV Garden?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: For tiden rundt {count} direktekanaler, som spenner over kategorier som {categories} .

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: Kanalantallet endres ofte etter hvert som offentlige strømmer går på og uten nett – åpne verktøyet ovenfor for å se hva som er live akkurat nå.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: Denne listen oppdateres automatisk fra den offentlige iptv-org-katalogen.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Hvorfor bufrer noen {countryName}-kanaler eller ikke lastes inn?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Du kobler direkte til kringkasterens egen server, så hastighet og pålitelighet avhenger av deres infrastruktur, ikke vår. Hvis en kanal ikke laster inn, prøv en annen fra listen.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Kan jeg se {countryName} nyhetskanaler direkte på telefonen min?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Ja – spilleren fungerer på alle telefonnettlesere uten appnedlasting. Bare åpne denne siden, trykk på en nyhetskanal og bruk fullskjerm for best mulig visning.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Er dette den offisielle nettsiden til en hvilken som helst {countryName} kringkaster?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Nei. FreeTV Garden er en uavhengig katalog som lenker til offentlig tilgjengelige strømmer. Den er ikke tilknyttet, støttet av eller drevet av noen kringkaster som er oppført på denne siden.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Spinn en fotorealistisk 3D-satellittglobe og oppdag tusenvis av direktesendte radiostasjoner fra hele verden, plottet etter deres virkelige sendeplassering – gratis, ingen registrering nødvendig.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Direktesendte TV-kanaler er organisert i 25+ kategorier – nyheter, sport, filmer, musikk, barn, dokumentar og mer – slik at du kan bla etter hva du vil se i stedet for å bla gjennom alt.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Tusenvis av gratis direktesendte radiostasjoner, organisert etter sjanger – Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies og mer. Bla gjennom {link1} eller bytt til Radio-fanen over kloden.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Live kamerafeeds fra byer, landemerker, strender og natursteder over hele verden – gratis, ingen registrering. Bla gjennom {link1} eller bytt til Webkamera-fanen over kloden.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Hver kanal er også organisert etter språk — 84+ totalt — slik at du kan finne noe å se på det språket du faktisk snakker, ikke bare landet du surfer på.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Hvert eneste av de 200+ landene FreeTV Garden dekker har sin egen dedikerte side med kanaler - velg din nedenfor, eller bla etter kontinent fra hele listen.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden er ikke i Play Store eller App Store – den installeres rett fra nettleseren din i stedet, på hvilken som helst enhet, med noen få trykk.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Åpne Chrome (eller en annen nettleser som støtter nettinstallasjoner) og gå til freetvgarden.com . Se etter installasjonsikonet i adressefeltet, eller åpne nettlesermenyen og velg "Legg til på startskjermen" / "Installer app." FreeTV Garden vil da åpne fullskjerm fra startskjermen din, akkurat som en innebygd app, uten å måtte laste ned fra Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Åpne freetvgarden.com i Safari. Trykk på Del-ikonet og deretter "Legg til på startskjermen". Dette legger til et appikon på iPhone eller iPad som starter nettstedet i full skjerm - ingen App Store-oppføring nødvendig, og ingenting å holde oppdatert.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Åpne TV-ens innebygde nettleser og naviger til freetvgarden.com . Hvis TV-en din ikke har en brukbar nettleser, kan du caste siden fra telefonen eller den bærbare datamaskinen med Chromecast eller AirPlay for å se den på storskjerm i stedet.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Åpne Silk Browser (forhåndsinstallert på Fire TV-enheter, eller gratis fra Amazon Appstore) og gå til freetvgarden.com . Velg et land eller en kategori og begynn å se – ingen abonnement eller ekstra app kreves.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Enhver moderne nettleser fungerer – bare besøk freetvgarden.com . I Chrome eller Edge vises et installasjonsikon i adressefeltet for å legge det til som en skrivebordsapp; ellers kjører den fint som en vanlig nettleserfane.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Det er ingen registrering, intet abonnement og ingen betaling på noe tidspunkt – bare velg et land eller en kanal og begynn å se.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Er tv.garden det samme som FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nei. Den originale tv.garden ble endret til Famelack i 2026 og bruker ikke lenger TV Garden-navnet. FreeTV Garden er et eget, uavhengig drevet nettsted - ikke tilknyttet Famelack eller den originale tv.garden .

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden de samme funksjonene som TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, pluss mer. FreeTV Garden har samme spin-the-globe, velg-et-land-opplevelse, sammen med 84+ språkfiltre, 25+ innholdskategorier, bilde-i-bilde-avspilling, favoritter du kan stjernemerke og se på nytt, en tilfeldig kanalknapp og ett-trykks installering rett fra Chrome eller Safari – ingen appbutikk nødvendig.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Har FreeTV Garden også radio og webkameraer?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden har også en Radio-fane med live-stasjoner på tvers av sjangere som Pop, Jazz og Talk, og en Webcam-fane med live kamerafeeder fra hele verden. Bytt fane over kloden.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hvordan er FreeTV Garden forskjellig fra radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden er et separat, uavhengig drevet prosjekt — ikke tilknyttet radio.garden . Den tilbyr et enklere, mer intuitivt grensesnitt med enklere navigering, og går utover radio med direktesendt TV og webkameraer innebygd i det samme gratis verktøyet med ett trykk.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Hva skjedde med den gamle FreeTool TV Garden-siden på Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Den ble relansert her. Siden som pleide å bo på freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden er det samme prosjektet, som nå kjører under sitt eget navn og domene: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ingen konto er nødvendig. FreeTV Garden ber ikke om en e-post, passord eller noen personlige detaljer for å se.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden kjører i en hvilken som helst moderne mobilnettleser på Android eller iPhone, og kan legges til på startskjermen din for tilgang med ett trykk (se installeringsdelen ovenfor).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaler er direktestrømmer hentet fra offentlige kringkastere, så noen går midlertidig frakoblet på grunn av kringkasterens egne serverproblemer. Prøv en annen kanal, eller kom tilbake senere – de fleste kommer tilbake innen noen få minutter til timer.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentlig tilgjengelige direktesendinger - primært fra iptv-org fellesskapskatalogen - og er ikke vert for eller lagrer noen videofiler i seg selv. Se avsnittet Juridisk og sikkerhet nedenfor for mer.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Flere spørsmål er besvart på hele {link1}.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden samler offentlig tilgjengelige direktesendinger fra gratis, offentlige kilder, inkludert iptv-org fellesskapskatalogen. Den er ikke vert for eller lagrer video- eller lydfiler, og krever ingen konto for å bruke.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Spørsmål, tilbakemeldinger eller en kanal å foreslå? E-post {link1} .

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Onko FreeTV Garden:ssa myös radiota ja verkkokameroita?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Kyllä. FreeTV Garden sisältää myös Radio-välilehden, jossa on live-asemia eri genreissä, kuten Pop, Jazz ja Talk, ja Webcam-välilehti, jossa on suoria kamerasyötteitä ympäri maailmaa. Vaihda välilehteä maapallon yläpuolella.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Miten FreeTV Garden eroaa radio.garden:sta?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden on erillinen, itsenäisesti suoritettava projekti - ei liity radio.garden -ohjelmaan. Se tarjoaa yksinkertaisemman, intuitiivisemman käyttöliittymän, jossa on helpompi navigoida, ja se on radiota pidemmälle rakennettu live-TV:n ja verkkokameroiden ansiosta, jotka on rakennettu samaan ilmaiseen yhden napautuksen työkaluun.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Mitä tapahtui vanhalle FreeTool TV Garden -sivulle Odoossa?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Täällä se käynnistettiin uudelleen. Sivu, joka asui aiemmin osoitteessa freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden, on sama projekti, joka toimii nyt omalla nimellä ja verkkotunnuksella: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Tiliä ei tarvita. FreeTV Garden ei pyydä sähköpostiosoitetta, salasanaa tai muita henkilökohtaisia ​​tietoja katsoakseen.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Kyllä — FreeTV Garden toimii missä tahansa nykyaikaisessa Android- tai iPhone-mobiiliselaimessa, ja se voidaan lisätä aloitusnäyttöön yhdellä napautuksella (katso yllä oleva asennusosio).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanavat ovat suoria lähetyksiä, jotka on hankittu julkisilta yleisradioyhtiöiltä, ​​joten osa siirtyy tilapäisesti offline-tilaan lähetystoiminnan harjoittajan omien palvelinongelmien vuoksi. Kokeile toista kanavaa tai palaa myöhemmin – useimmat palaavat muutaman minuutin tai tunnin kuluessa.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden kokoaa julkisesti saatavilla olevia suoratoistoja – ensisijaisesti iptv-org-yhteisöhakemistosta – eikä isännöi tai tallenna itse videotiedostoja. Katso lisätietoja alla olevasta Laki ja turvallisuus -osiosta.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Lisää kysymyksiä löytyy koko {link1} -sivustolta.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden kokoaa julkisesti saatavilla olevia suoratoistoja ilmaisista julkisista lähteistä, mukaan lukien yhteisön hakemistosta iptv-org. Se ei isännöi tai tallenna video- tai äänitiedostoja, eikä se vaadi tiliä käyttääkseen.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Γιατί ορισμένα κανάλια {countryName} αποθηκεύουν προσωρινά ή αποτυγχάνουν να φορτώσουν;

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Συνδέεστε απευθείας στον διακομιστή του ίδιου του τηλεοπτικού φορέα, επομένως η ταχύτητα και η αξιοπιστία εξαρτώνται από την υποδομή τους και όχι από τη δική μας. Εάν ένα κανάλι δεν φορτώνει, δοκιμάστε ένα άλλο από τη λίστα.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Μπορώ να παρακολουθώ {countryName} ειδησεογραφικά κανάλια ζωντανά στο τηλέφωνό μου;

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Ναι — το πρόγραμμα αναπαραγωγής λειτουργεί σε οποιοδήποτε πρόγραμμα περιήγησης τηλεφώνου χωρίς λήψη εφαρμογής. Απλώς ανοίξτε αυτήν τη σελίδα, πατήστε ένα κανάλι ειδήσεων και χρησιμοποιήστε την πλήρη οθόνη για την καλύτερη προβολή.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Είναι αυτός ο επίσημος ιστότοπος οποιουδήποτε ραδιοτηλεοπτικού φορέα {countryName};

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Όχι. FreeTV Garden είναι ένας ανεξάρτητος κατάλογος που συνδέεται με δημόσια διαθέσιμες ροές. Δεν συνδέεται, δεν υποστηρίζεται από, ούτε λειτουργεί από κανέναν ραδιοτηλεοπτικό φορέα που αναφέρεται σε αυτή τη σελίδα.

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroOne.translated: Η FreeTV Garden αυτή τη στιγμή παραθέτει {count} ζωντανά κανάλια {genreName} από όλο τον κόσμο, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του {names} — λαμβάνεται ζωντανά από τον δημόσιο κατάλογο καναλιών iptv-org και μπορεί να αναπαραχθεί άμεσα στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας χωρίς επιπλέον λογισμικό.

seo.genreIntroEmpty.en: {genreName} channels on FreeTV Garden are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. The exact channel list changes day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.genreIntroEmpty.translated: Τα κανάλια {genreName} στο FreeTV Garden ανασύρονται ζωντανά από τον δημόσιο κατάλογο καναλιών iptv-org και μπορούν να αναπαραχθούν άμεσα στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας χωρίς επιπλέον λογισμικό. Η ακριβής λίστα καναλιών αλλάζει μέρα με τη μέρα καθώς οι ροές συνεχίζονται και εκτός σύνδεσης.

seo.genreBrowseP.translated: Περιηγηθείτε στο {countriesLink} ή επιστρέψτε στο {homeLink} για να περιστρέψετε τη διαδραστική υδρόγειο σφαίρα.

seo.genreFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {genreName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.genreFaqFreeQ.translated: Είναι δωρεάν η παρακολούθηση {genreName} TV στο FreeTV Garden;

seo.genreFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.genreFaqFreeA.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει κανάλια Free-to-Air (FTA) που είναι δημόσια διαθέσιμα στο διαδίκτυο. Δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή, λογαριασμός ή εφαρμογή.

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {langName}-language TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeQ.translated: Είναι δωρεάν η παρακολούθηση {langName} σε γλώσσα FreeTV Garden;

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online, regardless of which country they broadcast from. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeA.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει κανάλια Free-to-Air (FTA) που είναι δημόσια διαθέσιμα στο διαδίκτυο, ανεξάρτητα από τη χώρα από την οποία εκπέμπουν. Δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή, λογαριασμός ή εφαρμογή.

seo.homeH1.en: Watch Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams From Anywhere in the World
seo.homeH1.translated: Παρακολουθήστε Δωρεάν Ζωντανή Τηλεόραση, Ραδιόφωνο και Webcams από οπουδήποτε στον κόσμο

seo.homeIntroTemplate.en: FreeTV Garden is a free streaming platform: spin the globe or pick a country to stream live TV, listen to live radio, and watch live webcams — no account, no app, no cost. {learnMoreLink} or see how we {alternativesLink}.
seo.homeIntroTemplate.translated: Το FreeTV Garden είναι μια δωρεάν πλατφόρμα ροής: γυρίστε τον κόσμο ή επιλέξτε μια χώρα για να μεταδώσετε ζωντανή τηλεόραση, να ακούσετε ζωντανό ραδιόφωνο και να παρακολουθήσετε ζωντανές κάμερες web — χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς εφαρμογή, χωρίς κόστος. {learnMoreLink} ή δείτε πώς {alternativesLink} .

seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.en: Is listening to {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionRadio.translated: Η ακρόαση του {channelName} στο FreeTV Garden είναι δωρεάν;

seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.en: Is watching {channelName} on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.faqFreeQuestionWebcam.translated: Είναι δωρεάν η παρακολούθηση {channelName} στο FreeTV Garden;

seo.faqFreeAnswer.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available streams. There is no subscription, account or app required.
seo.faqFreeAnswer.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει ροές που είναι διαθέσιμες στο κοινό. Δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή, λογαριασμός ή εφαρμογή.

seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.en: Is this the official station for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionRadio.translated: Είναι αυτός ο επίσημος σταθμός για {channelName};

seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.en: Is this the official webcam for {channelName}?
seo.faqOfficialQuestionWebcam.translated: Είναι αυτή η επίσημη κάμερα web για {channelName};

seo.faqOfficialAnswer.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by {channelName}.
seo.faqOfficialAnswer.translated: Όχι. FreeTV Garden είναι ένας ανεξάρτητος κατάλογος που συνδέεται με δημόσια διαθέσιμες ροές. Δεν συνδέεται, δεν υποστηρίζεται από, ούτε λειτουργεί από {channelName} .

seo.wantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse all {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.wantMoreTemplate.translated: Θέλετε περισσότερα; Περιηγηθείτε σε όλα τα {link} στο FreeTV Garden .

seo.satStationTitle.en: Listen to {stationName} Live — Satellite Radio | FreeTV Garden
seo.satStationTitle.translated: Ακούστε {stationName} Ζωντανά — Δορυφορικό Ραδιόφωνο | FreeTV Garden

seo.satStationDescription.en: Listen to {stationName} live on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — completely free, with no signup or subscription required.
seo.satStationDescription.translated: Ακούστε {stationName} ζωντανά στον διαδραστικό δορυφορικό ραδιόφωνο του FreeTV Garden — εντελώς δωρεάν, χωρίς να απαιτείται εγγραφή ή συνδρομή.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden
seo.satHubTitle.translated: Δορυφορικό Ραδιόφωνο - Ζωντανό Ραδιόφωνο Υδρόγειο | FreeTV Garden

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: Εξερευνήστε χιλιάδες ζωντανούς ραδιοφωνικούς σταθμούς από όλο τον κόσμο σε μια διαδραστική δορυφορική σφαίρα. Κάντε κλικ σε οποιονδήποτε σταθμό για να ακούσετε ζωντανά, δωρεάν.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: Το {stationName} είναι διαθέσιμο για δωρεάν ακρόαση στο διαδραστικό δορυφορικό ραδιόφωνο του FreeTV Garden — δεν απαιτείται εγγραφή, καμία εφαρμογή, δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή. Περιστρέψτε την υδρόγειο, βρείτε τον σταθμό και πατήστε αναπαραγωγή.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: Θέλετε περισσότερα; Περιηγηθείτε στο πλήρες {link} στο FreeTV Garden .

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Εξερευνήστε το ζωντανό ραδιόφωνο σε μια διαδραστική δορυφορική σφαίρα

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Περιστρέψτε μια φωτορεαλιστική τρισδιάστατη δορυφορική υδρόγειο και ανακαλύψτε χιλιάδες ζωντανούς ραδιοφωνικούς σταθμούς από όλο τον κόσμο, σχεδιασμένους από την πραγματική τους τοποθεσία μετάδοσης — δωρεάν, χωρίς εγγραφή.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Τα ζωντανά τηλεοπτικά κανάλια είναι οργανωμένα σε 25+ κατηγορίες — Ειδήσεις, Αθλητικά, Ταινίες, Μουσική, Παιδιά, Ντοκιμαντέρ και πολλά άλλα — ώστε να μπορείτε να περιηγηθείτε ανάλογα με το τι θέλετε να παρακολουθήσετε αντί να κάνετε κύλιση στα πάντα.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Χιλιάδες δωρεάν ζωντανοί ραδιοφωνικοί σταθμοί, οργανωμένοι ανά είδος — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies και άλλα. Περιηγηθείτε στο {link1} ή μεταβείτε στην καρτέλα Ραδιόφωνο πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Ζωντανές ροές κάμερας από πόλεις, ορόσημα, παραλίες και σημεία της φύσης σε όλο τον κόσμο — δωρεάν, χωρίς εγγραφή. Περιηγηθείτε στο {link1} ή μεταβείτε στην καρτέλα Webcam πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Κάθε κανάλι οργανώνεται επίσης κατά γλώσσα — 84+ συνολικά — ώστε να μπορείτε να βρείτε κάτι να παρακολουθήσετε στη γλώσσα που μιλάτε πραγματικά, όχι μόνο στη χώρα που περιηγείστε.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Κάθε ένα από τα εξώφυλλα των 200+ χωρών FreeTV Garden έχει τη δική του ειδική σελίδα καναλιών — επιλέξτε τη δική σας παρακάτω ή περιηγηθείτε ανά ήπειρο από την πλήρη λίστα.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: Το FreeTV Garden δεν βρίσκεται στο Play Store ή στο App Store — εγκαθίσταται απευθείας από το πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας, σε οποιαδήποτε συσκευή, με λίγα αγγίγματα.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Ανοίξτε το Chrome (ή άλλο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης που υποστηρίζει εγκαταστάσεις ιστού) και μεταβείτε στο freetvgarden.com . Αναζητήστε το εικονίδιο εγκατάστασης στη γραμμή διευθύνσεων ή ανοίξτε το μενού του προγράμματος περιήγησης και επιλέξτε "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη" / "Εγκατάσταση εφαρμογής". Το FreeTV Garden θα ανοίξει στη συνέχεια σε πλήρη οθόνη από την αρχική σας οθόνη, όπως μια εγγενής εφαρμογή, χωρίς να απαιτείται λήψη από το Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Ανοίξτε το freetvgarden.com στο Safari. Πατήστε το εικονίδιο Κοινή χρήση και μετά "Προσθήκη στην αρχική οθόνη". Αυτό προσθέτει ένα εικονίδιο εφαρμογής στο iPhone ή το iPad σας που εκκινεί τον ιστότοπο σε πλήρη οθόνη — δεν απαιτείται καταχώριση στο App Store και τίποτα που να ενημερώνεται συνεχώς.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Ανοίξτε το ενσωματωμένο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης της τηλεόρασής σας και μεταβείτε στο freetvgarden.com . Εάν η τηλεόρασή σας δεν διαθέτει πρόγραμμα περιήγησης που μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί, μεταδώστε τη σελίδα από το τηλέφωνο ή τον φορητό υπολογιστή σας χρησιμοποιώντας Chromecast ή AirPlay για να την παρακολουθήσετε στη μεγάλη οθόνη.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Ανοίξτε το Silk Browser (προεγκατεστημένο σε συσκευές Fire TV ή δωρεάν από το Amazon Appstore) και μεταβείτε στο freetvgarden.com . Επιλέξτε χώρα ή κατηγορία και ξεκινήστε την παρακολούθηση — δεν απαιτείται συνδρομή ή πρόσθετη εφαρμογή.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Κάθε σύγχρονο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης για επιτραπέζιους υπολογιστές λειτουργεί — απλώς επισκεφτείτε το freetvgarden.com. Στο Chrome ή στο Edge, εμφανίζεται ένα εικονίδιο εγκατάστασης στη γραμμή διευθύνσεων για να το προσθέσετε ως εφαρμογή επιφάνειας εργασίας. Διαφορετικά τρέχει μια χαρά ως κανονική καρτέλα προγράμματος περιήγησης.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Είναι πραγματικά το FreeTV Garden δωρεάν;

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ναί. Δεν υπάρχει καμία εγγραφή, καμία συνδρομή και καμία πληρωμή σε κανένα σημείο - απλώς επιλέξτε μια χώρα ή ένα κανάλι και ξεκινήστε να παρακολουθείτε.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Είναι το tv.garden ίδιο με το FreeTV Garden;

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Όχι. Το αρχικό tv.garden μετονομάστηκε σε Famelack το 2026 και δεν χρησιμοποιεί πλέον το όνομα TV Garden. Ο FreeTV Garden είναι ένας ξεχωριστός ιστότοπος που λειτουργεί ανεξάρτητα — δεν σχετίζεται με Famelack ή με τον αρχικό tv.garden .

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Το FreeTV Garden έχει τις ίδιες δυνατότητες με το TV Garden;

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ναι, συν περισσότερα. Το FreeTV Garden έχει την ίδια εμπειρία spin-the-globe, επιλογή χώρας, μαζί με 84+ φίλτρα γλώσσας, 25+ κατηγορίες περιεχομένου, αναπαραγωγή εικόνας σε εικόνα, αγαπημένα που μπορείτε να επισκέπτεστε με αστέρι και να επισκέπτεστε ξανά, ένα κουμπί τυχαίου καναλιού και εγκατάσταση με ένα πάτημα απευθείας από το Chrome ή το Safari — δεν χρειάζεται κατάστημα εφαρμογών.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Το FreeTV Garden διαθέτει επίσης ραδιόφωνο και webcam;

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ναί. Το FreeTV Garden διαθέτει επίσης μια καρτέλα Ραδιόφωνο με ζωντανούς σταθμούς σε διάφορα είδη όπως Pop, Jazz και Talk, και μια καρτέλα Webcam με ζωντανές ροές κάμερας από όλο τον κόσμο. Εναλλαγή καρτελών πάνω από την υδρόγειο.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Σε τι διαφέρει το FreeTV Garden από το radio.garden;

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: Το FreeTV Garden είναι ένα ξεχωριστό έργο που εκτελείται ανεξάρτητα — δεν σχετίζεται με radio.garden. Προσφέρει μια απλούστερη, πιο διαισθητική διεπαφή με ευκολότερη πλοήγηση και ξεπερνά το ραδιόφωνο με ζωντανή τηλεόραση και κάμερες web ενσωματωμένες στο ίδιο δωρεάν εργαλείο με ένα πάτημα.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Τι συνέβη με την παλιά σελίδα FreeTool TV Garden στο Odoo;

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ξανακυκλοφόρησε εδώ. Η σελίδα που κατοικούσε στο freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden είναι το ίδιο έργο, που τώρα εκτελείται με το δικό της όνομα και τομέα: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Δεν απαιτείται λογαριασμός. Το FreeTV Garden δεν ζητά email, κωδικό πρόσβασης ή προσωπικά στοιχεία για παρακολούθηση.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ναι — το FreeTV Garden εκτελείται σε οποιοδήποτε σύγχρονο πρόγραμμα περιήγησης για κινητά σε Android ή iPhone και μπορεί να προστεθεί στην αρχική οθόνη σας για πρόσβαση με ένα πάτημα (δείτε την ενότητα Εγκατάσταση παραπάνω).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Τα κανάλια είναι ζωντανές ροές που προέρχονται από δημόσιους ραδιοτηλεοπτικούς φορείς, επομένως ορισμένα τίθενται εκτός σύνδεσης προσωρινά λόγω προβλημάτων διακομιστή του ίδιου του ραδιοτηλεοπτικού φορέα. Δοκιμάστε άλλο κανάλι ή ελέγξτε ξανά αργότερα — τα περισσότερα επιστρέφουν μέσα σε λίγα λεπτά έως ώρες.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Είναι νόμιμες οι ροές για παρακολούθηση;

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει δημοσίως διαθέσιμες ζωντανές ροές — κυρίως από τον κατάλογο της κοινότητας iptv-org — και δεν φιλοξενεί ούτε αποθηκεύει τα ίδια αρχεία βίντεο. Δείτε την ενότητα Νομική και Ασφάλεια παρακάτω για περισσότερα.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Περισσότερες ερωτήσεις απαντώνται στο πλήρες {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: Το FreeTV Garden συγκεντρώνει δημόσια διαθέσιμες ζωντανές ροές από δωρεάν, δημόσιες πηγές, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του καταλόγου κοινότητας iptv-org. Δεν φιλοξενεί ούτε αποθηκεύει αρχεία βίντεο ή ήχου και δεν απαιτεί λογαριασμό για χρήση.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Jak sledovat {countryName} TV na vašem zařízení

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Ke sledování {countryName} kanálů není potřeba žádná aplikace ani účet. Tato stránka funguje přímo ve vašem prohlížeči na jakémkoli zařízení – stačí klepnout na kanál a stisknout tlačítko Přehrát.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Otevřete tuto stránku v Chromu, klepnutím na kanál {countryName} začněte sledovat a poté použijte tlačítko celé obrazovky pro nejlepší zobrazení. Pro rychlý přístup příště klepněte na nabídku Chrome a vyberte „Přidat na plochu“ a vytvořte ikonu podobnou aplikaci.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Otevřete tuto stránku v Safari a klepnutím na libovolný kanál {countryName} začněte okamžitě streamovat. Klepněte na ikonu Sdílet a vyberte „Přidat na domovskou obrazovku“ pro přístup jedním klepnutím bez stahování aplikace z App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Funguje jakýkoli moderní prohlížeč – Chrome, Safari, Firefox nebo Edge. Otevřete kanál {countryName} a použijte ikonu na celou obrazovku v přehrávači, abyste měli ze sledování TV bez rozptylování.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Otevřete tuto stránku ve vestavěném prohlížeči televizoru nebo ji odešlete z telefonu či notebooku pomocí Chromecastu nebo AirPlay a sledujte {countryName} kanály na velké obrazovce.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
