seo.satHubDescription.translated: استكشف الآلاف من محطات الراديو الحية من جميع أنحاء العالم على كرة أرضية تفاعلية عبر الأقمار الصناعية. انقر فوق أي محطة للاستماع مباشرة، مجانا.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} متاح للاستماع إليه مجانًا على راديو الأقمار الصناعية التفاعلي الخاص بـ FreeTV Garden - بدون اشتراك أو تطبيق أو اشتراك مطلوب. قم بتدوير الكرة الأرضية، وابحث عن المحطة، ثم اضغط على تشغيل.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: هل تريد المزيد؟ تصفح {link} بالكامل على FreeTV Garden .

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: استكشف البث الإذاعي المباشر على القمر الصناعي التفاعلي

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: قم بتدوير كرة فضائية ثلاثية الأبعاد واقعية واكتشف الآلاف من محطات الراديو المباشرة من جميع أنحاء العالم، والتي يتم رسمها حسب موقع البث الحقيقي الخاص بها - مجانًا، ولا يلزم الاشتراك.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: يتم تنظيم القنوات التلفزيونية المباشرة في أكثر من 25 فئة - الأخبار والرياضة والأفلام والموسيقى والأطفال والأفلام الوثائقية والمزيد - حتى تتمكن من التصفح حسب ما تريد مشاهدته بدلاً من التمرير عبر كل شيء.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: الآلاف من محطات الراديو الحية المجانية، منظمة حسب النوع - موسيقى البوب ​​والجاز والمحادثة والأخبار والأشياء القديمة والمزيد. تصفح {link1} أو قم بالتبديل إلى علامة التبويب "الراديو" أعلى الكرة الأرضية.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: تتغذى الكاميرا الحية من المدن والمعالم والشواطئ والمواقع الطبيعية في جميع أنحاء العالم - مجانًا وبدون اشتراك. تصفح {link1} أو قم بالتبديل إلى علامة تبويب كاميرا الويب أعلى الكرة الأرضية.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: يتم أيضًا تنظيم كل قناة حسب اللغة - أكثر من 84 قناة إجمالاً - حتى تتمكن من العثور على شيء لمشاهدته باللغة التي تتحدثها بالفعل، وليس فقط البلد الذي تتصفحه.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: كل واحدة من أكثر من 200 دولة من أغلفة FreeTV Garden لديها صفحة قنوات مخصصة خاصة بها - اختر قناتك أدناه، أو تصفح حسب القارة من القائمة الكاملة.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ليس موجودًا في Play Store أو App Store - بل يتم تثبيته مباشرةً من متصفحك بدلاً من ذلك، على أي جهاز، ببضع نقرات.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: افتح Chrome (أو متصفح آخر يدعم عمليات تثبيت الويب) وانتقل إلى freetvgarden.com . ابحث عن رمز التثبيت في شريط العناوين، أو افتح قائمة المتصفح واختر "إضافة إلى الشاشة الرئيسية" / "تثبيت التطبيق". سيتم بعد ذلك فتح FreeTV Garden بملء الشاشة من شاشتك الرئيسية، تمامًا مثل التطبيق الأصلي، دون الحاجة إلى التنزيل من متجر Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: افتح freetvgarden.com في Safari. اضغط على أيقونة المشاركة، ثم "إضافة إلى الشاشة الرئيسية". يؤدي هذا إلى إضافة أيقونة تطبيق إلى جهاز iPhone أو iPad الخاص بك الذي يقوم بتشغيل الموقع بملء الشاشة - لا حاجة إلى قائمة متجر التطبيقات، ولا يوجد شيء ليتم تحديثه.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: افتح المتصفح المدمج بجهاز التلفزيون وانتقل إلى freetvgarden.com . إذا لم يكن جهاز التلفزيون الخاص بك يحتوي على متصفح قابل للاستخدام، فقم بإرسال الصفحة من هاتفك أو الكمبيوتر المحمول باستخدام Chromecast أو AirPlay لمشاهدتها على الشاشة الكبيرة بدلاً من ذلك.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: افتح متصفح Silk (المثبت مسبقًا على أجهزة Fire TV، أو مجانًا من Amazon Appstore) وانتقل إلى freetvgarden.com . حدد بلدًا أو فئة وابدأ المشاهدة — لا يلزم الاشتراك أو تطبيق إضافي.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: يعمل أي متصفح حديث لسطح المكتب — ما عليك سوى زيارة freetvgarden.com . في Chrome أو Edge، يظهر رمز التثبيت في شريط العناوين لإضافته كتطبيق سطح مكتب؛ وإلا فإنه يعمل بشكل جيد كعلامة تبويب متصفح عادية.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: نعم. لا يوجد تسجيل ولا اشتراك ولا دفع في أي وقت - ما عليك سوى اختيار بلد أو قناة وبدء المشاهدة.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: هل tv.garden هو نفسه FreeTV Garden ؟

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: لا، تمت إعادة تسمية tv.garden الأصلية إلى Famelack في عام 2026 ولم تعد تستخدم اسم TV Garden. FreeTV Garden هو موقع منفصل يتم تشغيله بشكل مستقل — ولا ينتمي إلى Famelack أو tv.garden الأصلي.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: هل يتمتع FreeTV Garden بنفس ميزات TV Garden؟

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: نعم، بالإضافة إلى المزيد. يتمتع FreeTV Garden بنفس تجربة الدوران واختيار البلد، إلى جانب أكثر من 84 مرشح لغة، وأكثر من 25 فئة محتوى، وتشغيل صورة داخل صورة، والمفضلات التي يمكنك تمييزها بنجمة وإعادة زيارتها، وزر قناة عشوائي، والتثبيت بنقرة واحدة مباشرة من Chrome أو Safari - لا حاجة إلى متجر تطبيقات.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: هل يحتوي FreeTV Garden أيضًا على راديو وكاميرات ويب؟

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: نعم. يحتوي FreeTV Garden أيضًا على علامة تبويب "راديو" تحتوي على محطات مباشرة عبر الأنواع مثل موسيقى البوب ​​والجاز والحديث، وعلامة تبويب "كاميرا الويب" مع موجزات الكاميرا المباشرة من جميع أنحاء العالم. تبديل علامات التبويب فوق الكرة الأرضية.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: كيف يختلف FreeTV Garden عن radio.garden؟

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden هو مشروع منفصل يتم إدارته بشكل مستقل — وليس تابعًا لـ radio.garden . فهو يوفر واجهة أبسط وأكثر سهولة مع سهولة التنقل، ويتجاوز الراديو من خلال البث التلفزيوني المباشر وكاميرات الويب المدمجة في نفس الأداة المجانية التي تعمل بنقرة واحدة.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: ماذا حدث لصفحة FreeTool TV Garden القديمة على Odoo؟

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: تم إعادة إطلاقه هنا. الصفحة التي كانت موجودة في freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden هي نفس المشروع، وتعمل الآن تحت اسمها ونطاقها: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: ليس هناك حاجة إلى حساب. FreeTV Garden لا يطلب بريدًا إلكترونيًا أو كلمة مرور أو أي تفاصيل شخصية للمشاهدة.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: نعم — يعمل FreeTV Garden في أي متصفح جوال حديث على Android أو iPhone، ويمكن إضافته إلى شاشتك الرئيسية للوصول إليه بنقرة واحدة (راجع قسم التثبيت أعلاه).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: القنوات عبارة عن بث مباشر يتم الحصول عليه من جهات البث العامة، لذا فإن بعضها يصبح غير متصل بالإنترنت مؤقتًا بسبب مشكلات في خادم جهة البث. جرّب قناة أخرى، أو عاود التحقق لاحقًا — يعود معظمهم في غضون بضع دقائق إلى ساعات.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: يقوم FreeTV Garden بتجميع مجموعات البث المباشر المتاحة للعامة — بشكل أساسي من دليل مجتمع iptv-org — ولا يستضيف أو يخزن أي ملفات فيديو بنفسه. راجع قسم الشؤون القانونية والسلامة أدناه للمزيد.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: يتم الرد على المزيد من الأسئلة على {link1} بالكامل.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: يقوم FreeTV Garden بتجميع مجموعات البث المباشر المتاحة للعامة من المصادر العامة المجانية، بما في ذلك دليل مجتمع iptv-org. لا يستضيف أو يخزن أي ملفات فيديو أو صوت، ولا يتطلب حسابًا لاستخدامه.

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: חקור אלפי תחנות רדיו חיות מרחבי העולם על גבי גלובוס לווין אינטראקטיבי. לחץ על כל תחנה כדי להאזין בשידור חי, בחינם.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: חקור רדיו חי בגלובוס לווין אינטראקטיבי

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: סובב כדור לוויין תלת מימד פוטו-ריאליסטי וגלה אלפי תחנות רדיו בשידור חי מרחבי העולם, המתוכננים לפי מיקום השידור האמיתי שלהן - בחינם, ללא צורך בהרשמה.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: ערוצי טלוויזיה בשידור חי מאורגנים ב-25+ קטגוריות - חדשות, ספורט, סרטים, מוזיקה, ילדים, סרטים דוקומנטריים ועוד - כך שתוכלו לדפדף לפי מה שתרצו לצפות במקום לגלול בין הכל.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: אלפי תחנות רדיו חיות בחינם, מאורגנות לפי ז'אנר - פופ, ג'אז, דיבור, חדשות, עתיקות ועוד. עיין ב-{link1} או עבור ללשונית רדיו מעל הגלובוס.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: עדכוני מצלמות חיים מערים, ציוני דרך, חופים ומקומות טבע ברחבי העולם - בחינם, ללא הרשמה. עיין ב-{link1} או עבור ללשונית מצלמת אינטרנט מעל הגלובוס.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: כל ערוץ מאורגן גם לפי שפה - 84+ בסך הכל - כך שתוכל למצוא משהו לצפות בו בשפה שבה אתה מדבר בפועל, לא רק במדינה שבה אתה גולש.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: לכל אחת מ-200+ המדינות FreeTV Garden יש עמוד ערוצים ייעודי משלה - בחר את שלך למטה, או דפדף לפי יבשות מהרשימה המלאה.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden לא נמצא בחנות Play או App Store - הוא מותקן ישירות מהדפדפן שלך במקום זאת, בכל מכשיר, בכמה הקשות.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: פתח את Chrome (או דפדפן אחר התומך בהתקנות אינטרנט) ועבור אל freetvgarden.com . חפש את סמל ההתקנה בשורת הכתובת, או פתח את תפריט הדפדפן ובחר "הוסף למסך הבית" / "התקן אפליקציה". לאחר מכן FreeTV Garden ייפתח במסך מלא ממסך הבית שלך, בדיוק כמו אפליקציה מקורית, ללא צורך בהורדה מחנות Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: פתח את freetvgarden.com בספארי. הקש על סמל השיתוף ולאחר מכן על "הוסף למסך הבית". זה מוסיף סמל אפליקציה לאייפון או לאייפד שלך שמפעיל את האתר במסך מלא - אין צורך ברישום של App Store, ואין מה להתעדכן.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: פתח את הדפדפן המובנה של הטלוויזיה שלך ונווט אל freetvgarden.com . אם לטלוויזיה שלך אין דפדפן שמיש, העבר את הדף מהטלפון או המחשב הנייד שלך באמצעות Chromecast או AirPlay כדי לצפות במסך הגדול במקום זאת.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: פתח את דפדפן המשי (מותקן מראש במכשירי Fire TV, או בחינם מ-Amazon Appstore) ועבור אל freetvgarden.com. בחר מדינה או קטגוריה והתחל לצפות - אין צורך במנוי או באפליקציה נוספת.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: כל דפדפן שולחן עבודה מודרני עובד - פשוט בקר ב-freetvgarden.com. בכרום או ב-Edge, סמל התקנה מופיע בשורת הכתובת כדי להוסיף אותו כאפליקציה לשולחן העבודה; אחרת הוא פועל בסדר ככרטיסיית דפדפן רגילה.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: כֵּן. אין הרשמה, אין מנוי ואין תשלום בשום שלב - פשוט בחר מדינה או ערוץ והתחל לצפות.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: האם tv.garden זהה ל-FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: לא. ה-tv.garden המקורי מיתוג מחדש ל-Famelack בשנת 2026 ואינו משתמש יותר בשם ה-TV Garden. FreeTV Garden הוא אתר נפרד המנוהל באופן עצמאי - אינו מזוהה עם Famelack או tv.garden המקורי.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: האם ל-FreeTV Garden יש את אותן תכונות כמו TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: כן, ועוד. ל-FreeTV Garden יש את אותה חוויית סיבוב בעולם, לבחור מדינה, יחד עם 84+ מסנני שפה, 25+ קטגוריות תוכן, השמעת תמונה בתוך תמונה, מועדפים שתוכלו לככב ולבקר מחדש, כפתור ערוץ אקראי והתקנה בלחיצה אחת ישירות מ-Chrome או Safari - אין צורך בחנות אפליקציות.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: האם ל-FreeTV Garden יש גם רדיו ומצלמות אינטרנט?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: כֵּן. ל-FreeTV Garden יש גם כרטיסיית רדיו עם תחנות חיות בז'אנרים כמו פופ, ג'אז ודיבור, וכרטיסיית מצלמת אינטרנט עם עדכוני מצלמות חיים מרחבי העולם. החלף כרטיסיות מעל הגלובוס.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: במה שונה FreeTV Garden מradio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden הוא פרויקט נפרד המנוהל באופן עצמאי - אינו מזוהה עם radio.garden . הוא מציע ממשק פשוט ואינטואיטיבי יותר עם ניווט קל יותר, ועובר מעבר לרדיו עם טלוויזיה בשידור חי ומצלמות רשת המובנות באותו כלי חינמי בלחיצה אחת.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: מה קרה לדף FreeTool TV Garden הישן ב-Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: זה הושק מחדש כאן. העמוד שחי בעבר ב-freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden הוא אותו פרויקט, שפועל כעת תחת השם והדומיין שלו: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: אין צורך בחשבון. FreeTV Garden אינו מבקש אימייל, סיסמה או פרטים אישיים כלשהם לצפייה.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: כן - FreeTV Garden פועל בכל דפדפן נייד מודרני באנדרואיד או אייפון, וניתן להוסיף אותו למסך הבית שלך לגישה בלחיצה אחת (ראה סעיף ההתקנה למעלה).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ערוצים הם שידורים חיים שמקורם בגופי שידור ציבוריים, כך שחלקם יוצאים לא מקוון באופן זמני עקב בעיות בשרת של השדר עצמו. נסה ערוץ אחר, או בדוק שוב מאוחר יותר - רובם חוזרים תוך מספר דקות עד שעות.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden צובר זרמים חיים זמינים לציבור - בעיקר מספריית הקהילה iptv-org - ואינו מארח או מאחסן קבצי וידאו בעצמו. עיין בסעיף משפטי ובטיחות למטה למידע נוסף.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: שאלות נוספות נענות ב-{link1} המלא.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden אוסף זרמים חיים זמינים לציבור ממקורות ציבוריים בחינם, כולל ספריית הקהילה iptv-org. הוא אינו מארח או מאחסן קבצי וידאו או אודיו, ואינו מצריך חשבון לשימוש.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: שאלות, משוב או ערוץ להציע? דוא"ל {link1} .

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Herhangi bir modern tarayıcı çalışır - Chrome, Safari, Firefox veya Edge. Bir {countryName} kanalı açın ve dikkat dağıtıcı olmayan, TV benzeri bir izleme deneyimi için oynatıcıdaki tam ekran simgesini kullanın.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: {countryName} TV'yi FreeTV Garden'de izlemek ücretsiz mi?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Evet. FreeTV Garden, çevrimiçi olarak halka açık olan Ücretsiz Yayın (FTA) kanallarını bir araya getirir. İzlemek için herhangi bir abonelik, hesap veya uygulama gerekmez.

seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Doğrudan yayıncının kendi sunucusuna bağlanıyorsunuz, dolayısıyla hız ve güvenilirlik bizim altyapımıza değil, onların altyapısına bağlı. Bir kanal yüklenmezse listeden başka bir kanal deneyin.

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: Hayır. FreeTV Garden, herkese açık akışlara bağlanan bağımsız bir dizindir. Bu sayfada listelenen herhangi bir yayıncıya bağlı değildir, bu yayıncı tarafından desteklenmez veya işletilmez.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies ve daha fazlası gibi türe göre düzenlenmiş binlerce ücretsiz canlı radyo istasyonu. {link1}'a göz atın veya yerkürenin üzerindeki Radyo sekmesine geçin.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Dünya çapındaki şehirlerden, simge yapılardan, plajlardan ve doğa noktalarından canlı kamera yayınları - ücretsiz, kayıt gerektirmez. {link1}'a göz atın veya yerkürenin üzerindeki Web Kamerası sekmesine geçin.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Her kanal aynı zamanda dile göre de düzenlenmiştir (toplamda 84+) böylece yalnızca göz attığınız ülkede değil, gerçekte konuştuğunuz dilde de izleyecek bir şeyler bulabilirsiniz.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden'ın kapsadığı 200'den fazla ülkenin her birinin kendine özel kanal sayfaları vardır; aşağıdan istediğiniz kanalı seçin veya tam listeden kıtaya göre göz atın.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden Play Store'da veya App Store'da bulunmaz; bunun yerine doğrudan tarayıcınızdan, herhangi bir cihaza birkaç dokunuşla yüklenir.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome'u (veya web yüklemelerini destekleyen başka bir tarayıcıyı) açın ve freetvgarden.com adresine gidin. Adres çubuğunda yükleme simgesini arayın veya tarayıcı menüsünü açın ve "Ana Ekrana Ekle" / "Uygulamayı Yükle"yi seçin. FreeTV Garden daha sonra tıpkı yerel bir uygulama gibi, Play Store'dan indirmenize gerek kalmadan ana ekranınızdan tam ekran açılacaktır.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: freetvgarden.com'yi Safari'de açın. Paylaş simgesine ve ardından "Ana Ekrana Ekle"ye dokunun. Bu, iPhone veya iPad'inize siteyi tam ekran başlatan bir uygulama simgesi ekler; App Store listesine gerek yoktur ve güncellenmesi gereken hiçbir şey yoktur.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: TV'nizin yerleşik tarayıcısını açın ve freetvgarden.com adresine gidin. TV'nizin kullanışlı bir tarayıcısı yoksa sayfayı telefonunuzdan veya dizüstü bilgisayarınızdan Chromecast veya AirPlay kullanarak yayınlayarak büyük ekranda izleyin.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Silk Tarayıcıyı açın (Fire TV cihazlarına önceden yüklenmiştir veya Amazon Appstore'dan ücretsiz olarak gelir) ve freetvgarden.com adresine gidin. Bir ülke veya kategori seçin ve izlemeye başlayın; abonelik veya ek uygulama gerekmez.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Herhangi bir modern masaüstü tarayıcı çalışır; sadece freetvgarden.com adresini ziyaret edin. Chrome veya Edge'de, adres çubuğunda onu bir masaüstü uygulaması olarak eklemek için bir yükleme simgesi görünür; aksi takdirde normal bir tarayıcı sekmesi olarak sorunsuz çalışır.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Evet. Herhangi bir noktada kayıt, abonelik ve ödeme yok; yalnızca bir ülke veya kanal seçin ve izlemeye başlayın.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden ile FreeTV Garden aynı mı?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Hayır. Orijinal tv.garden, 2026'da Famelack olarak yeniden markalandı ve artık TV Garden adını kullanmıyor. FreeTV Garden ayrı, bağımsız olarak işletilen bir sitedir; Famelack veya orijinal tv.garden ile bağlantısı yoktur.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden TV Garden ile aynı özelliklere sahip mi?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Evet, artı daha fazlası. FreeTV Garden aynı dünyayı döndürme, bir ülke seçme deneyiminin yanı sıra 84'ten fazla dil filtresi, 25'ten fazla içerik kategorisi, resim içinde resim oynatma, yıldız ekleyip tekrar ziyaret edebileceğiniz favoriler, rastgele kanal düğmesi ve doğrudan Chrome veya Safari'den tek dokunuşla yükleme olanağına sahiptir; uygulama mağazasına gerek yoktur.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden'da radyo ve web kamerası da var mı?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Evet. FreeTV Garden ayrıca Pop, Jazz ve Talk gibi türlerdeki canlı istasyonların yer aldığı bir Radyo sekmesine ve dünyanın dört bir yanından canlı kamera yayınlarının yer aldığı bir Web Kamerası sekmesine sahiptir. Yerkürenin üzerindeki sekmeleri değiştirin.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden'nin radio.garden'den farkı nedir?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ayrı, bağımsız olarak yürütülen bir projedir; radio.garden ile bağlantısı yoktur. Daha kolay gezinme ile daha basit, daha sezgisel bir arayüz sunar ve aynı ücretsiz, tek dokunuşlu araçta yerleşik olarak canlı TV ve web kameraları ile radyonun ötesine geçer.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Odoo'daki eski FreeTool TV Garden sayfasına ne oldu?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Burada yeniden faaliyete geçti. Eskiden freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden'da yaşayan sayfa aynı projedir ve artık kendi adı ve alanı altında çalışmaktadır: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Hiçbir hesaba gerek yoktur. FreeTV Garden izlemek için e-posta, şifre veya herhangi bir kişisel ayrıntı istemez.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Evet — FreeTV Garden, Android veya iPhone'daki herhangi bir modern mobil tarayıcıda çalışır ve tek dokunuşla erişim için ana ekranınıza eklenebilir (yukarıdaki Kurulum bölümüne bakın).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanallar, kamuya açık yayıncılardan alınan canlı yayınlardır, dolayısıyla bazıları yayıncının kendi sunucu sorunları nedeniyle geçici olarak çevrimdışı olur. Başka bir kanalı deneyin veya daha sonra tekrar kontrol edin; çoğu birkaç dakika ila birkaç saat içinde geri gelir.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden, başta iptv-org topluluk dizininden olmak üzere herkese açık canlı yayınları bir araya getirir ve herhangi bir video dosyasını kendisi barındırmaz veya saklamaz. Daha fazla bilgi için aşağıdaki Yasal ve Güvenlik bölümüne bakın.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Daha fazla soru {link1}'un tamamında yanıtlanmıştır.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden, iptv-org topluluk dizini de dahil olmak üzere ücretsiz, herkese açık kaynaklardan gelen herkese açık canlı yayınları bir araya getirir. Herhangi bir video veya ses dosyasını barındırmaz veya saklamaz ve kullanmak için bir hesap gerektirmez.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: برای تماشای کانال های {countryName} به برنامه یا حسابی نیاز نیست. این صفحه مستقیماً در مرورگر شما در هر دستگاهی کار می کند - فقط کافی است روی یک کانال ضربه بزنید و پخش را فشار دهید.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: این صفحه را در Chrome باز کنید، روی یک کانال {countryName} ضربه بزنید تا شروع به تماشا کنید، سپس از دکمه تمام صفحه برای بهترین نمایش استفاده کنید. برای دسترسی سریع دفعه بعد، روی منوی Chrome ضربه بزنید و "افزودن به صفحه اصلی" را انتخاب کنید تا یک نماد برنامه مانند ایجاد کنید.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: این صفحه را در Safari باز کنید و روی هر کانال {countryName} ضربه بزنید تا پخش فوری شروع شود. روی نماد اشتراک‌گذاری ضربه بزنید و «افزودن به صفحه اصلی» را برای دسترسی با یک ضربه بدون دانلود برنامه از اپ استور انتخاب کنید.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: هر مرورگر مدرنی کار می کند - کروم، سافاری، فایرفاکس یا اج. یک کانال {countryName} را باز کنید و از نماد تمام صفحه در پخش‌کننده استفاده کنید تا تجربه تماشای تلویزیون‌مانند و بدون حواس‌پرتی داشته باشید.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: این صفحه را در مرورگر داخلی تلویزیون خود باز کنید، یا آن را از تلفن یا لپ تاپ خود با استفاده از Chromecast یا AirPlay پخش کنید تا کانال های {countryName} را در صفحه بزرگ تماشا کنید.

seo.countryAnotherH2.translated: کانال های کشور دیگری را می خواهید؟

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: به {homeLink} برگردید تا کره 3 بعدی تعاملی را بچرخانید و یکی از 200+ کشوری را که پشتیبانی می کنیم انتخاب کنید، یا {countriesLink} را مرور کنید.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: آیا تماشای تلویزیون {countryName} در FreeTV Garden رایگان است؟

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: بله FreeTV Garden کانال‌های Free-to-Air (FTA) را که به صورت آنلاین در دسترس عموم هستند، جمع‌آوری می‌کند. هیچ اشتراک، حساب یا برنامه ای برای تماشا لازم نیست.

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: در حال حاضر حدود {count} کانال زنده، شامل دسته‌هایی مانند {categories}.

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: با ادامه و آفلاین شدن جریان‌های عمومی، تعداد کانال‌ها اغلب تغییر می‌کند - ابزار بالا را باز کنید تا ببینید در حال حاضر چه چیزی زنده است.

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: این لیست به طور خودکار از فهرست عمومی iptv-org به روز می شود.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: چرا برخی کانال های {countryName} بافر می شوند یا بارگیری نمی شوند؟

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: شما مستقیماً به سرور خود پخش کننده متصل می شوید، بنابراین سرعت و قابلیت اطمینان به زیرساخت آنها بستگی دارد، نه زیرساخت ما. اگر یک کانال بارگیری نشد، کانال دیگری را از لیست امتحان کنید.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: آیا می توانم کانال های خبری {countryName} را به صورت زنده در تلفن خود تماشا کنم؟

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: بله - پخش کننده در هر مرورگر تلفن بدون دانلود برنامه کار می کند. کافی است این صفحه را باز کنید، روی یک کانال خبری ضربه بزنید و از تمام صفحه برای بهترین نمایش استفاده کنید.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: آیا این وب‌سایت رسمی هر پخش کننده {countryName} است؟

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: شماره FreeTV Garden یک فهرست راهنمای مستقل است که به جریان‌های در دسترس عموم پیوند می‌دهد. این به هیچ یک از پخش‌کننده‌های فهرست‌شده در این صفحه وابسته، تأیید یا اداره نمی‌شود.

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroOne.translated: FreeTV Garden در حال حاضر کانال {count} {genreName} زنده را از سرتاسر جهان فهرست می کند، از جمله {names} — به صورت زنده از فهرست راهنمای کانال عمومی iptv-org استخراج شده و فوراً در مرورگر شما بدون نرم افزار اضافی قابل پخش است.

seo.genreIntroMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channels from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.
seo.genreIntroMany.translated: FreeTV Garden در حال حاضر کانال های {count} {genreName} زنده را از سراسر جهان فهرست می کند، از جمله {names} — از فهرست راهنمای عمومی کانال iptv-org استخراج شده و فوراً در مرورگر شما بدون نرم افزار اضافی قابل پخش است.

seo.genreIntroEmpty.translated: کانال های {genreName} در FreeTV Garden به صورت زنده از فهرست راهنمای کانال عمومی iptv-org خارج می شوند و فوراً در مرورگر شما بدون نرم افزار اضافی قابل پخش هستند. با ادامه و آفلاین شدن پخش‌ها، فهرست دقیق کانال‌ها روز به روز تغییر می‌کند.

seo.spokenLanguageFaqFreeQ.translated: آیا تماشای تلویزیون {langName} به زبان FreeTV Garden رایگان است؟

seo.homeH1.en: Watch Free Live TV, Radio & Webcams From Anywhere in the World
seo.homeH1.translated: تلویزیون، رادیو و وب‌کم‌های زنده رایگان را از هر کجای دنیا تماشا کنید

seo.homeIntroTemplate.translated: FreeTV Garden یک پلت فرم پخش رایگان است: جهان را بچرخانید یا کشوری را برای پخش زنده تلویزیونی، گوش دادن به رادیو زنده و تماشای وب کم های زنده انتخاب کنید - بدون حساب، بدون برنامه، بدون هزینه. {learnMoreLink} یا ببینید چگونه ما {alternativesLink}.

seo.wantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse all {link} on FreeTV Garden.

seo.satStationTitle.en: Listen to {stationName} Live — Satellite Radio | FreeTV Garden
seo.satStationTitle.translated: گوش دادن به {stationName} زنده — رادیو ماهواره ای | FreeTV Garden

seo.satStationDescription.en: Listen to {stationName} live on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — completely free, with no signup or subscription required.
seo.satStationDescription.translated: به طور زنده به {stationName} در کره رادیویی تعاملی ماهواره ای FreeTV Garden گوش دهید — کاملاً رایگان، بدون نیاز به ثبت نام یا اشتراک.

seo.satHubTitle.en: Satellite Radio - Live Radio Globe | FreeTV Garden
seo.satHubTitle.translated: رادیو ماهواره ای - زنده رادیو گلوب | FreeTV Garden

seo.satHubDescription.en: Explore thousands of live radio stations from around the world on an interactive satellite globe. Click any station to listen live, free.
seo.satHubDescription.translated: هزاران ایستگاه رادیویی زنده از سراسر جهان را در یک کره ماهواره ای تعاملی کاوش کنید. برای گوش دادن زنده، رایگان، روی هر ایستگاهی کلیک کنید.

seo.satStationIntro.en: {stationName} is available to listen to for free on FreeTV Garden's interactive satellite radio globe — no signup, no app, no subscription required. Spin the globe, find the station, and press play.
seo.satStationIntro.translated: {stationName} برای گوش دادن رایگان در کره رادیویی ماهواره ای تعاملی FreeTV Garden در دسترس است — بدون ثبت نام، بدون برنامه، بدون اشتراک مورد نیاز. کره زمین را بچرخانید، ایستگاه را پیدا کنید و پخش را فشار دهید.

seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.en: Want more? Browse the full {link} on FreeTV Garden.
seo.satStationWantMoreTemplate.translated: بیشتر می خواهید؟ {link} کامل را در FreeTV Garden مرور کنید.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: رادیو زنده را در یک کره ماهواره ای تعاملی کاوش کنید

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: یک کره‌ی ماهواره‌ای سه‌بعدی واقع‌گرایانه را بچرخانید و هزاران ایستگاه رادیویی زنده از سراسر جهان را کشف کنید که بر اساس مکان پخش واقعی آنها ترسیم شده‌اند — رایگان، بدون نیاز به ثبت‌نام.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: کانال‌های تلویزیونی زنده در 25+ دسته سازمان‌دهی شده‌اند - اخبار، ورزش، فیلم، موسیقی، بچه‌ها، مستند و موارد دیگر - بنابراین می‌توانید به جای پیمایش در همه چیز، آنچه را که می‌خواهید تماشا کنید، مرور کنید.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: هزاران ایستگاه رادیویی زنده رایگان، سازمان‌دهی شده بر اساس ژانر - پاپ، جاز، گفتگو، اخبار، قدیمی‌ها و موارد دیگر. {link1} را مرور کنید یا به برگه رادیو در بالای کره زمین بروید.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: دوربین زنده از شهرها، مکان‌های دیدنی، سواحل و مکان‌های طبیعی در سراسر جهان تغذیه می‌شود — رایگان، بدون ثبت نام. {link1} را مرور کنید یا به برگه وب کم در بالای کره زمین بروید.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: هر کانال همچنین بر اساس زبان سازماندهی شده است - در مجموع بیش از 84 - بنابراین می توانید چیزی را برای تماشا به زبانی که در واقع صحبت می کنید پیدا کنید، نه فقط کشوری که در حال مرور آن هستید.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: هر یک از بیش از 200 کشور که پوشش می‌دهد FreeTV Garden صفحه اختصاصی کانال‌های مخصوص به خود را دارد - کانال خود را در زیر انتخاب کنید یا بر اساس قاره از فهرست کامل مرور کنید.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden در فروشگاه Play یا App Store نیست - در عوض مستقیماً از مرورگر شما، در هر دستگاهی، با چند ضربه نصب می‌شود.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome (یا مرورگر دیگری که از نصب های وب پشتیبانی می کند) را باز کنید و به freetvgarden.com بروید. به دنبال نماد نصب در نوار آدرس بگردید یا منوی مرورگر را باز کنید و "افزودن به صفحه اصلی" / "نصب برنامه" را انتخاب کنید. سپس FreeTV Garden از صفحه اصلی شما به صورت تمام صفحه باز می شود، درست مانند یک برنامه بومی، بدون نیاز به دانلود از فروشگاه Play.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: freetvgarden.com را در سافاری باز کنید. روی نماد اشتراک‌گذاری و سپس «افزودن به صفحه اصلی» ضربه بزنید. این یک نماد برنامه را به iPhone یا iPad شما اضافه می‌کند که سایت را به صورت تمام صفحه راه‌اندازی می‌کند - بدون نیاز به لیست App Store، و چیزی برای به‌روزرسانی نیست.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: مرورگر داخلی تلویزیون خود را باز کنید و به freetvgarden.com بروید. اگر تلویزیون شما یک مرورگر قابل استفاده ندارد، صفحه را از تلفن یا لپ تاپ خود با استفاده از Chromecast یا AirPlay برای تماشا در صفحه بزرگ پخش کنید.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: مرورگر Silk را باز کنید (از پیش نصب شده در دستگاه های Fire TV یا رایگان از فروشگاه Appstore آمازون) و به freetvgarden.com بروید. یک کشور یا دسته را انتخاب کنید و شروع به تماشا کنید - به اشتراک یا برنامه اضافی نیاز ندارید.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: هر مرورگر دسک‌تاپ مدرنی کار می‌کند — کافی است از freetvgarden.com دیدن کنید. در Chrome یا Edge، یک نماد نصب در نوار آدرس ظاهر می شود تا آن را به عنوان یک برنامه دسکتاپ اضافه کنید. در غیر این صورت به عنوان یک تب معمولی مرورگر به خوبی اجرا می شود.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: آیا FreeTV Garden واقعا رایگان است؟

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: بله هیچ ثبت نام، اشتراک و پرداختی در هیچ نقطه ای وجود ندارد - فقط یک کشور یا کانال را انتخاب کنید و شروع به تماشا کنید.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: آیا tv.garden همان FreeTV Garden است؟

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: خیر. tv.garden اصلی در سال 2026 به Famelack تغییر نام داد و دیگر از نام باغ تلویزیون استفاده نمی‌کند. FreeTV Garden یک سایت مجزا و مستقل است که به Famelack یا tv.garden اصلی وابسته نیست.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: آیا FreeTV Garden همان ویژگی‌های باغ تلویزیون را دارد؟

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: بله، به علاوه بیشتر. FreeTV Garden دارای همان تجربه چرخش جهان، انتخاب کشور، به همراه بیش از 84 فیلتر زبان، 25+ دسته محتوا، پخش تصویر در تصویر، موارد دلخواه که می‌توانید ستاره‌دار و مجدداً مشاهده کنید، یک دکمه کانال تصادفی و نصب با یک ضربه مستقیم از Chrome یا Safari - بدون نیاز به فروشگاه برنامه‌ای است.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: آیا FreeTV Garden رادیو و وب کم نیز دارد؟

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: بله FreeTV Garden همچنین دارای یک برگه رادیو با ایستگاه‌های زنده در ژانرهایی مانند پاپ، جاز، و تاک، و یک برگه وب‌کم با فیدهای دوربین زنده از سراسر جهان است. برگه ها را در بالای کره زمین تغییر دهید.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden چه تفاوتی با radio.garden دارد؟

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden یک پروژه مجزا و مستقل است که به radio.garden وابسته نیست. این رابط کاربری ساده‌تر و شهودی‌تر با ناوبری آسان‌تر ارائه می‌دهد و با تلویزیون زنده و وب‌کم‌های ساخته شده در همان ابزار رایگان و با یک ضربه، فراتر از رادیو است.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: چه اتفاقی برای صفحه FreeTool TV Garden قدیمی در Odoo افتاد؟

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: اینجا دوباره راه اندازی شد صفحه‌ای که قبلاً در freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden زندگی می‌کرد، همان پروژه است که اکنون با نام و دامنه خود اجرا می‌شود: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: آیا باید یک حساب کاربری ایجاد کنم؟

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: هیچ حساب کاربری لازم نیست. FreeTV Garden ایمیل، گذرواژه یا هیچ جزئیات شخصی برای تماشا نمی‌خواهد.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: بله - FreeTV Garden در هر مرورگر تلفن همراه مدرن در Android یا iPhone اجرا می‌شود و می‌تواند برای دسترسی با یک ضربه به صفحه اصلی شما اضافه شود (به بخش نصب در بالا مراجعه کنید).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: چرا کانالی «در دسترس نیست» را نشان می دهد؟

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: کانال‌ها جریان‌های زنده هستند که از پخش‌کننده‌های عمومی تهیه می‌شوند، بنابراین برخی از آنها به دلیل مشکلات سرور خود پخش‌کننده موقتاً آفلاین می‌شوند. کانال دیگری را امتحان کنید یا بعداً دوباره بررسی کنید - اکثر آنها ظرف چند دقیقه تا چند ساعت برمی‌گردند.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: آیا پخش جریانی برای تماشا قانونی است؟

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden جریان‌های زنده در دسترس عموم را جمع‌آوری می‌کند - عمدتاً از فهرست راهنمای انجمن iptv-org - و خود هیچ فایل ویدیویی را میزبان یا ذخیره نمی‌کند. برای اطلاعات بیشتر به بخش حقوقی و ایمنی زیر مراجعه کنید.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: به سوالات بیشتر در {link1} کامل پاسخ داده شده است.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden جریان‌های زنده در دسترس عموم را از منابع عمومی رایگان، از جمله فهرست راهنمای انجمن iptv-org جمع‌آوری می‌کند. هیچ فایل ویدیویی یا صوتی را میزبان یا ذخیره نمی کند و برای استفاده نیازی به حساب کاربری ندارد.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: سوال، بازخورد، یا کانالی برای پیشنهاد؟ ایمیل {link1}.

seo.faqHostQ.translated: FreeTV Garden weşanên vîdyoyê mêvandar dike an bar dike?

seo.faqHostA.en: No. FreeTV Garden does not host, upload or store any video files. It links to publicly available streams so you can watch them directly from the broadcaster's own servers.
seo.faqHostA.translated: Na FreeTV Garden tu pelên vîdyoyê mêvandar nake, bar dike an hilîne. Ew bi weşanên berdest ên gelemperî ve girêdide da ku hûn wan rasterast ji serverên weşangerê xwe temaşe bikin.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Meriv çawa li ser cîhaza xwe {countryName} TV-yê temaşe dike

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Ji bo temaşekirina kanalên {countryName} tu sepan an hesabek ne hewce ye. Ev rûpel rasterast di geroka we de li ser her amûrekê dixebite - tenê kanalek bikirtînin û lîstikê bikirtînin.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Vê rûpelê di Chrome-ê de vekin, kanalek {countryName} bikirtînin da ku dest bi temaşekirinê bikin, dûv re ji bo dîtina çêtirîn bişkojka tevahî ekranê bikar bînin. Ji bo gihîştina bilez carek din, li menuya Chrome-ê bikirtînin û "Li Ekrana Malê Zêde Bikin" hilbijêrin da ku îkonek mîna serîlêdanê biafirînin.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Vê rûpelê di Safari de vekin û li ser kanalek {countryName} bikirtînin da ku tavilê dest bi weşanê bikin. Li ser îkona Parvekirinê bikirtînin û ji bo gihîştina yek-tepekê bêyî dakêşana serîlêdanek ji App Store-ê "Têxe Ekrana Malê" hilbijêrin.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Her gerokek nûjen dixebite - Chrome, Safari, Firefox an Edge. Kanalek {countryName} vekin û ji bo tecrubeya temaşekirina TV-yê ya bêtevger, îkona tev-ekranê di lîstikvanê de bikar bînin.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Vê rûpelê di geroka xweya çêkirî ya TV-yê de vekin, an jî wê ji têlefon an laptopê bi karanîna Chromecast an AirPlay-ê biavêjin da ku kanalên {countryName} li ser ekrana mezin temaşe bikin.

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: Ma temaşekirina {countryName} TV-ya FreeTV Garden belaş e?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: Erê. FreeTV Garden kanalên Belaş-Air (FTA) yên ku bi gelemperî serhêl têne peyda kirin berhev dike. Ji bo temaşekirinê tu abonetî, hesab an sepanek hewce nake.

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: Çima hin kanalên {countryName} tampon dikin an bar nakin?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Hûn rasterast bi servera weşangerê ve girêdayî ne, ji ber vê yekê lez û pêbawerî bi binesaziya wan ve girêdayî ye, ne ya me. Ger kanalek bar neke, yekî din ji navnîşê biceribîne.

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: Ez dikarim li ser têlefona xwe kanalên {countryName} nûçeyên zindî temaşe bikim?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: Erê - lîstikvan li ser geroka têlefonê bêyî dakêşana serîlêdanê dixebite. Tenê vê rûpelê vekin, kanalek nûçeyan bikirtînin, û ji bo dîtina çêtirîn bi tevahî ekran bikar bînin.

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: Ma ev malpera fermî ya her {countryName} weşanê ye?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: No. FreeTV Garden pelrêçek serbixwe ye ku bi herikên berdest ên gelemperî ve girêdide. Ew ne girêdayî ye, ne ji hêla weşangerek ku li ser vê rûpelê hatî navnîş kirin ve hatî pejirandin, an jî tê xebitandin.

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Cîhanek satelîtê ya 3D-ya fotorealîst bizivirînin û bi hezaran stasyonên radyoyê yên zindî ji çaraliyê cîhanê, ku ji hêla cîhê weşana wan a rastîn ve hatine xêz kirin - belaş, bê qeydkirin hewce ne.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Bi hezaran stasyonên radyoya zindî yên belaş, ku ji hêla celebê ve têne organîze kirin - Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, û hêj bêtir. Li {link1}-ê bigerin an jî li tabloya Radyoyê ya li jorê dinyayê bigerin.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Kamera zindî ji bajaran, nîşangiran, peravê, û ciyên xwezayê li çaraliyê cîhanê - belaş, bê qeydkirin. Li {link1}-ê bigerin an jî biguhezînin tabloya Webkamera li jorê cîhanê.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Her kanal her weha ji hêla ziman ve hatî organîze kirin - bi tevahî 84+ - ji ber vê yekê hûn dikarin bi zimanê ku hûn bi rastî diaxivin, ne tenê bi welatê ku hûn lê digerin tiştek bibînin ku temaşe bikin.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Her yek ji 200+ welatan FreeTV Garden kaxez rûpela xwe ya taybet a kanalan heye - ya xwe li jêr hilbijêrin, an li gorî parzemînê ji navnîşa tevahî bigerin.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ne li Play Store an App Store-ê ye - ew rasterast ji geroka we, li ser her amûrekê, di çend tiliyan de saz dike.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chrome-ê (an gerokek din a ku sazkirinên webê piştgirî dike) vekin û biçin freetvgarden.com. Li îkona sazkirinê di barika navnîşanê de bigerin, an pêşeka gerokê vekin û "Add to Screen Home" / "Start App" hilbijêrin. Dûv re FreeTV Garden dê ji ekrana xweya malê tevahî-ekran veke, mîna serîlêdanek xwemalî, bêyî dakêşana ji Play Store-ê hewce bike.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: freetvgarden.com di Safari de veke. Li ser îkona Parvekirinê bikirtînin, dûv re "Li Ekrana Malê Zêde Bikin." Ev yek îkonek serîlêdanê li iPhone an iPad-a we zêde dike ku malperê bi tevahî-ekran dest pê dike - navnîşek App Store-ê hewce nake, û tiştek ku were nûve kirin tune.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Geroka TV-ya xwe ya çêkirî veke û biçe freetvgarden.com. Ger TV-ya we gerokek bikêr nîne, rûpelê ji têlefonê an laptopa xwe bi Chromecast an AirPlay bikar bînin da ku li şûna wê li ser ekrana mezin temaşe bikin.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Geroka Silk (ji berê li ser cîhazên Fire TV-yê hatî saz kirin, an belaş ji Amazon Appstore) vekin û biçin freetvgarden.com. Welatek an kategoriyek hilbijêrin û dest bi temaşekirinê bikin - abonetiyek an serîlêdana zêde hewce nake.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Her gerokek sermaseya nûjen dixebite - tenê biçin freetvgarden.com. Di Chrome an Edge de, îkonek sazkirinê di barika navnîşanê de xuya dike ku wê wekî serîlêdana sermaseyê zêde bike; Wekî din ew wekî tabloyek gerokek birêkûpêk baş dimeşe.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden bi rastî belaş e?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Erê. Qet nebe qeyd, abonetî û drav tune - tenê welatek an kanalek hilbijêrin û dest bi temaşekirinê bikin.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden wek FreeTV Garden ye?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Na. Ya orîjînal tv.garden di 2026-an de ji nû ve bû Famelack û êdî navê Baxçeyê TV-yê bikar nayîne. FreeTV Garden malperek veqetandî, serbixwe ye ku bi Famelack an ya orîjînal tv.garden ve girêdayî ne.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ma FreeTV Garden xwedî heman taybetmendiyên wekî TV Garden e?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Erê, bêtir bêtir. FreeTV Garden xwedî heman tecrubeya gerguhêzkirina cîhanê, hilbijarka welatekî, ligel 84+ fîlterên ziman, 25+ kategoriyên naverokê, leyiztina wêne-di-wêneyê, bijareyên ku hûn dikarin stêrk bikin û ji nû ve bişopînin, bişkokek kanalek rasthatî, û yek-tepek rasterast ji Chrome an Safari saz bikin - ne hewce ye dikana sepanê.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden radyo û kamerayên webê jî hene?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Erê. FreeTV Garden di heman demê de tabloyek Radyoyê ya bi qereqolên zindî li seranserê celebên mîna Pop, Jazz, û Talk, û tabloyek Webkamerê ya ku ji çaraliyê cîhanê veguhezîne kameraya zindî heye. Tabloyên li ser dinyayê biguherînin.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ji radio.garden çawa cuda ye?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden projeyek veqetandî, serbixwe ye ku bi radio.garden ve girêdayî ye. Ew bi navîgasyonek hêsantir ve navgînek sadetir, xwerûtir pêşkêşî dike, û bi TV-ya zindî û kamerayên webê yên ku di heman amûra belaş, yek-tap de hatine çêkirin, ji radyoyê wêdetir diçe.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Çi qewimî bi rûpela FreeTool TV Garden ya kevn li ser Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Li vir ji nû ve dest pê kir. Rûpelê ku berê li freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden dijiya heman proje ye, niha di bin nav û domaina xwe de dixebite: FreeTV Garden.

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Ma ez hewce dikim ku hesabek çêbikin?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Hesab ne hewce ye. FreeTV Garden ji bo temaşekirinê e-name, şîfre, an hûrguliyên kesane napirse.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: Ma ew li ser mobîl dixebite?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Erê — FreeTV Garden di her gerokek mobîl a nûjen de li ser Android an iPhone-ê dimeşe, û ji bo gihîştina yek-tepekê dikare li ser ekrana xweya malê were zêdekirin (li beşa Sazkirinê li jor binêre).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanal weşanên zindî ne ku ji weşanên giştî têne peyda kirin, ji ber vê yekê hin ji ber pirsgirêkên servera xweya weşanger bi demkî negirêdayî ne. Kanalek din biceribînin, an paşê paşde vegerînin - piranî di nav çend hûrdeman heya demjimêran de vedigerin.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden weşanên zindî yên berdest ên gelemperî - di serî de ji pelrêça civatê iptv-org berhev dike - û bi xwe tu pelên vîdyoyê nahewîne an hilîne. Ji bo bêtir li beşa Yasayî & Ewlehî li jêr binêrin.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Pirsên bêtir li ser {link1} tam têne bersivandin.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden weşanên zindî yên berdest ên gelemperî ji çavkaniyên belaş, gelemperî, tevî pelrêça civatê iptv-org berhev dike. Ew tu pelên vîdyoyî an dengî mêvandar nake an hilîne, û ji bo karanîna hesabek hewce nake.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Pirs, bersiv, an kanalek ku pêşniyar bikin? Email {link1}.

seo.hubHowToBody.en: No app or account is needed. This page works directly in your browser on any device — just tap a {nounSingular} and press play. On Android or iPhone, open this page in Chrome or Safari and use "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access next time. On desktop, any modern browser works.
seo.hubHowToBody.translated: Tu sepan an hesab ne hewce ye. Ev rûpel rasterast di geroka we de li ser her amûrekê dixebite - tenê {nounSingular} bikirtînin û lîstikê bikirtînin. Li ser Android an iPhone-ê, vê rûpelê di Chrome an Safari de vekin û ji bo gihandina yek-tepek carek din "Li Screen Home lê zêde bike" bikar bînin. Li ser sermaseyê, gerokek nûjen dixebite.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
