seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: ໝຸນດາວທຽມ 3D ທີ່ມີຮູບຖ່າຍຈິງ ແລະຄົ້ນພົບສະຖານີວິທະຍຸສົດນັບພັນແຫ່ງຈາກທົ່ວໂລກ, ວາງແຜນໂດຍສະຖານທີ່ອອກອາກາດຕົວຈິງຂອງເຂົາເຈົ້າ — ບໍ່ເສຍຄ່າ, ບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງສະໝັກ.

seo.homeLegalSafety.translated: ກົດໝາຍ ແລະຄວາມປອດໄພ

seo.homeTVCategories.translated: ໝວດໂທລະພາບ

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: ຊ່ອງໂທລະພາບສົດຖືກຈັດເປັນ 25+ ໝວດໝູ່ — ຂ່າວ, ກິລາ, ຮູບເງົາ, ເພງ, ເດັກ, ສາລະຄະດີ, ແລະອື່ນໆອີກ — ດັ່ງນັ້ນເຈົ້າສາມາດເລືອກເບິ່ງສິ່ງທີ່ທ່ານຕ້ອງການເບິ່ງແທນການເລື່ອນເບິ່ງທຸກຢ່າງ.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: ສະຖານີວິທະຍຸສົດຫຼາຍພັນແຫ່ງ, ຈັດຕາມປະເພດ — ປັອບ, ແຈສ, ສົນທະນາ, ຂ່າວ, ເກົ່າ, ແລະອື່ນໆອີກ. ເລືອກເບິ່ງ {link1} ຫຼືສະຫຼັບໄປແຖບວິທະຍຸຢູ່ເໜືອໜ່ວຍໂລກ.

seo.homeRadioIntroLink1.translated: ລາຍການວິທະຍຸສົດ

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: ຟີດກ້ອງສົດຈາກຕົວເມືອງ, ສະຖານທີ່ສຳຄັນ, ຫາດຊາຍ, ແລະສະຖານທີ່ທຳມະຊາດທົ່ວໂລກ — ບໍ່ເສຍຄ່າ, ບໍ່ມີການສະໝັກ. ເລືອກເບິ່ງ {link1} ຫຼືສະຫຼັບໄປແຖບເວັບແຄມຢູ່ເທິງໂລກ.

seo.homeWebcamsIntroLink1.translated: ໄດເລກະທໍລີ webcam ສົດ

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: ທຸກໆຊ່ອງຍັງຖືກຈັດເປັນພາສາ — ທັງໝົດ 84+ — ດັ່ງນັ້ນເຈົ້າສາມາດຊອກຫາສິ່ງທີ່ເບິ່ງໃນພາສາທີ່ເຈົ້າເວົ້າແທ້ໆ, ບໍ່ແມ່ນແຕ່ປະເທດທີ່ເຈົ້າກຳລັງຊອກຫາເທົ່ານັ້ນ.

seo.homeSeeLanguagesLink1.translated: ບັນຊີລາຍຊື່ພາສາ

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: ທຸກໆໜຶ່ງໃນ 200+ ປະເທດ FreeTV Garden ກວມເອົາມີໜ້າຊ່ອງສະເພາະຂອງຕົນເອງ — ເລືອກຂອງທ່ານຂ້າງລຸ່ມນີ້ ຫຼືເລືອກເບິ່ງຕາມທະວີບຈາກບັນຊີລາຍຊື່ເຕັມ.

seo.homeSeeCountriesLink1.translated: ບັນຊີລາຍຊື່ປະເທດ

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ບໍ່ໄດ້ຢູ່ໃນ Play Store ຫຼື App Store — ມັນຕິດຕັ້ງໂດຍກົງຈາກບຣາວເຊີຂອງເຈົ້າແທນ, ໃນອຸປະກອນໃດກໍໄດ້, ໂດຍການແຕະສອງສາມຄັ້ງ.

seo.homeSmartTV.translated: ໂທລະທັດອັດສະລິຍະ

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: ເປີດ Chrome (ຫຼືຕົວທ່ອງເວັບອື່ນທີ່ຮອງຮັບການຕິດຕັ້ງເວັບ) ແລະໄປທີ່ freetvgarden.com . ຊອກຫາໄອຄອນຕິດຕັ້ງຢູ່ໃນແຖບທີ່ຢູ່, ຫຼືເປີດເມນູຂອງຕົວທ່ອງເວັບແລະເລືອກ "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden ຈາກນັ້ນຈະເປີດແບບເຕັມຈໍຈາກໜ້າຈໍຫຼັກຂອງທ່ານ, ຄືກັບແອັບຕົ້ນສະບັບ, ໂດຍບໍ່ຕ້ອງການດາວໂຫຼດຈາກ Play Store.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: ເປີດ freetvgarden.com ໃນ Safari. ແຕະທີ່ໄອຄອນແບ່ງປັນ, ຈາກນັ້ນ "ເພີ່ມໃສ່ໜ້າຈໍຫຼັກ." ນີ້ຈະເປັນການເພີ່ມໄອຄອນແອັບໃສ່ iPhone ຫຼື iPad ຂອງທ່ານທີ່ເປີດເວັບໄຊແບບເຕັມຈໍ — ບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງມີລາຍການ App Store, ແລະບໍ່ມີຫຍັງໃຫ້ອັບເດດຕໍ່ໄປ.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: ເປີດ​ຕົວ​ທ່ອງ​ເວັບ​ໃນ​ຕົວ​ຂອງ​ໂທລະ​ພາບ​ຂອງ​ທ່ານ​ແລະ​ທ່ອງ​ໄປ​ຫາ freetvgarden.com . ຖ້າໂທລະພາບຂອງທ່ານບໍ່ມີບຣາວເຊີທີ່ສາມາດໃຊ້ໄດ້, ໃຫ້ຄາສທ໌ໜ້າຈາກໂທລະສັບ ຫຼືແລັບທັອບຂອງທ່ານໂດຍໃຊ້ Chromecast ຫຼື AirPlay ເພື່ອເບິ່ງໃນໜ້າຈໍໃຫຍ່ແທນ.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: ເປີດ Silk Browser (ຕິດຕັ້ງໄວ້ລ່ວງໜ້າໃນອຸປະກອນ Fire TV, ຫຼືບໍ່ເສຍຄ່າຈາກ Amazon Appstore) ແລະໄປທີ່ freetvgarden.com . ເລືອກປະເທດ ຫຼືໝວດໝູ່ ແລະເລີ່ມເບິ່ງ — ບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງສະໝັກສະມາຊິກ ຫຼືແອັບເພີ່ມເຕີມ.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: ທຸກ browser desktop ທີ່ທັນສະໄຫມເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ — ພຽງແຕ່ເຂົ້າໄປທີ່ freetvgarden.com . ໃນ Chrome ຫຼື Edge, ໄອຄອນຕິດຕັ້ງຈະປາກົດຢູ່ໃນແຖບທີ່ຢູ່ເພື່ອເພີ່ມມັນເປັນແອັບຯ desktop; ຖ້າບໍ່ດັ່ງນັ້ນມັນເຮັດວຽກໄດ້ດີເປັນແຖບຕົວທ່ອງເວັບປົກກະຕິ.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ຟຣີແທ້ບໍ?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. ບໍ່ມີການລົງທະບຽນ, ບໍ່ມີການສະໝັກໃຊ້ ແລະບໍ່ມີການຊຳລະເງິນໃນທຸກຈຸດ — ພຽງແຕ່ເລືອກປະເທດ ຫຼືຊ່ອງໃດໜຶ່ງແລ້ວເລີ່ມເບິ່ງ.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden ຄືກັນກັບ FreeTV Garden ບໍ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: ບໍ່. ຕົ້ນສະບັບ tv.garden ປ່ຽນຊື່ເປັນ Famelack ໃນປີ 2026 ແລະບໍ່ໄດ້ໃຊ້ຊື່ TV Garden ອີກຕໍ່ໄປ. FreeTV Garden ເປັນເວັບໄຊທີ່ແຍກອອກເປັນອິດສະລະ, ບໍ່ໄດ້ຂຶ້ນກັບ Famelack ຫຼືຕົ້ນສະບັບ tv.garden .

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ມີຄຸນສົມບັດດຽວກັນກັບ TV Garden ບໍ?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ, ແລະອື່ນໆອີກ. FreeTV Garden ມີປະສົບການແບບ spin-the-globe, ເລືອກປະເທດ, ພ້ອມກັບຕົວກອງພາສາ 84+, 25+ ໝວດໝູ່ເນື້ອຫາ, ການຫຼິ້ນແບບຮູບພາບໃນຮູບ, ລາຍການທີ່ມັກທີ່ເຈົ້າສາມາດຕິດດາວ ແລະເບິ່ງຄືນໄດ້, ປຸ່ມຊ່ອງແບບສຸ່ມ, ແລະຕິດຕັ້ງພຽງຄັ້ງດຽວຈາກ Chrome ຫຼື Safari — ບໍ່ຈໍາເປັນຕ້ອງມີຮ້ານ app.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ມີວິທະຍຸ ແລະເວັບແຄມບໍ?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. FreeTV Garden ຍັງມີແຖບວິທະຍຸທີ່ມີສະຖານີສົດໃນທົ່ວປະເພດເຊັ່ນ Pop, Jazz, ແລະ Talk, ແລະແຖບ Webcam ທີ່ມີຟີດກ້ອງຖ່າຍຮູບສົດຈາກທົ່ວໂລກ. ສະຫຼັບແຖບຂ້າງເທິງໂລກ.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ແຕກຕ່າງຈາກ radio.garden ແນວໃດ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ເປັນໂຄງການແຍກຕ່າງຫາກ, ດໍາເນີນການຢ່າງເປັນເອກະລາດ — ບໍ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງກັບ radio.garden . ມັນສະຫນອງການໂຕ້ຕອບທີ່ງ່າຍດາຍ, intuitive ຫຼາຍດ້ວຍການນໍາທາງທີ່ງ່າຍຂຶ້ນ, ແລະໄປໄກກວ່າວິທະຍຸທີ່ມີໂທລະພາບສົດແລະເວັບແຄມທີ່ສ້າງຂຶ້ນໃນເຄື່ອງມືຟຣີ, ແຕະດຽວ.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: ເກີດຫຍັງຂຶ້ນກັບໜ້າ FreeTool TV Garden ເກົ່າໃນ Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: ມັນໄດ້ເປີດຄືນໃໝ່ຢູ່ທີ່ນີ້. ໜ້າເວັບທີ່ເຄີຍອາໄສຢູ່ທີ່ freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden ແມ່ນໂຄງການດຽວກັນ, ຕອນນີ້ກຳລັງເຮັດວຽກພາຍໃຕ້ຊື່ ແລະໂດເມນຂອງຕົນເອງ: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: ຂ້ອຍຈໍາເປັນຕ້ອງສ້າງບັນຊີບໍ?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: ບໍ່ມີບັນຊີທີ່ຕ້ອງການ. FreeTV Garden ບໍ່ໄດ້ຖາມຫາອີເມວ, ລະຫັດຜ່ານ, ຫຼືລາຍລະອຽດສ່ວນຕົວໃດໆທີ່ຈະເບິ່ງ.

seo.homeFaq8Q.translated: ມັນເຮັດວຽກຢູ່ໃນມືຖືບໍ?

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ — FreeTV Garden ແລ່ນຢູ່ໃນທຸກບຣາວເຊີມືຖືທີ່ທັນສະໄໝຢູ່ໃນ Android ຫຼື iPhone, ແລະສາມາດເພີ່ມໃສ່ໜ້າຈໍຫຼັກຂອງທ່ານໄດ້ດ້ວຍການແຕະເທື່ອດຽວ (ເບິ່ງສ່ວນການຕິດຕັ້ງຂ້າງເທິງ).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: ເປັນຫຍັງຊ່ອງສະແດງວ່າ "ບໍ່ສາມາດໃຊ້ໄດ້"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ຊ່ອງແມ່ນການຖ່າຍທອດສົດທີ່ມາຈາກຜູ້ອອກອາກາດສາທາລະນະ, ສະນັ້ນບາງຊ່ອງຈະໄປອອບລາຍຊົ່ວຄາວເນື່ອງຈາກບັນຫາເຊີບເວີຂອງຜູ້ອອກອາກາດເອງ. ລອງຊ່ອງອື່ນ ຫຼືກວດເບິ່ງຄືນໃນພາຍຫຼັງ — ສ່ວນຫຼາຍຈະກັບຄືນມາພາຍໃນສອງສາມນາທີຫາຊົ່ວໂມງ.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: ການຖ່າຍທອດສົດຖືກກົດໝາຍໃຫ້ເບິ່ງບໍ?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ຮວບຮວມການຖ່າຍທອດສົດທີ່ມີໃຫ້ສາທາລະນະ — ຕົ້ນຕໍມາຈາກ iptv-org ລາຍຊື່ຊຸມຊົນ — ແລະບໍ່ໄດ້ເປັນເຈົ້າພາບ ຫຼືເກັບຮັກສາໄຟລ໌ວິດີໂອໃດໆເອງ. ເບິ່ງພາກສ່ວນກົດໝາຍ ແລະຄວາມປອດໄພທາງລຸ່ມສຳລັບຂໍ້ມູນເພີ່ມເຕີມ.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: ຄຳຖາມເພີ່ມເຕີມມີຄຳຕອບຢູ່ໃນເຕັມ {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden ຮວບຮວມການຖ່າຍທອດສົດສາທາລະນະຈາກແຫຼ່ງສາທາລະນະທີ່ບໍ່ເສຍຄ່າ, ລວມທັງລາຍຊື່ຊຸມຊົນ iptv-org. ມັນ​ບໍ່​ໄດ້​ເປັນ​ເຈົ້າ​ພາບ​ຫຼື​ເກັບ​ຮັກ​ສາ​ວິ​ດີ​ໂອ​ຫຼື​ໄຟລ​໌​ສຽງ​, ແລະ​ບໍ່​ຈໍາ​ເປັນ​ຕ້ອງ​ມີ​ບັນ​ຊີ​ເພື່ອ​ນໍາ​ໃຊ້​.

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ora ana ing Play Store utawa App Store — instal langsung saka browser, ing piranti apa wae, ing sawetara nutul.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Bukak Chrome (utawa browser liyane sing ndhukung panginstalan web) banjur pindhah menyang freetvgarden.com . Goleki lambang instal ing baris alamat, utawa bukak menu browser banjur pilih "Tambah menyang Layar Ngarep" / "Instal App." FreeTV Garden banjur bakal mbukak layar wutuh saka layar ngarep, kaya app native, tanpa download saka Play Store dibutuhake.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Bukak freetvgarden.com ing Safari. Tutul lambang Enggo bareng, banjur "Tambah menyang Layar Ngarep." Iki nambah lambang app menyang iPhone utawa iPad sing mbukak situs kanthi layar wutuh - ora ana dhaptar App Store sing dibutuhake, lan ora ana sing kudu dianyari.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Bukak browser sing dipasang ing TV banjur navigasi menyang freetvgarden.com . Yen TV sampeyan ora duwe browser sing bisa digunakake, copot kaca kasebut saka telpon utawa laptop nggunakake Chromecast utawa AirPlay kanggo nonton ing layar amba.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Bukak Browser Sutra (sing wis diinstal ing piranti Fire TV, utawa gratis saka Amazon Appstore) banjur pindhah menyang freetvgarden.com. Pilih negara utawa kategori lan miwiti nonton - ora perlu langganan utawa app tambahan.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Sembarang browser desktop modern bisa digunakake - bukak wae freetvgarden.com . Ing Chrome utawa Edge, lambang instal katon ing baris alamat kanggo ditambahake minangka aplikasi desktop; digunakake mlaku nggoleki minangka tab browser biasa.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: ya wis. Ora ana ndhaptar, ora ana langganan, lan ora ana pambayaran apa wae - mung pilih negara utawa saluran lan wiwiti nonton.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Apa tv.garden padha karo FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Ora tv.garden asli diganti dadi Famelack ing 2026 lan ora nganggo jeneng Taman TV maneh. FreeTV Garden punika kapisah, independen mbukak situs — ora afiliasi karo Famelack utawa asli tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Apa FreeTV Garden duwe fitur sing padha karo TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ya, ditambah liyane. FreeTV Garden duwe spin-the-globe, pengalaman pick-a-country sing padha, bebarengan karo 84+ saringan basa, 25+ kategori konten, puter maneh gambar ing gambar, favorit sing bisa dibintangi lan dibukak maneh, tombol saluran acak, lan siji-tutul nginstal langsung saka Chrome utawa Safari - ora perlu nyimpen app.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Apa FreeTV Garden uga duwe radio lan webcam?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: ya wis. FreeTV Garden uga nduweni tab Radio kanthi stasiun langsung ing genre kaya Pop, Jazz, lan Talk, lan tab Webcam kanthi feed kamera langsung saka sak ndonya. Ganti tab ing ndhuwur globe.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Kepiye FreeTV Garden beda karo radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden minangka proyek sing kapisah lan dikelola kanthi mandiri — ora ana gandhengane karo radio.garden. Nawakake prasaja, antarmuka luwih intuisi karo pandhu arah luwih gampang, lan ngluwihi radio karo TV urip lan webcams dibangun ing padha free , alat siji-tutul.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Apa sing kedadeyan karo kaca FreeTool TV Garden lawas ing Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Iki diluncurake maneh ing kene. Kaca sing biyen manggon ing freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden minangka proyek sing padha, saiki nganggo jeneng lan domain dhewe: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ora ana akun sing dibutuhake. FreeTV Garden ora njaluk email, sandhi, utawa rincian pribadhi kanggo ditonton.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ya — FreeTV Garden mlaku ing browser seluler modern ing Android utawa iPhone, lan bisa ditambahake menyang layar ngarep kanggo akses siji-tutul (ndeleng bagean Instal ing ndhuwur).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Saluran minangka aliran langsung sing asale saka penyiar umum, mula sawetara dadi offline sementara amarga masalah server penyiar kasebut. Coba saluran liyane, utawa mriksa maneh mengko - umume bali ing sawetara menit nganti jam.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden nglumpukake stream langsung sing kasedhiya kanggo umum - utamane saka direktori komunitas iptv-org - lan ora dadi tuan rumah utawa nyimpen file video dhewe. Deleng bagean Legal & Safety ing ngisor iki kanggo luwih akeh.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Pitakonan liyane dijawab kanthi lengkap {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden nglumpukake stream langsung sing kasedhiya kanggo umum saka sumber umum gratis, kalebu direktori komunitas iptv-org. Ora dadi tuan rumah utawa nyimpen file video utawa audio, lan ora mbutuhake akun kanggo digunakake.

seo.homeFireStick.translated: Fimbo ya Moto & Televisheni ya Moto

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Fungua Chrome (au kivinjari kingine kinachoauni usakinishaji wa wavuti) na uende kwa freetvgarden.com . Tafuta ikoni ya kusakinisha kwenye upau wa anwani, au fungua menyu ya kivinjari na uchague "Ongeza kwenye Skrini ya Nyumbani" / "Sakinisha Programu." FreeTV Garden kisha itafungua skrini nzima kutoka skrini yako ya kwanza, kama vile programu asilia, bila upakuaji kutoka kwenye Duka la Google Play unaohitajika.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Fungua freetvgarden.com katika Safari. Gonga aikoni ya Kushiriki, kisha "Ongeza kwenye Skrini ya Nyumbani." Hii huongeza aikoni ya programu kwenye iPhone au iPad yako inayozindua skrini nzima ya tovuti - hakuna uorodheshaji wa Duka la Programu unaohitajika, na hakuna cha kusasisha.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Fungua kivinjari kilichojengewa ndani cha TV yako na uende kwenye freetvgarden.com . Ikiwa TV yako haina kivinjari kinachoweza kutumika, tuma ukurasa kutoka kwa simu au kompyuta yako ya mkononi ukitumia Chromecast au AirPlay ili kutazama kwenye skrini kubwa badala yake.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Fungua Kivinjari cha Silk (kilichosakinishwa awali kwenye vifaa vya Fire TV, au bila malipo kutoka kwa Amazon Appstore) na uende kwa freetvgarden.com . Chagua nchi au aina na uanze kutazama - huhitaji usajili au programu ya ziada.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Kivinjari chochote cha kisasa cha eneo-kazi kinafanya kazi — tembelea tu freetvgarden.com . Katika Chrome au Edge, ikoni ya kusakinisha inaonekana kwenye upau wa anwani ili kuiongeza kama programu ya eneo-kazi; vinginevyo inakwenda vizuri kama kichupo cha kawaida cha kivinjari.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Je, FreeTV Garden ni bure kweli?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ndiyo. Hakuna kujisajili, hakuna usajili, na hakuna malipo wakati wowote - chagua nchi au kituo na uanze kutazama.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Je, tv.garden ni sawa na FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Hapana. tv.garden ya asili ilibadilishwa chapa kuwa Famelack mwaka wa 2026 na haitumii tena jina la TV Garden. FreeTV Garden ni tovuti tofauti, inayoendeshwa kwa kujitegemea — haihusiani na Famelack au tv.garden ya asili.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Je, FreeTV Garden ina vipengele sawa na TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ndiyo, pamoja na zaidi. FreeTV Garden ina uzoefu ule ule wa kuzunguka duniani, kuchagua nchi, pamoja na vichujio vya lugha 84+, kategoria 25+ za maudhui, uchezaji wa picha ndani ya picha, vipendwa unavyoweza kuweka nyota na kutazama upya, kitufe cha kituo bila mpangilio na usakinishe kwa kugusa mara moja moja kwa moja kutoka Chrome au Safari — huhitaji duka la programu.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Je, FreeTV Garden pia ina redio na kamera za wavuti?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ndiyo. FreeTV Garden pia ina kichupo cha Redio kilicho na stesheni za moja kwa moja katika aina mbalimbali kama vile Pop, Jazz, na Talk, na kichupo cha Kamera ya Wavuti kilicho na mipasho ya moja kwa moja ya kamera kutoka duniani kote. Badili vichupo juu ya ulimwengu.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ni tofauti gani na radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden ni mradi tofauti, unaoendeshwa kwa kujitegemea — hauhusiani na radio.garden . Inatoa kiolesura rahisi na angavu zaidi chenye urambazaji rahisi, na huenda zaidi ya redio iliyo na TV ya moja kwa moja na kamera za wavuti zilizoundwa ndani ya zana ile ile isiyolipishwa ya kugonga mara moja.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Ni nini kilifanyika kwa ukurasa wa FreeTool TV Garden wa zamani kwenye Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Imezinduliwa hapa. Ukurasa uliokuwa ukiishi freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden ni mradi ule ule, sasa unaendeshwa chini ya jina na kikoa chake: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Hakuna akaunti inahitajika. FreeTV Garden haiulizi barua pepe, nenosiri au maelezo yoyote ya kibinafsi ya kutazama.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ndiyo — FreeTV Garden inatumika katika kivinjari chochote cha kisasa cha simu kwenye Android au iPhone, na inaweza kuongezwa kwenye skrini yako ya nyumbani kwa ufikiaji wa mguso mmoja (angalia sehemu ya Kusakinisha hapo juu).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Vituo ni mitiririko ya moja kwa moja kutoka kwa watangazaji wa umma, kwa hivyo zingine huenda nje ya mtandao kwa muda kwa sababu ya maswala ya seva ya mtangazaji mwenyewe. Jaribu kituo kingine, au uangalie tena baadaye - nyingi zinarudi baada ya dakika chache hadi saa.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Je, mitiririko hiyo ni halali kutazama?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden hujumlisha mitiririko ya moja kwa moja inayopatikana kwa umma - haswa kutoka saraka ya jumuiya ya iptv-org - na haipangishi au kuhifadhi faili zozote za video zenyewe. Tazama sehemu ya Sheria na Usalama hapa chini kwa zaidi.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Maswali zaidi yatajibiwa kwenye {link1} kamili.

seo.homeFaqMoreLink1.translated: Ukurasa wa Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden hujumlisha mitiririko ya moja kwa moja inayopatikana kwa umma kutoka kwa vyanzo visivyolipishwa vya umma, ikijumuisha iptv-org saraka ya jumuiya. Haipangishi au kuhifadhi faili zozote za video au sauti, na haihitaji akaunti ili kutumia.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Je, una maswali, maoni au kituo cha kupendekeza? Barua pepe {link1} .

On Android or iPhone, open this page in Chrome or Safari and use "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access next time. On desktop, any modern browser works.

Kwenye Android au iPhone, fungua ukurasa huu katika Chrome au Safari na utumie "Ongeza kwenye Skrini ya Nyumbani" kwa ufikiaji wa mguso mmoja wakati ujao. Kwenye eneo-kazi, kivinjari chochote cha kisasa hufanya kazi.

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Ciyarwar kamara kai tsaye daga birane, alamun ƙasa, rairayin bakin teku, da wuraren yanayi a duk duniya - kyauta, babu rajista. Bincika {link1} ko canza zuwa shafin kyamarar yanar gizon da ke sama da duniya.

seo.homeWebcamsIntroLink1.translated: littafin adireshi na kamara kai tsaye

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Kowace tasha kuma ana shirya ta da harshe — 84+ gaba ɗaya - don haka za ku iya samun abin kallo a cikin yaren da kuke magana da gaske, ba kawai ƙasar da kuke lilo ba.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Kowane ɗayan ƙasashe 200+ FreeTV Garden yana da nasa shafi na tashoshi - zaɓi naku a ƙasa, ko bincika ta nahiya daga cikakken jeri.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden baya kan Play Store ko App Store - yana shigarwa kai tsaye daga burauzar ku maimakon, akan kowace na'ura, a cikin ƴan famfo.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Bude Chrome (ko wani mai bincike mai goyan bayan shigar yanar gizo) kuma je zuwa freetvgarden.com . Nemo gunkin shigarwa a mashaya adireshin, ko buɗe menu na mai bincike kuma zaɓi "Ƙara zuwa Fuskar allo" / "Shigar da App." Sannan FreeTV Garden zai bude cikakken allo daga allon gida, kamar app na asali, ba tare da zazzagewa daga Play Store da ake buƙata ba.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Bude freetvgarden.com a cikin Safari. Matsa alamar Share, sannan "Ƙara zuwa Fuskar allo." Wannan yana ƙara alamar ƙa'idar zuwa iPhone ko iPad ɗinku wanda ke ƙaddamar da cikakken allo na rukunin yanar gizon - babu jerin abubuwan Store ɗin da ake buƙata, kuma babu abin da za a ci gaba da sabuntawa.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Bude ginanniyar burauzar gidan talabijin ɗin ku kuma kewaya zuwa freetvgarden.com . Idan TV ɗin ku ba shi da mai lilo mai amfani, jefa shafin daga wayarku ko kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ta amfani da Chromecast ko AirPlay don kallo akan babban allo maimakon.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Bude Silk Browser (wanda aka riga aka shigar akan na'urorin TV na Wuta, ko kyauta daga Amazon Appstore) kuma je zuwa freetvgarden.com . Zaɓi ƙasa ko rukuni kuma fara kallo - babu biyan kuɗi ko ƙarin ƙa'idar da ake buƙata.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Duk wani mai binciken tebur na zamani yana aiki - kawai ziyarci freetvgarden.com . A cikin Chrome ko Edge, gunkin shigarwa yana bayyana a cikin adireshin adireshin don ƙara shi azaman aikace-aikacen tebur; in ba haka ba yana aiki lafiya azaman shafin burauza na yau da kullun.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Shin da gaske FreeTV Garden kyauta ne?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ee. Babu rajista, babu biyan kuɗi, kuma babu biyan kuɗi a kowane lokaci - kawai zaɓi ƙasa ko tashoshi kuma fara kallo.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Shin tv.garden daidai yake da FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: A'a. Asalin tv.garden an sake masa suna zuwa Famelack a 2026 kuma baya amfani da sunan Lambun TV. FreeTV Garden keɓantacce ne, rukunin yanar gizo mai zaman kansa - bashi da alaƙa da Famelack ko ainihin tv.garden .

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Shin FreeTV Garden yana da fasali iri ɗaya da Lambun TV?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ee, da ƙari. FreeTV Garden yana da nau'i-nau'i iri ɗaya, gwaninta na zaɓi-ƙasa, tare da masu tace harshe 84, nau'in abun ciki 25+, sake kunna hoto a cikin hoto, abubuwan da kuka fi so da za ku iya tauraro kuma ku sake duba, maɓallin tashar bazuwar, da kuma shigar da dannawa daya kai tsaye daga Chrome ko Safari - babu wani kantin sayar da kayan aiki da ake bukata.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Shin FreeTV Garden shima yana da radiyo da kyamarorin yanar gizo?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ee. FreeTV Garden Hakanan yana da shafin Rediyo tare da tashoshi kai tsaye a nau'ikan nau'ikan kamar Pop, Jazz, da Talk, da shafin kyamarar gidan yanar gizo tare da ciyarwar kamara kai tsaye daga ko'ina cikin duniya. Canja shafuka sama da duniya.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Ta yaya FreeTV Garden ya bambanta da radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden keɓantacce ne, aiki mai zaman kansa - ba shi da alaƙa da radio.garden . Yana ba da mafi sauƙi, mafi sauƙin dubawa tare da kewayawa mai sauƙi, kuma ya wuce rediyo tare da TV kai tsaye da kyamarar gidan yanar gizon da aka gina cikin kayan aikin tap ɗaya kyauta.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Me ya faru da tsohon shafin FreeTool TV Garden akan Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: An sake buɗe shi anan. Shafin da a da ke zama a freetool.odoo.com / tv-garden aikin iri daya ne, yanzu yana gudana a karkashin sunansa da yankinsa: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Babu asusu da ake bukata. FreeTV Garden baya neman imel, kalmar sirri, ko kowane bayanan sirri don kallo.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ee — FreeTV Garden yana gudana a cikin kowane burauzar wayar hannu ta zamani akan Android ko iPhone, kuma ana iya ƙarawa zuwa allon gida don samun dama ta taɓawa ɗaya (duba sashin shigarwa a sama).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Tashoshi rafi ne kai tsaye da aka samo su daga masu watsa shirye-shiryen jama'a, don haka wasu suna yin layi na ɗan lokaci saboda matsalar uwar garke. Gwada wata tashar, ko duba baya daga baya - yawancin suna dawowa cikin 'yan mintuna zuwa sa'o'i.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Shin rafukan sun halatta a kalla?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden yana tattara rafukan raye-raye na jama'a - da farko daga littafin al'umma na iptv-org - kuma baya ɗaukan ko adana duk fayilolin bidiyo da kanta. Duba sashin Shari'a & Tsaro a ƙasa don ƙarin.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Ana amsa ƙarin tambayoyi akan cikakken {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden yana tattara rafukan kai tsaye na jama'a daga kyauta, kafofin jama'a, gami da kundin adireshin al'umma iptv-org. Ba ya ɗaukar nauyin ko adana kowane bidiyo ko fayilolin mai jiwuwa, kuma baya buƙatar asusu don amfani da shi.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Tambayoyi, martani, ko tashar da za a ba da shawara? Imel {link1}.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Gbogbo ikanni tun jẹ ṣeto nipasẹ ede — 84+ lapapọ — nitorinaa o le wa nkan lati wo ni ede ti o sọ ni otitọ, kii ṣe orilẹ-ede ti o n lọ kiri nikan.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Gbogbo ọkan ninu awọn orilẹ-ede 200+ awọn ideri FreeTV Garden ni oju-iwe iyasọtọ tirẹ ti awọn ikanni — mu tirẹ ni isalẹ, tabi ṣawakiri nipasẹ kọnputa lati atokọ ni kikun.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ko si lori Play itaja tabi App Store — o fi sori ẹrọ taara lati ẹrọ aṣawakiri rẹ dipo, lori ẹrọ eyikeyi, ni awọn tẹ ni kia kia diẹ.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Ṣii Chrome (tabi ẹrọ aṣawakiri miiran ti o ṣe atilẹyin fifi sori ẹrọ wẹẹbu) ki o lọ si freetvgarden.com . Wa aami fifi sori ẹrọ ni ọpa adirẹsi, tabi ṣii akojọ ẹrọ aṣawakiri ki o yan “Fikun-un si Iboju ile” / “Fi Ohun elo sori ẹrọ.” FreeTV Garden yoo ṣii iboju kikun lati iboju ile rẹ, gẹgẹ bi ohun elo abinibi, laisi igbasilẹ lati Play itaja ti o nilo.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Ṣii freetvgarden.com ni Safari. Fọwọ ba aami Pin, lẹhinna "Fikun-un si Iboju ile." Eyi ṣafikun aami app si iPhone tabi iPad rẹ ti o ṣe ifilọlẹ oju opo wẹẹbu ni kikun iboju - ko si atokọ Ile itaja App ti o nilo, ko si nkankan lati tọju imudojuiwọn.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Ṣii ẹrọ aṣawakiri ti TV ti a ṣe sinu rẹ ki o lọ kiri si freetvgarden.com . Ti TV rẹ ko ba ni ẹrọ aṣawakiri to ṣee lo, sọ oju-iwe naa lati foonu rẹ tabi kọǹpútà alágbèéká nipa lilo Chromecast tabi AirPlay lati wo loju iboju nla dipo.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Ṣii ẹrọ aṣawakiri Silk (ti a fi sori ẹrọ tẹlẹ lori awọn ẹrọ TV Fire, tabi ofe lati Amazon Appstore) ki o lọ si freetvgarden.com . Yan orilẹ-ede kan tabi ẹka ki o bẹrẹ wiwo - ko si ṣiṣe alabapin tabi afikun ohun elo ti o nilo.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Eyikeyi aṣawakiri tabili ode oni n ṣiṣẹ — kan ṣabẹwo si freetvgarden.com . Ni Chrome tabi Edge, aami fifi sori ẹrọ han ninu ọpa adirẹsi lati ṣafikun bi ohun elo tabili kan; bibẹkọ ti o nṣiṣẹ itanran bi a deede kiri taabu.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Bẹẹni. Ko si iforukosile, ko si ṣiṣe alabapin, ko si si sisanwo ni eyikeyi aaye - kan gbe orilẹ-ede kan tabi ikanni ki o bẹrẹ wiwo.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ṣe tv.garden bakanna bi FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Rara. Atilẹba tv.garden ti tun jẹ ami iyasọtọ si Famelack ni ọdun 2026 ko si lo orukọ Ọgba TV mọ. FreeTV Garden jẹ aaye ti o yatọ, ti o nṣiṣẹ ni ominira - ko ni nkan ṣe pẹlu Famelack tabi atilẹba tv.garden.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ṣe FreeTV Garden ni awọn ẹya kanna bi Ọgbà TV?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Bẹẹni, pẹlu diẹ sii. FreeTV Garden ni o ni kanna spin-the-globe, mu-a-orilẹ-ede iriri, pẹlu 84+ ede Ajọ, 25+ akoonu isori, aworan-in-aworan Sisisẹsẹhin, awọn ayanfẹ ti o le star ki o si tun wo, a ID bọtini ikanni, ati ọkan-tẹ ni kia kia fi sori ẹrọ taara lati Chrome tabi Safari - ko si app itaja nilo.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Njẹ FreeTV Garden tun ni redio ati awọn kamera wẹẹbu?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Bẹẹni. FreeTV Garden tun ni taabu Redio pẹlu awọn ibudo ifiwe kaakiri awọn oriṣi bii Pop, Jazz, ati Talk, ati taabu kamera wẹẹbu kan pẹlu awọn ifunni kamẹra laaye lati kakiri agbaye. Yipada awọn taabu loke agbaiye.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Bawo ni FreeTV Garden ṣe yatọ si radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden jẹ iṣẹ akanṣe ọtọtọ, ṣiṣe ni ominira - ko ni ibatan pẹlu radio.garden. O funni ni wiwo ti o rọrun, ti oye diẹ sii pẹlu lilọ kiri rọrun, ati pe o kọja redio pẹlu TV laaye ati awọn kamera wẹẹbu ti a ṣe sinu ọfẹ kanna, ohun elo-tẹ ni kia kia.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kini o ṣẹlẹ si oju-iwe FreeTool TV Garden atijọ lori Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: O tun bẹrẹ nibi. Oju-iwe ti o n gbe ni freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden jẹ iṣẹ akanna kan, ti nṣiṣẹ ni bayi labẹ orukọ tirẹ ati agbegbe: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Ṣe Mo nilo lati ṣẹda akọọlẹ kan?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ko si akọọlẹ ti o nilo. FreeTV Garden ko beere fun imeeli, ọrọ igbaniwọle, tabi awọn alaye ti ara ẹni eyikeyi lati wo.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Bẹẹni — FreeTV Garden nṣiṣẹ ni eyikeyi ẹrọ aṣawakiri alagbeka igbalode lori Android tabi iPhone, ati pe o le ṣafikun si iboju ile rẹ fun iraye si ẹyọkan (wo apakan Fi sori ẹrọ loke).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Kini idi ti ikanni kan nfihan "Ko si"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Awọn ikanni jẹ ṣiṣan ifiwe ti o jade lati ọdọ awọn olugbohunsafefe ti gbogbo eniyan, nitorinaa diẹ ninu aisinipo fun igba diẹ nitori awọn ọran olupin ti olugbohunsafefe tirẹ. Gbiyanju ikanni miiran, tabi ṣayẹwo nigbamii - pupọ julọ wa pada laarin iṣẹju diẹ si awọn wakati.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Ṣe awọn ṣiṣan naa jẹ ofin lati wo bi?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ṣajọpọ awọn ṣiṣan ifiwe ti o wa ni gbangba - nipataki lati itọsọna agbegbe iptv-org - ko si gbalejo tabi tọju eyikeyi awọn faili fidio funrararẹ. Wo Ofin & Aabo apakan ni isalẹ fun diẹ sii.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Awọn ibeere diẹ sii ni idahun ni kikun {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden ṣajọpọ awọn ṣiṣan ifiwe ti o wa ni gbangba lati ọfẹ, awọn orisun ti gbogbo eniyan, pẹlu itọsọna agbegbe iptv-org. Ko gbalejo tabi tọju eyikeyi fidio tabi awọn faili ohun, ati pe ko nilo akọọlẹ kan lati lo.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Otu esi ele {countryName} TV na ngwaọrụ gị

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Enweghị ngwa ma ọ bụ akaụntụ achọrọ iji lelee ọwa {countryName}. Ibe a na-arụ ọrụ ozugbo na ihe nchọgharị gị na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla - naanị kpatụ ọwa wee pịa play.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Mepee ibe a na Chrome, kpatụ ọwa {countryName} ka ịmalite ikiri, wee jiri bọtịnụ ihuenyo zuru ezu maka nlele kacha mma. Maka ịnweta ngwa ngwa oge ọzọ, kpatụ menu Chrome wee họrọ "Tinye na ihuenyo ụlọ" ka ịmepụta akara ngosi ngwa.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Mepee ibe a na Safari wee pịa ọwa {countryName} ọ bụla ka ịmalite mgbasa ozi ozugbo. Kpatụ akara ngosi nkekọrịta wee họrọ "Tinye na ihuenyo ụlọ" maka ịnweta otu ọpịpị na-ebudataghị ngwa site na Ụlọ Ahịa App.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Ihe nchọgharị ọgbara ọhụrụ ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ - Chrome, Safari, Firefox ma ọ bụ Edge. Mepee ọwa {countryName} wee jiri akara ngosi ihuenyo zuru oke n'ime ihe ọkpụkpọ maka ihe ndọpụ uche, ahụmịhe nlele dịka TV.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Mepee ibe a n'ime ihe nchọgharị arụnyere na TV gị, ma ọ bụ tụba ya na ekwentị gị ma ọ bụ laptọọpụ site na iji Chromecast ma ọ bụ AirPlay iji lelee ọwa {countryName} na nnukwu ihuenyo.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Mepee Chrome (ma ọ bụ ihe nchọgharị ọzọ na-akwado nrụnye webụ) wee gaa na freetvgarden.com . Chọọ akara ngosi wụnye na ebe adreesị, ma ọ bụ mepee menu ihe nchọgharị wee họrọ "Tinye na ihuenyo ụlọ" / "Wụnye ngwa." FreeTV Garden ga-emeghekwa ihuenyo zuru oke site na ihuenyo ụlọ gị, dị ka ngwa ala, na-enweghị nbudata na Play Store achọrọ.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Mepee freetvgarden.com na Safari. Kpatụ akara ngosi Share, wee "Tinye na ihuenyo ụlọ." Nke a na-agbakwụnye akara ngosi ngwa na iPhone ma ọ bụ iPad gị nke na-ebupụta saịtị ahụ na ihuenyo zuru ezu - enweghị ndepụta Storelọ Ahịa Ngwa achọrọ, ọ nweghịkwa ihe ọ bụla ị ga-emelite.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Mepee ihe nchọgharị arụnyere na TV gị wee gaa na freetvgarden.com . Ọ bụrụ na TV gị enweghị ihe nchọgharị a na-eji eme ihe, were Chromecast ma ọ bụ AirPlay tụpụ ibe ahụ na ekwentị gị ma ọ bụ laptọọpụ gị na-ekiri na nnukwu ihuenyo kama.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Mepee ihe nchọgharị silk (arụnyere ya na ngwa TV Fire, ma ọ bụ na Amazon Appstore) wee gaa na freetvgarden.com . Họrọ obodo ma ọ bụ otu wee malite ikiri - enweghị ndenye aha ma ọ bụ ngwa mgbakwunye achọrọ.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Ihe nchọgharị desktọpụ ọ bụla ọgbara ọhụrụ na-arụ ọrụ - naanị gaa na freetvgarden.com . Na Chrome ma ọ bụ Edge, akara ngosi awụnyere na-egosi na ogwe adreesị iji tinye ya dị ka ngwa desktọpụ; ma ọ bụghị ya, ọ na-aga nke ọma dị ka taabụ nchọgharị mgbe niile.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ọ nwere n'efu n'ezie?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ee. Enweghị ndebanye aha, enweghị ndenye aha, na enweghị ụgwọ ọ bụla - naanị họrọ obodo ma ọ bụ ọwa wee malite ikiri.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ọ bụ tv.garden dị ka FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Mba. tv.garden izizi ahagharịrị ka ọ bụrụ Famelack na 2026 ma anaghịzi eji aha Ogige TV. FreeTV Garden bụ saịtị dị iche, na-agba ọsọ n'onwe ya - enweghị njikọ na Famelack ma ọ bụ tv.garden mbụ.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden nwere otu atụmatụ dị ka Ogige TV?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ee, gbakwunyere ọzọ. FreeTV Garden nwere otu spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, yana 84+ asụsụ nzacha, 25+ ọdịnaya edemede, picture na-ese foto, ọkacha mmasị ị nwere ike kpakpando na gagharịa, a random-ọwa bọtịnụ, na otu-pịa wụnye ozugbo site Chrome ma ọ bụ Safari-ọ dịghị ngwa a chọrọ.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: FreeTV Garden nwekwara redio na kamera weebụ?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ee. FreeTV Garden nwekwara taabụ Redio nwere ọdụ dị ndụ n'ofe ụdị dị ka Pop, Jazz, na Talk, yana taabụ kamera nwere ntanetịime igwefoto dị ndụ sitere na gburugburu ụwa. Gbanwee taabụ n'elu ụwa.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Kedu ka FreeTV Garden si dị iche na radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden bụ ọrụ dị iche, na-arụ ọrụ onwe ya - enweghị mmekọ na radio.garden. Ọ na-enye interface dị mfe, nghọta karịa nke nwere igodo dị mfe, ma gafere redio nwere TV dị ndụ na kamera weebụ arụnyere n'ime otu ngwaọrụ efu, otu mgbata.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kedu ihe mere ibe FreeTool TV Garden ochie na Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Ọ maliteghachiri ebe a. Ibe nke na-ebibu na freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden bụ otu ọrụ, na-arụ ugbu a n'okpuru aha na ngalaba ya: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Enweghị akaụntụ achọrọ. FreeTV Garden anaghị arịọ maka email, paswọọdụ, ma ọ bụ nkọwa nkeonwe ọ bụla ị ga-ekiri.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ee - FreeTV Garden na-agba na ihe nchọgharị mkpanaka ọgbara ọhụrụ ọ bụla na gam akporo ma ọ bụ iPhone, enwere ike itinye ya na ihuenyo ụlọ gị maka ịnweta otu mgbata (lee ngalaba ntinye n'elu).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Kedu ihe kpatara ọwa na-egosi "Ọ dịghị"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Ọwa bụ iyi ndụ sitere n'aka ndị mgbasa ozi ọha, yabụ ụfọdụ na-aga n'ịntanetị nwa oge n'ihi ihe nkesa nke onye mgbasa ozi nwere. Gbalịa ọwa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ lelee azụ ma emechaa - ọtụtụ na-alọta n'ime nkeji ole na ole ruo awa.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: iyi ndị a nwere iwu ikiri?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden na-achịkọta iyi egwu dị n'ihu ọha - nke sitere na ndekọ obodo iptv-org - na anaghị akwado ma ọ bụ chekwaa faịlụ vidiyo ọ bụla n'onwe ya. Lee ngalaba Iwu & Nchekwa n'okpuru maka ihe ndị ọzọ.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: A zara ajụjụ ndị ọzọ na {link1} zuru ezu.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden na-achịkọta iyi egwu dị n'ihu ọha sitere na isi mmalite ọha, gụnyere akwụkwọ ndekọ aha obodo iptv-org. Ọ naghị akwado ma ọ bụ chekwaa vidiyo ma ọ bụ faịlụ ọdịyo ọ bụla, ọ chọghịkwa akaụntụ iji.

seo.homeContactP.translated: Ajụjụ, nzaghachi, ma ọ bụ ọwa ịtụ aro? Email {link1}.

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Uyibuka kanjani i-TV ye-{countryName} kudivayisi yakho

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Alukho uhlelo lokusebenza noma i-akhawunti edingekayo ukuze ubukele iziteshi ezingu-{countryName}. Leli khasi lisebenza ngqo esipheqululini sakho kunoma iyiphi idivayisi - vele uthephe isiteshi bese ucindezela dlala.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Vula leli khasi ku-Chrome, thepha {countryName} isiteshi ukuze uqale ukubuka, bese usebenzisa inkinobho yesikrini esigcwele ukuze ubuke kahle. Ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okusheshayo ngokuzayo, thepha imenyu ye-Chrome uphinde ukhethe okuthi "Engeza Esikrinini Sasekhaya" ukuze udale isithonjana esifana nohlelo lokusebenza.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Vula leli khasi ku-Safari bese uthepha noma yisiphi isiteshi {countryName} ukuze uqale ukusakaza-bukhoma ngokushesha. Thepha isithonjana sokwabelana bese ukhetha okuthi "Engeza Esikrinini Sasekhaya" ukuze ufinyelele ngokuthepha okukodwa ngaphandle kokulanda uhlelo lokusebenza ku-App Store.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Noma yisiphi isiphequluli sesimanje siyasebenza - i-Chrome, iSafari, iFirefox noma i-Edge. Vula {countryName} isiteshi futhi usebenzise isithonjana sesikrini esigcwele kusidlali ukuze uthole ukuzizwisa okungenasiphazamiso, okufana ne-TV.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Vula leli khasi esipheqululini esakhelwe ngaphakathi se-TV yakho, noma uyisakaze kusukela kufoni yakho noma ikhompuyutha ephathekayo usebenzisa i-Chromecast noma i-AirPlay ukuze ubuke {countryName} iziteshi esikrinini esikhulu.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Phenya iglobhu yesathelayithi ye-3D enezithombe futhi uthole izinkulungwane zeziteshi zomsakazo ezibukhoma emhlabeni wonke, ezihlelwe ngendawo yazo yokusakaza yangempela - mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa okudingekayo.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Iziteshi ze-TV ezibukhoma zihlelwe zaba izigaba ezingu-25+ — Izindaba, Ezemidlalo, Amamuvi, Umculo, Izingane, Idokhumentari, nokuningi — ukuze ukwazi ukuphequlula ngalokho ofuna ukukubuka esikhundleni sokuskrola kuyo yonke into.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Izinkulungwane zeziteshi zomsakazo ezibukhoma zamahhala, ezihlelwe uhlobo - I-Pop, i-Jazz, i-Talk, i-News, i-Oldies, nokuningi. Phequlula i-{link1} noma shintshela kuthebhu yerediyo ngenhla komhlaba.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Okuphakelayo kwekhamera ebukhoma okuvela emadolobheni, izimpawu zendawo, amabhishi, nezindawo zemvelo emhlabeni wonke — mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa. Phequlula i-{link1} noma shintshela kuthebhu yekhamera yewebhu ngenhla komhlaba.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Isiteshi ngasinye sihlelwa futhi ngolimi — 84+ isiyonke — ukuze uthole okuthile ongakubuka ngolimi olukhulumayo, hhayi izwe olipheqululayo kuphela.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Wonke amazwe angu-200+ FreeTV Garden amakhava anekhasi lawo elizinikele leziteshi - khetha elakho ngezansi, noma uphequlule ngezwekazi ohlwini olugcwele.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ayikho ku-Google Play Isitolo noma Isitolo Sohlelo Lokusebenza — ifaka ngokuqondile isuka kusiphequluli sakho esikhundleni salokho, kunoma iyiphi idivayisi, ngokuthepha okumbalwa.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Vula i-Chrome (noma esinye isiphequluli esisekela ukufakwa kwewebhu) bese uya kokuthi freetvgarden.com . Bheka isithonjana sokufaka kubha yekheli, noma vula imenyu yesiphequluli bese ukhetha "Engeza Esikrinini Sasekhaya" / "Faka Uhlelo Lokusebenza." FreeTV Garden izobese ivula isikrini esigcwele esikrinini sakho sasekhaya, njengohlelo lokusebenza lwendabuko, ngaphandle kokulanda okusuka ku-Google Play Isitolo okudingekayo.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Vula i-freetvgarden.com ku-Safari. Thepha isithonjana sokwabelana, bese "Engeza esikrinini sasekhaya." Lokhu kungeza isithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza ku-iPhone yakho noma i-iPad evula isayithi ngesikrini esigcwele - akukho ukufakwa kuhlu kwe-App Store okudingekayo, futhi akukho okumele kugcinwe kubuyekeziwe.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Vula isiphequluli se-TV yakho esakhelwe ngaphakathi bese uzulazulela ku-freetvgarden.com . Uma i-TV yakho ingenaso isiphequluli esisebenzisekayo, sakaza ikhasi kusuka kufoni noma ikhompuyutha ephathekayo usebenzisa i-Chromecast noma i-AirPlay ukuze ubuke esikrinini esikhulu kunalokho.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Vula iSilk Browser (esifakwe ngaphambilini kumadivayisi we-Fire TV, noma mahhala ku-Amazon Appstore) bese uya kokuthi freetvgarden.com . Khetha izwe noma isigaba bese uqala ukubuka — akukho ukubhalisa noma uhlelo lokusebenza olwengeziwe oludingekayo.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Noma yisiphi isiphequluli sedeskithophu yesimanje siyasebenza — vele uvakashele freetvgarden.com . Ku-Chrome noma i-Edge, isithonjana sokufaka siyavela kubha yekheli ukuze uyengeze njengohlelo lokusebenza lwedeskithophu; kungenjalo isebenza kahle njengethebhu yesiphequluli evamile.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Yebo. Akukho ukubhalisa, akukho okubhaliselwe, futhi akukho nkokhelo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi — vele ukhethe izwe noma isiteshi bese uqala ukubuka.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ingabe i-tv.garden iyafana nokuthi FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Cha. Eyokuqala tv.garden yenziwe kabusha yaba yi-Famelack ngo-2026 futhi ayisasebenzisi igama le-TV Garden. I-FreeTV Garden iyindawo ehlukene, esebenza ngokuzimela — ayixhunyaniswa ne-Famelack noma i-tv.garden yoqobo.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ingabe i-FreeTV Garden inezici ezifanayo neze-TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Yebo, nokunye okwengeziwe. I-FreeTV Garden inokuhlangenwe nakho okufanayo kwe-spin-the-globe, ukukhetha izwe, kanye nezihlungi zezilimi ezingu-84+, izigaba zokuqukethwe ezingu-25+, ukudlalwa kwesithombe esisesithombeni, izintandokazi ongazifakela inkanyezi futhi uzivakashele kabusha, inkinobho yesiteshi esingahleliwe, kanye nokuthepha okukodwa kokufaka ngokuqondile kusukela ku-Chrome noma i-Safari — asikho isitolo sohlelo lokusebenza esidingekayo.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Ingabe i-FreeTV Garden nayo inawo umsakazo namakhamera ewebhu?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Yebo. FreeTV Garden futhi inethebhu Yerediyo eneziteshi ezibukhoma kuzo zonke izinhlobo ezifana ne-Pop, Jazz, ne-Talk, kanye nethebhu yekhamera yewebhu enokuphakelwa kwamakhamera abukhoma avela emhlabeni wonke. Shintsha amathebhu ngaphezu komhlaba.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Ingabe i-FreeTV Garden ihluke kanjani ku-radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: I-FreeTV Garden iphrojekthi ehlukene, eqhutshwa ngokuzimela — ayihlangene ne-radio.garden . Inikeza isixhumi esibonakalayo esilula, esinembile esinokuzulazula okulula, futhi idlulela ngale komsakazo one-TV ebukhoma namakhamera ewebhu akhelwe kuthuluzi elifanayo lamahhala, lokuthinta okukodwa.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kwenzekeni ekhasini FreeTool TV Garden elidala ku-Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Iqale kabusha lapha. Ikhasi ebelihlala e-freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden liyiphrojekthi efanayo, manje esebenza ngaphansi kwegama layo nesizinda: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Ayikho i-akhawunti edingekayo. FreeTV Garden ayiceli i-imeyili, iphasiwedi, nanoma imiphi imininingwane yomuntu siqu ukuze ibukwe.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Yebo — FreeTV Garden isebenza kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli seselula sesimanje ku-Android noma i-iPhone, futhi ingangezwa esikrinini sakho sasekhaya ukuze ufinyelele ngokuthepha kanye (bona isigaba sokufaka ngenhla).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Iziteshi ziwukusakazwa bukhoma okuvela ezisakazweni zomphakathi, ngakho ezinye azixhunyiwe ku-inthanethi okwesikhashana ngenxa yezinkinga zeseva yomsakazi. Zama esinye isiteshi, noma ubuye uhlole kamuva — iningi libuya phakathi nemizuzu embalwa ukuya emahoreni.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden ihlanganisa ukusakaza bukhoma okutholakala esidlangalaleni — ngokuyinhloko isuka kunkomba yomphakathi iptv-org — futhi ayibambi noma igcine noma yimaphi amafayela evidiyo ngokwawo. Bona isigaba sezomthetho nokuphepha ngezansi ukuze uthole okwengeziwe.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Eminye imibuzo iphendulwa ngokugcwele {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden ihlanganisa ukusakaza bukhoma okutholakala esidlangalaleni okuvela emithonjeni yamahhala, esesidlangalaleni, okuhlanganisa iptv-org inkomba yomphakathi. Ayisingathi noma igcine noma yimaphi amafayela evidiyo noma alalelwayo, futhi ayidingi i-akhawunti ukuze isetshenziswe.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Imibuzo, impendulo, noma isiteshi esingasiphakamisa? I-imeyili {link1} .
