seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Ukutya kwekhamera ephilayo kwizixeko, iimpawu zomhlaba, iilwandle, kunye neendawo zendalo kwihlabathi jikelele - simahla, akukho kubhaliswa. Bhrawuza i- {link1} okanye utshintshele kwi-Webcam tab ngaphezulu kweglowubhu.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Ijelo ngalinye likwacwangciswa ngolwimi - 84+ lilonke - ukuze ufumane into onokuyibukela ngolwimi oluthethayo, hayi ilizwe okhangela kulo.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Ilizwe ngalinye kumazwe angama-200+ FreeTV Garden amaqweqwe anephepha lawo elizinikeleyo lamatshaneli - khetha elakho ngezantsi, okanye ukhangele ilizwekazi kuluhlu olupheleleyo.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden ayikho kwiPlay Store okanye App Store — ifaka ngqo kwibrawuza yakho endaweni yoko, kuso nasiphi na isixhobo, ngeempompo ezimbalwa.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Vula iChrome (okanye esinye isikhangeli esixhasa uhloliso lwewebhu) kwaye uye ku- freetvgarden.com . Jonga i-icon yokufaka kwibar yedilesi, okanye uvule imenyu yesikhangeli kwaye ukhethe "Yongeza kwiSkrini saseKhaya" / "Faka i-App." FreeTV Garden iya kuthi emva koko ivule isikrini esigcweleyo kwiscreen sakho sasekhaya, njenge-app yemveli, ngaphandle kokukhutshelwa kuDlalo logcino olufunekayo.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Vula freetvgarden.com kwiSafari. Cofa i icon yokwabelana, emva koko "Yongeza kwiSkrini saseKhaya." Oku kongeza i-icon ye-app kwi-iPhone okanye kwi-iPad yakho esungula indawo egcwele isikrini-akukho luhlu lweVenkile ye-App efunekayo, kwaye akukho nto yokugcina ihlaziywa.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Vula i-browser eyakhelwe-ngaphakathi ye-TV yakho kwaye uhambe uye ku- freetvgarden.com . Ukuba iTV yakho ayinaso isikhangeli esisebenzisekayo, phosa iphepha kwifowuni yakho okanye ilaptop usebenzisa iChromecast okanye iAirPlay ukubukela kwiscreen esikhulu endaweni yoko.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Vula isikhangeli seSilk (esifakwe ngaphambili kwizixhobo zeTV zoMlilo, okanye simahla kwiAmazon Appstore) kwaye uye ku freetvgarden.com . Khetha ilizwe okanye udidi kwaye uqalise ukubukela — akukho mrhumo okanye usetyenziso olongezelelweyo olufunekayo.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Nasiphi na isikhangeli sedesktop sangoku siyasebenza — vele undwendwele freetvgarden.com . Kwi-Chrome okanye kwi-Edge, i-icon yokufaka ibonakala kwibar yedilesi ukuyongeza njenge-desktop app; ngenye indlela ihamba kakuhle njengesikhangeli sesithuba esiqhelekileyo.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ewe. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho mrhumo, kwaye akukho ntlawulo nanini na - khetha ilizwe okanye isitishi kwaye uqale ukubukela.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Ngaba tv.garden iyafana ne FreeTV Garden ?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Hayi. Eyoqobo tv.garden yenziwe ngokutsha yaya ku Famelack ngo-2026 kwaye ayisasebenzisi igama leGadi yeTV. FreeTV Garden yindawo eyahlukileyo, eqhutywa ngokuzimeleyo — ayidityaniswanga ne Famelack okanye imvelaphi tv.garden .

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Ngaba i- FreeTV Garden ineempawu ezifanayo neGadi yeTV?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ewe, kunye nokunye. FreeTV Garden inamava afanayo e-spin-the-globe, pick-a-country, kunye nezihluzo zeelwimi ezingama-84+, 25+ iindidi zomxholo, ukudlala komfanekiso osemfanekisweni, intandokazi onokuthi uyihombise kwaye uzindwendwele, iqhosha lesitshaneli esingakhethiyo, kunye nokucofa okukodwa faka ngqo kwiChrome okanye kwiSafari - akukho app store ifunekayo.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Ngaba i- FreeTV Garden inayo nerediyo kunye neewebcams?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ewe. FreeTV Garden ikwaneTabhu yeRadiyo enezitishi eziqhubekayo kuzo zonke iindidi ezifana nePop, iJazz, kunye neNtetho, kunye nethebhu yeWebcam enokutya kwekhamera ngqo kwihlabathi jikelele. Tshintsha iithebhu ngaphezulu kweglowubhu.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Ingaba FreeTV Garden yahluke njani kwi- radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden yiprojekthi ezimeleyo, eqhutywa ngokuzimeleyo — ayinxulumananga radio.garden . Ibonelela nge-interface elula, ecacileyo ngakumbi yokuhambahamba ngokulula, kwaye idlulela ngaphaya kwerediyo ngeTV ephilayo kunye neewebcams ezakhelwe kwisisixhobo esinye sasimahla sokucofa enye.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Kwenzeke ntoni kwiphepha elidala le-FreeTool TV Garden kwi-Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Iphinde yaqala apha. Iphepha elalikade lihlala e- freetool.odoo.com /tv-garden ikwayiprojekthi enye, ngoku iqhutywa phantsi kwegama layo kunye nesizinda: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Akukho akhawunti ifunekayo. FreeTV Garden ayifuni imeyile, igama lokugqitha, okanye naziphi na iinkcukacha zakho zokubukela.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ewe — FreeTV Garden isebenza kuso nasiphi na isikhangeli seselfowuni yala maxesha kwi-Android okanye i-iPhone, kwaye inokongezwa kwiscreen sakho sasekhaya ukuze ufikelele kanye (bona icandelo lokuhlohla ngasentla).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Izitishi zizijelo ezibukhoma ezivela kubasasazo bakawonke-wonke, ngoko ke ezinye ziphuma ngaphandle kweintanethi okwethutyana ngenxa yemicimbi yeseva yomsasazi. Zama elinye ijelo, okanye ujonge kamva — uninzi lubuya phakathi kwemizuzu embalwa ukuya kwiiyure.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden i-aggregates efumaneka kuwonke-wonke ujelo losasazo oluphilayo - ikakhulu ukusuka iptv-org ulawulo lwabahlali - kwaye ayibambe okanye igcine naziphi na iifayile zevidiyo ngokwayo. Bona icandelo lezoMthetho noKhuseleko ngezantsi ngokungakumbi.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Imibuzo engakumbi iphendulwa ngokupheleleyo {link1} .

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden uqikelelo olufumaneka kuwonke wonke ustrimisho olukhoyo olusuka simahla, imithombo yoluntu, kuquka iptv-org ulawulo lwabahlali. Ayibambi okanye igcine nayiphi na ividiyo okanye iifayile zeaudio, kwaye ayifuni akhawunti ukuba isetyenziswe.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Ngaba unemibuzo, impendulo, okanye ijelo elinokucebisa? I-imeyile {link1} .

seo.faqCountFromCountriesA.translated: በአሁኑ ጊዜ ከ{countries} አገሮች ወደ {count} የቀጥታ ቻናሎች።

seo.countryIntroTV.en: This page is part of {siteLink}, our free live TV tool covering 1000+ channels from 200+ countries. Here the tool opens straight to {countryName}, so you can start watching immediately in your browser - no signup, no app, no subscription, and no credit card required.
seo.countryIntroTV.translated: ይህ ገጽ ከ200+ አገሮች የመጡ 1000+ ቻናሎችን የሚሸፍን የ{siteLink} አካል ነው። እዚህ መሣሪያው በቀጥታ ወደ {countryName} ይከፈታል፣ ስለዚህ ወዲያውኑ በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ማየት መጀመር ይችላሉ - ምንም ምዝገባ የለም ፣ ምንም መተግበሪያ የለም ፣ ምንም ምዝገባ እና ምንም ክሬዲት ካርድ አያስፈልግም።

seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.en: {countryName}'s free-to-air TV channels are pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory, covering categories like news, entertainment, sports and music where available, and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphEmpty.translated: የ {countryName} የነፃ የቲቪ ቻናሎች ከህዝብ iptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ ተስበው እንደ ዜና፣ መዝናኛ፣ ስፖርት እና ሙዚቃ ያሉ ምድቦችን ይሸፍናሉ እና ያለ ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላሉ። ልክ እንደ ማንኛውም ከአየር ወደ አየር ማሰባሰብያ፣ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ሊቀየር ይችላል።

seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channel, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphOne.translated: FreeTV Garden በአሁኑ ጊዜ {names}ን ጨምሮ {count} የቀጥታ {countryName} ቻናል ይዘረዝራል — ከሕዝብ iptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ የተወሰደ እና ምንም ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር ሳይኖር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላል። ልክ እንደ ማንኛውም ከአየር ወደ አየር ማሰባሰብያ፣ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ሊቀየር ይችላል።

seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {countryName} channels, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software. As with any free-to-air aggregator, the exact channel list can change day to day as streams go on and offline.
seo.countryChannelsParagraphMany.translated: FreeTV Garden በአሁኑ ጊዜ {names}ን ጨምሮ {count} የቀጥታ {countryName} ቻናሎችን ይዘረዝራል - ከሕዝብ iptv-org ቻናል ማውጫ በቀጥታ የተቀዳ እና ምንም ተጨማሪ ሶፍትዌር ሳይኖር በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ወዲያውኑ መጫወት ይችላል። ልክ እንደ ማንኛውም ከአየር ወደ አየር ማሰባሰብያ፣ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ ሲሄዱ ትክክለኛው የሰርጥ ዝርዝር ከቀን ወደ ቀን ሊቀየር ይችላል።

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: በመሳሪያዎ ላይ {countryName} ቲቪን እንዴት እንደሚመለከቱ

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: {countryName} ቻናሎችን ለመመልከት ምንም መተግበሪያ ወይም መለያ አያስፈልግም። ይህ ገጽ በማንኛውም መሳሪያ ላይ በቀጥታ በአሳሽዎ ውስጥ ይሰራል - ቻናልን መታ ያድርጉ እና ተጫወትን ይጫኑ።

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: ይህንን ገጽ በChrome ውስጥ ይክፈቱ፣ ማየት ለመጀመር {countryName} ቻናል ይንኩ፣ ከዚያ ለበለጠ እይታ የሙሉ ስክሪን አዝራሩን ይጠቀሙ። በሚቀጥለው ጊዜ ለፈጣን መዳረሻ የChrome ምናሌውን መታ ያድርጉ እና መተግበሪያን የሚመስል አዶ ለመፍጠር «ወደ መነሻ ስክሪን አክል»ን ይምረጡ።

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: በቅጽበት መልቀቅ ለመጀመር ይህን ገጽ በSafari ይክፈቱ እና ማንኛውንም {countryName} ቻናል ይንኩ። አፕ ከ አፕ ስቶር ሳያወርዱ አንድ ጊዜ መታ ለማድረግ የማጋራት አዶውን ይንኩ እና "ወደ መነሻ ስክሪን አክል" ን ይምረጡ።

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: ማንኛውም ዘመናዊ አሳሽ ይሰራል - Chrome፣ Safari፣ Firefox ወይም Edge። {countryName} ቻናል ይክፈቱ እና የሙሉ ስክሪን አዶን ከማስተጓጎል ነፃ የሆነ፣ ቲቪ ለሚመስል የእይታ ተሞክሮ በተጫዋቹ ውስጥ ይጠቀሙ።

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: በትልቁ ስክሪን ላይ የ{countryName} ቻናሎችን ለመመልከት ይህን ገጽ በቲቪዎ አብሮ በተሰራው አሳሽ ይክፈቱት ወይም Chromecast ወይም AirPlayን ተጠቅመው ከስልክዎ ወይም ከላፕቶፕዎ ይውሰዱት።

seo.countryAnotherP.en: Head back to the {homeLink} to spin the interactive 3D globe and pick any of the 200+ countries we support, or browse the {countriesLink}.
seo.countryAnotherP.translated: በይነተገናኝ 3D ግሎብ ለማሽከርከር ወደ {homeLink} ይመለሱ እና ከምንደግፋቸው 200+ ሀገራት አንዱን ይምረጡ ወይም {countriesLink}ን ያስሱ።

seo.countryFaqFreeQ.en: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeQ.translated: {countryName} ቲቪን በFreeTV Garden መመልከት ነፃ ነው?

seo.countryFaqFreeA.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqFreeA.translated: አዎ። FreeTV Garden ነፃ-ወደ-አየር (ኤፍቲኤ) በመስመር ላይ በይፋ የሚገኙ ቻናሎችን ያጠቃልላል። ለመመልከት የሚያስፈልገው ምንም የደንበኝነት ምዝገባ፣ መለያ ወይም መተግበሪያ የለም።

seo.countryFaqCountQ.en: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?

seo.countryFaqCountA.en: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountA.translated: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በ{count} የቀጥታ ቻናሎች ዙሪያ፣ እንደ {categories} ያሉ ምድቦችን ያቀፉ።

seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.en: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA.translated: ይፋዊ ዥረቶች ሲቀጥሉ እና ከመስመር ውጭ በሚሄዱበት ጊዜ የሰርጡ ቆጠራ ብዙ ጊዜ ይቀየራል - አሁን በቀጥታ ምን እንዳለ ለማየት ከላይ ያለውን መሳሪያ ይክፈቱ።

seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.en: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates.translated: ይህ ዝርዝር ከህዝብ iptv-org ማውጫ በራስ-ሰር ይዘምናል።

seo.countryFaqBufferQ.en: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferQ.translated: ለምንድነው አንዳንድ {countryName} ቻናሎች የሚቋቋሙት ወይም መጫን ያልቻሉት?

seo.countryFaqBufferA.en: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: እርስዎ በቀጥታ የሚገናኙት ከብሮድካስተር የራሱ አገልጋይ ጋር ነው፣ ስለዚህ ፍጥነት እና አስተማማኝነት በእኛ ሳይሆን በመሠረተ ልማት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። አንዱ ቻናል ካልተጫነ ከዝርዝሩ ውስጥ ሌላውን ይሞክሩ።

seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.en: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ.translated: በስልኬ የ{countryName} የዜና ጣቢያዎችን በቀጥታ ማየት እችላለሁ?

seo.countryFaqPhoneA.en: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqPhoneA.translated: አዎ — ተጫዋቹ ምንም መተግበሪያ ሳይወርድ በማንኛውም የስልክ አሳሽ ላይ ይሰራል። በቀላሉ ይህንን ገጽ ይክፈቱ፣ የዜና ጣቢያን ይንኩ እና ለበለጠ እይታ ሙሉ ስክሪን ይጠቀሙ።

seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.en: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ.translated: ይህ የማንኛውም {countryName} አሰራጭ ኦፊሴላዊ ድር ጣቢያ ነው?

seo.countryFaqOfficialA.en: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
seo.countryFaqOfficialA.translated: ቁጥር FreeTV Garden በይፋ ከሚገኙ ዥረቶች ጋር የሚያገናኝ ገለልተኛ ማውጫ ነው። በዚህ ገፅ ላይ በተዘረዘረው ማንኛውም አሰራጭ ጋር አልተገናኘም፣ አልተደገፈም ወይም አይሰራም።

seo.genreIntroOne.en: FreeTV Garden currently lists {count} live {genreName} channel from around the world, including {names} — pulled live from the public iptv-org channel directory and playable instantly in your browser with no extra software.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: የቀጥታ ካሜራ ምግቦች በዓለም ዙሪያ ከከተሞች፣ ምልክቶች፣ የባህር ዳርቻዎች እና የተፈጥሮ ቦታዎች - ነፃ፣ ምንም ምዝገባ የለም። {link1} ያስሱ ወይም ከዓለም በላይ ወዳለው የድር ካሜራ ትር ይቀይሩ።

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: እያንዳንዱ ቻናል እንዲሁ በቋንቋ ነው የተደራጀው — በአጠቃላይ 84+ — ስለዚህ በምትመለከቱት ሀገር ብቻ ሳይሆን በምትናገሩት ቋንቋ የምትመለከቱትን ነገር እንድታገኝ ነው።

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: ከ200+ አገሮች ውስጥ እያንዳንዱ FreeTV Garden ሽፋን የራሱ የሆነ የሰርጥ ገጽ አለው - የእርስዎን ከታች ይምረጡ ወይም ከሙሉ ዝርዝር ውስጥ በአህጉር ያስሱ።

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden በፕሌይ ስቶር ወይም አፕ ስቶር ላይ የለም - በቀጥታ ከአሳሽዎ ይጫናል በማንኛውም መሳሪያ ላይ በጥቂት መታ ማድረግ።

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Chromeን ይክፈቱ (ወይም ሌላ የድር ጭነቶችን የሚደግፍ አሳሽ) እና ወደ freetvgarden.com ይሂዱ። በአድራሻ አሞሌው ውስጥ የመጫኛ አዶውን ይፈልጉ ወይም የአሳሹን ሜኑ ይክፈቱ እና "ወደ መነሻ ማያ ገጽ አክል" / "መተግበሪያን ጫን" ን ይምረጡ። FreeTV Gardenከመነሻ ስክሪን ላይ ልክ እንደ ቤተኛ መተግበሪያ ከፕሌይ ስቶር ማውረድ አያስፈልግም።

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: በSafari ውስጥ freetvgarden.com ይክፈቱ። የማጋራት አዶውን ከዚያም "ወደ መነሻ ስክሪን አክል" ን ይንኩ። ይሄ የመተግበሪያ አዶን ወደ የእርስዎ አይፎን ወይም አይፓድ ያክላል፣ ጣቢያው ሙሉ ስክሪን የሚያስከፍት - ምንም የመተግበሪያ መደብር ዝርዝር አያስፈልግም፣ እና ምንም የሚዘመን የለም።

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: አብሮ የተሰራውን የቲቪ ማሰሻዎን ይክፈቱ እና ወደ freetvgarden.com ይሂዱ። የእርስዎ ቲቪ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል አሳሽ ከሌለው በምትኩ በትልቁ ስክሪን ለማየት Chromecastን ወይም AirPlayን በመጠቀም ገጹን ከስልክዎ ወይም ከላፕቶፕዎ ይውሰዱት።

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: የሐር ማሰሻውን ይክፈቱ (በፋየር ቲቪ መሣሪያዎች ላይ አስቀድሞ የተጫነ ወይም ከአማዞን መተግበሪያ መደብር ነፃ) እና ወደ freetvgarden.com ይሂዱ። አገር ወይም ምድብ ይምረጡ እና መመልከት ይጀምሩ - ምንም የደንበኝነት ምዝገባ ወይም ተጨማሪ መተግበሪያ አያስፈልግም.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: ማንኛውም ዘመናዊ የዴስክቶፕ አሳሽ ይሰራል - freetvgarden.comን ይጎብኙ። በ Chrome ወይም Edge ውስጥ እንደ ዴስክቶፕ መተግበሪያ ለመጨመር የመጫኛ አዶ በአድራሻ አሞሌው ላይ ይታያል; አለበለዚያ እንደ መደበኛ አሳሽ ትር በጥሩ ሁኔታ ይሰራል.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: አዎ። ምንም ምዝገባ፣ ምዝገባ እና ክፍያ በማንኛውም ጊዜ የለም - አገር ወይም ቻናል ይምረጡ እና ማየት ይጀምሩ።

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden ከFreeTV Garden ጋር አንድ ነው?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: አይደለም ዋናው tv.garden በ2026 ወደ Famelack ተቀይሯል እና የቲቪ አትክልት ስም አይጠቀምም። FreeTV Garden የተለየ፣ በራሱ የሚሰራ ጣቢያ ነው - ከFamelack ወይም ከዋናው tv.garden ጋር ግንኙነት የለውም።

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ከቲቪ የአትክልት ስፍራ ጋር አንድ አይነት ባህሪ አለው?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: አዎ፣ እንዲሁም ተጨማሪ። FreeTV Garden ተመሳሳዩ ስፒን-ዘ-ግሎብ፣ አገር መምረጥ ልምድ፣ ከ84+ የቋንቋ ማጣሪያዎች፣ 25+ የይዘት ምድቦች፣ በሥዕል-በ-ሥዕል መልሶ ማጫወት፣ ኮከብ ማድረግ እና እንደገና ማየት የምትችላቸው ተወዳጆች፣ የዘፈቀደ ቻናል አዝራር እና አንድ ጊዜ መታ ጫን በቀጥታ ከ Chrome ወይም Safari - ምንም መተግበሪያ መደብር አያስፈልግም።

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: እንዲሁም FreeTV Garden ሬዲዮ እና ዌብካም አለው?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: አዎ። FreeTV Gardenእንዲሁም እንደ ፖፕ፣ ጃዝ እና ቶክ ባሉ ዘውጎች ላይ የቀጥታ ጣቢያዎች ያሉት የሬዲዮ ትር እና የዌብካም ትር ከዓለም ዙሪያ የቀጥታ የካሜራ ምግቦች አሉት። ከዓለም በላይ ትሮችን ይቀይሩ።

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ከradio.garden የሚለየው እንዴት ነው?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden የተለየ፣ ራሱን የቻለ ፕሮጀክት ነው - ከradio.garden ጋር ግንኙነት የለውም። በቀላል አሰሳ ቀለል ያለ፣ የበለጠ ሊታወቅ የሚችል በይነገጽ ያቀርባል፣ እና ከሬዲዮ በዘለለ የቀጥታ ቲቪ እና ዌብ ካሜራዎች በተመሳሳዩ ነጻ፣ አንድ-መታ መሳሪያ ውስጥ የተገነቡ ናቸው።

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: በኦዱ ላይ የድሮው FreeTool TV Garden ገጽ ምን ሆነ?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: እዚህ እንደገና ተጀምሯል። በfreetool.odoo.com/ቲቪ-ጋርደን ይኖር የነበረው ገፅ አንድ አይነት ፕሮጀክት ነው፣አሁን በራሱ ስም እና ጎራ እየሄደ ነው፡FreeTV Garden።

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: መለያ አያስፈልግም። FreeTV Garden ለማየት ኢሜይል፣ የይለፍ ቃል ወይም ማንኛውንም የግል ዝርዝሮች አይጠይቅም።

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: አዎ — FreeTV Garden በአንድሮይድ ወይም አይፎን ላይ በማንኛውም ዘመናዊ የሞባይል አሳሽ ይሰራል እና ለአንድ ጊዜ መታ በማድረግ ወደ መነሻ ስክሪንዎ መጨመር ይቻላል (ከላይ ያለውን የመጫኛ ክፍል ይመልከቱ)።

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: ቻናሎች ከህዝባዊ ብሮድካስተሮች የሚመነጩ የቀጥታ ስርጭቶች ናቸው፣ስለዚህ አንዳንዶች በስርጭቱ በራሱ የአገልጋይ ችግር ምክንያት ለጊዜው ከመስመር ውጭ ይሄዳሉ። ሌላ ሰርጥ ይሞክሩ፣ ወይም ቆይተው ተመልሰው ይመልከቱ - ብዙዎቹ ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች እስከ ሰዓታት ውስጥ ይመለሳሉ።

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden በአደባባይ የሚገኙ የቀጥታ ዥረቶችን ያጠቃልላል - በዋናነት ከiptv-org የማህበረሰብ ማውጫ - እና ምንም አይነት የቪዲዮ ፋይሎችን አያስተናግድም ወይም አያከማችም። ለተጨማሪ ከዚህ በታች ያለውን የህግ እና ደህንነት ክፍል ይመልከቱ።

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: ተጨማሪ ጥያቄዎች በሙሉ {link1} ላይ ተመልሰዋል።

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Ka baadh Raadiyaha Tooska ah ee Satellite Globe ee Is-dhexgalka

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Iskudubbarid muuqaal sawir leh oo 3D satellite globe oo soo hel kumanaan idaacadaha tooska ah ee adduunka oo dhan, oo lagu tashaday goobtooda baahinta dhabta ah - bilaash, looma baahna saxiix.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Kanaalada tooska ah ee TV-ga waxaa loo habeeyay in ka badan 25+ qaybood - Wararka, Ciyaaraha, Filimada, Muusikada, Caruurta, Documentary, iyo in ka badan - si aad uga dhex baadho waxaad rabto inaad daawato intii aad wax walba dhex mari lahayd.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Kumanaan idaacado toos ah oo bilaash ah, oo loo habeeyey nooca — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, iyo in ka badan. Baadh {link1} ama u beddel raadiyaha tab ee ka sarreeya adduunka.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Kaamirada tooska ah waxay ka quudisaa magaalooyinka, calaamadaha taariikhiga ah, xeebaha, iyo meelaha dabiiciga ah ee adduunka oo dhan - bilaash, ma jiro saxiix. Baadh {link1} ama u beddel shabka kamaradaha ee ka sarreeya adduunka.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Kanaal kasta sidoo kale waxaa loo habeeyey luqad — 84+ guud ahaan — si aad u hesho wax aad ku daawato luqadda aad run ahaantii ku hadasho, ma aha oo kaliya dalka aad baadhayso.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Mid kasta oo ka mid ah 200+ dal ee FreeTV Garden wuxuu leeyahay bogag gaar ah oo kanaalo ah - ka soo qaado hoosta, ama ka baadho qaarad liiska oo dhan.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden kuma jiro Play Store ama App Store - waxay toos uga soo rabtaa biraawsarkaaga beddelkeeda, qalab kasta, dhawr tuubbo.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Fur Chrome (ama barowsar kale oo taageera rakibaadda shabakadda) oo tag freetvgarden.com . Ka raadi summada rakibidda ee ciwaanka, ama fur menu-ka browserka oo dooro "Kudar Shaashada Guriga" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden ayaa markaa shaashada buuxda ka furi doona shaashadda gurigaaga, si la mid ah abka wadaniga ah, iyada oo aan Play Store-ka laga soo dejin doonin.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Ka fur freetvgarden.com gudaha Safari. Taabo astaanta Share, ka dibna "Kudar Shaashada Guriga." Tani waxay ku darsataa summada app iPhone-kaaga ama iPad-kaaga kaas oo soo saara goobta shaashad buuxda - looma baahna liiska Dukaanka App-ka, iyo wax la cusbooneysiinayo.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Fur biraawsarkaaga TV-ga ku dhex jira oo u gudub freetvgarden.com . Haddii TV-gaagu aanu lahayn browser-ka la isticmaali karo, ka tuur bogga taleefankaaga ama laptop-kaaga adoo isticmaalaya Chromecast ama AirPlay si aad u daawato shaashadda weyn.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Fur Browser-ka xariirta (horey loogu rakibay qalabka TV-ga Dab-damiska, ama ka xor ah Amazon Appstore) oo tag freetvgarden.com . Dooro waddan ama qayb oo bilow daawashada - ma jiro rukunid ama app dheeraad ah oo loo baahan yahay.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Barowsar kasta oo casriga ah ayaa shaqeeya - kaliya booqo freetvgarden.com . Gudaha Chrome ama Edge, summada rakibaadda ayaa ka muuqata barta ciwaanka si loogu daro abka desktop-ka; Haddii kale waxay si fiican u socotaa sida tab browser joogto ah.

seo.homeFaq1Q.translated: Runtii FreeTV Garden xor ma yahay?

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Haa Ma jiro wax saxiix ah, ma jiro wax lacag ah, iyo lacag la'aan waqti kasta - kaliya dooro waddan ama kanaal oo bilow daawashada.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: tv.garden la mid ma yahay FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Maya. Asalka tv.garden ayaa dib loo summeeyay Famelack sanadka 2026 oo aan hadda isticmaalin magaca beerta TV-ga. FreeTV Garden waa goob gooni ah, si madaxbanaan loo maamulo - kuma xirna Famelack ama tv.garden asalka ah.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: FreeTV Garden ma leeyahay astaamo la mid ah kan Beerta TV-ga?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Haa, iyo wax ka badan. FreeTV Garden waxa uu leeyahay isla spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, oo ay la socoto 84+ shaandhada luqadaha, 25+ qaybood oo ka kooban, sawir-ku-ciyaarid, kuwa ugu cadcad ee aad xiddigi karto oo aad dib u booqato, badhanka-channel-ka, iyo hal taabo si toos ah uga rakib Chrome ama Safari - looma baahna dukaan app ah.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Sidoo kale FreeTV Garden ma leeyahay raadiyaha iyo kamaradaha webka?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Haa FreeTV Garden waxa kale oo uu leeyahay tabka raadiyaha oo leh xarumo toos ah oo kala duwan sida Pop, Jazz, iyo Talk, iyo tabka kamarada webka oo leh kamarad toos ah oo aduunka oo dhan laga keeno. U beddel tabaha ka sarreeya adduunka.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Sidee FreeTV Garden uga duwan yahay radio.garden ?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden waa mashruuc gooni ah, si madax banaan loo maamulo - oo aan xiriir la lahayn radio.garden . Waxay bixisaa interface ka fudud, dareen badan leh oo leh hagitaan sahlan, waxayna dhaaftaa raadiyaha oo leh TV-ga tooska ah iyo kamaradaha webka ee loo dhisay isla bilaashka ah, qalab hal tabo ah.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Maxaa ku dhacay boggii hore ee FreeTool TV Garden ee Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Halkan ayay dib uga bilaabatay. Bogga ku noolaan jiray freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden waa isku mashruuc, oo hadda ku socda magaciisa iyo domainkiisa: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?
seo.homeFaq7Q.translated: Ma u baahanahay in aan sameeyo xisaab?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Xisaab looma baahna FreeTV Garden ma weyddiisto iimayl, erayga sirta ah, ama wixii tafaasiil shakhsi ah oo la daawado.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Haa — FreeTV Garden waxa uu ku shaqeeyaa browserka mobilada ee casriga ah ee Android ama iPhone, waxaana lagu dari karaa shaashadda gurigaaga si aad hal taabo u gasho (eeg qaybta Rakibaadda ee sare).

seo.homeFaq9Q.translated: Waa maxay sababta kanaalka muujinaya "Lama heli karo"?

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanaalka waa duruus toos ah oo laga keenay warfidiyeenada dadweynaha, sidaas darteed qaar ayaa si ku meel gaar ah khadka uga baxa sababo la xiriira server-ka baahinta. Isku day kanaal kale, ama dib u eeg hadhow - badankoodu waxay ku soo noqdaan dhowr daqiiqo ilaa saacado gudahood.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: durdurrada ma sharci baa in la daawado?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden waxay isu keentaa durdurrada tooska ah ee si guud loo heli karo - ugu horrayn laga soo bilaabo iptv-org tusaha bulshada - oo ma martigeliyo ama ma kaydiyo wax faylal muuqaal ah laftiisa. Hoos ka eeg qaybta sharciga iyo badbaadada wixii dheeraad ah

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Su'aalo dheeraad ah ayaa lagaga jawaabay {link1} oo buuxa.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden wuxuu isu geeyaa si guud oo toos ah oo laga heli karo ilo toos ah oo bilaash ah, ilo dadweyne, oo ay ku jiraan iptv-org hagaha bulshada. Ma kaydiso ama kaydiso wax faylal ama muuqaal ah, umana baahna akoon si loo isticmaalo.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Su'aalo, jawaab celin, ama kanaal la soo jeediyo? Iimayl {link1}

seo.countryHowToH2.en: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToH2.translated: Hoe om {countryName} TV op jou toestel te kyk

seo.countryHowToIntro.en: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToIntro.translated: Geen toepassing of rekening word benodig om {countryName}-kanale te kyk nie. Hierdie bladsy werk direk in jou blaaier op enige toestel - tik net 'n kanaal en druk speel.

seo.countryHowToAndroid.en: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToAndroid.translated: Maak hierdie bladsy in Chrome oop, tik 'n {countryName}-kanaal om te begin kyk, en gebruik dan die volskermknoppie vir die beste uitsig. Vir vinnige toegang volgende keer, tik die Chrome-kieslys en kies "Voeg by tuisskerm" om 'n app-agtige ikoon te skep.

seo.countryHowToIOS.en: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToIOS.translated: Maak hierdie bladsy in Safari oop en tik op enige {countryName}-kanaal om onmiddellik te begin stroom. Tik die Deel-ikoon en kies "Voeg by tuisskerm" vir toegang met een tik sonder om 'n toepassing van die App Store af te laai.

seo.countryHowToDesktop.en: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToDesktop.translated: Enige moderne blaaier werk - Chrome, Safari, Firefox of Edge. Maak 'n {countryName}-kanaal oop en gebruik die volskerm-ikoon in die speler vir 'n afleidingsvrye, TV-agtige kykervaring.

seo.countryHowToSmartTV.en: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV.translated: Maak hierdie bladsy in jou TV se ingeboude blaaier oop, of saai dit van jou foon of skootrekenaar af met Chromecast of AirPlay om {countryName}-kanale op die groot skerm te kyk.

seo.countryFaqBufferA.translated: Jy koppel direk aan die uitsaaier se eie bediener, so spoed en betroubaarheid hang af van hul infrastruktuur, nie ons s'n nie. As een kanaal nie laai nie, probeer 'n ander uit die lys.

seo.satHubH1.en: Explore Live Radio on an Interactive Satellite Globe
seo.satHubH1.translated: Verken regstreekse radio op 'n interaktiewe satelliet-aardbol

seo.satHubIntro.en: Spin a photorealistic 3D satellite globe and discover thousands of live radio stations from around the world, plotted by their real broadcast location — free, no signup required.
seo.satHubIntro.translated: Draai 'n fotorealistiese 3D-satelliet-aardbol en ontdek duisende regstreekse radiostasies van regoor die wêreld, geplot volgens hul regte uitsaailigging - gratis, geen aanmelding nodig nie.

seo.homeCategoriesIntro.en: Live TV channels are organized into 25+ categories — News, Sports, Movies, Music, Kids, Documentary, and more — so you can browse by what you want to watch instead of scrolling through everything.
seo.homeCategoriesIntro.translated: Regstreekse TV-kanale is in 25+ kategorieë georganiseer – Nuus, Sport, Flieks, Musiek, Kinders, Dokumentêr, en meer – sodat jy kan blaai volgens wat jy wil kyk in plaas daarvan om deur alles te blaai.

seo.homeRadioIntro.en: Thousands of free live radio stations, organized by genre — Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, and more. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Radio tab above the globe.
seo.homeRadioIntro.translated: Duisende gratis regstreekse radiostasies, georganiseer volgens genre - Pop, Jazz, Talk, News, Oldies, en meer. Blaai deur die {link1} of skakel oor na die Radio-oortjie bo die aardbol.

seo.homeWebcamsIntro.en: Live camera feeds from cities, landmarks, beaches, and nature spots worldwide — free, no signup. Browse the {link1} or switch to the Webcam tab above the globe.
seo.homeWebcamsIntro.translated: Regstreekse kamerafeeds vanaf stede, landmerke, strande en natuurplekke wêreldwyd – gratis, geen aanmelding nie. Blaai deur die {link1} of skakel oor na die Webkamera-oortjie bo die aardbol.

seo.homeLanguagesIntro.en: Every channel is also organized by language — 84+ in total — so you can find something to watch in the language you actually speak, not just the country you're browsing.
seo.homeLanguagesIntro.translated: Elke kanaal is ook volgens taal georganiseer - 84+ in totaal - sodat jy iets kan vind om te kyk in die taal wat jy eintlik praat, nie net die land wat jy blaai nie.

seo.homeCountriesIntro.en: Every one of the 200+ countries FreeTV Garden covers has its own dedicated page of channels — pick yours below, or browse by continent from the full list.
seo.homeCountriesIntro.translated: Elkeen van die 200+ lande wat FreeTV Garden dek, het sy eie toegewyde bladsy van kanale - kies joune hieronder, of blaai volgens kontinent uit die volledige lys.

seo.homeInstallIntro.en: FreeTV Garden isn't on the Play Store or App Store — it installs straight from your browser instead, on any device, in a few taps.
seo.homeInstallIntro.translated: FreeTV Garden is nie in die Play Winkel of App Store nie - dit installeer direk vanaf jou blaaier eerder, op enige toestel, met 'n paar tik.

seo.homeInstallAndroid.en: Open Chrome (or another browser that supports web installs) and go to freetvgarden.com. Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App." FreeTV Garden will then open full-screen from your home screen, just like a native app, with no download from the Play Store required.
seo.homeInstallAndroid.translated: Maak Chrome oop (of 'n ander blaaier wat webinstallasies ondersteun) en gaan na freetvgarden.com . Soek die installasie-ikoon in die adresbalk, of maak die blaaierkieslys oop en kies "Voeg by tuisskerm" / "Installeer toepassing." FreeTV Garden sal dan volskerm vanaf jou tuisskerm oopmaak, net soos 'n inheemse toepassing, met geen aflaai vanaf die Play Winkel nodig nie.

seo.homeInstallIOS.en: Open freetvgarden.com in Safari. Tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This adds an app icon to your iPhone or iPad that launches the site full-screen — no App Store listing needed, and nothing to keep updated.
seo.homeInstallIOS.translated: Maak freetvgarden.com oop in Safari. Tik die Deel-ikoon en dan "Voeg by tuisskerm." Dit voeg 'n toepassingsikoon by jou iPhone of iPad wat die werf volskerm begin - geen App Store-lys nodig nie, en niks om op datum te hou nie.

seo.homeInstallSmartTV.en: Open your TV's built-in browser and navigate to freetvgarden.com. If your TV doesn't have a usable browser, cast the page from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch on the big screen instead.
seo.homeInstallSmartTV.translated: Maak jou TV se ingeboude blaaier oop en navigeer na freetvgarden.com . As jou TV nie 'n bruikbare blaaier het nie, saai die bladsy van jou foon of skootrekenaar af met Chromecast of AirPlay om eerder op die groot skerm te kyk.

seo.homeInstallFire.en: Open the Silk Browser (pre-installed on Fire TV devices, or free from the Amazon Appstore) and go to freetvgarden.com. Select a country or category and start watching — no subscription or additional app required.
seo.homeInstallFire.translated: Maak die Silk Browser oop (vooraf geïnstalleer op Fire TV-toestelle, of gratis vanaf die Amazon Appstore) en gaan na freetvgarden.com . Kies 'n land of kategorie en begin kyk - geen intekening of bykomende toepassing word vereis nie.

seo.homeInstallDesktop.en: Any modern desktop browser works — just visit freetvgarden.com. In Chrome or Edge, an install icon appears in the address bar to add it as a desktop app; otherwise it runs fine as a regular browser tab.
seo.homeInstallDesktop.translated: Enige moderne rekenaarblaaier werk — besoek net freetvgarden.com . In Chrome of Edge verskyn 'n installasie-ikoon in die adresbalk om dit as 'n rekenaartoepassing by te voeg; anders werk dit goed as 'n gewone blaaieroortjie.

seo.homeFaq1A.en: Yes. There's no signup, no subscription, and no payment at any point — just pick a country or channel and start watching.
seo.homeFaq1A.translated: Ja. Daar is geen aansluiting, geen intekening en geen betaling op enige stadium nie - kies net 'n land of kanaal en begin kyk.

seo.homeFaq2Q.en: Is tv.garden the same as FreeTV Garden?
seo.homeFaq2Q.translated: Is tv.garden dieselfde as FreeTV Garden?

seo.homeFaq2A.en: No. The original tv.garden rebranded to Famelack in 2026 and no longer uses the TV Garden name. FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run site — not affiliated with Famelack or the original tv.garden.
seo.homeFaq2A.translated: Nee. Die oorspronklike tv.garden is in 2026 herhandel na Famelack en gebruik nie meer die TV-tuinnaam nie. FreeTV Garden is 'n aparte, onafhanklik bestuurde webwerf - nie geaffilieer met Famelack of die oorspronklike tv.garden nie.

seo.homeFaq3Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden have the same features as TV Garden?
seo.homeFaq3Q.translated: Het FreeTV Garden dieselfde kenmerke as TV Garden?

seo.homeFaq3A.en: Yes, plus more. FreeTV Garden has the same spin-the-globe, pick-a-country experience, along with 84+ language filters, 25+ content categories, picture-in-picture playback, favorites you can star and revisit, a random-channel button, and one-tap install straight from Chrome or Safari — no app store needed.
seo.homeFaq3A.translated: Ja, plus meer. FreeTV Garden het dieselfde draai-die-wêreld, kies-'n-land-ervaring, saam met 84+ taalfilters, 25+ inhoudkategorieë, prent-in-prent-terugspeel, gunstelinge wat jy kan ster en herbesoek, 'n ewekansige kanaalknoppie en een-tik-installasie direk vanaf Chrome of Safari - geen toepassingwinkel nodig nie.

seo.homeFaq4Q.en: Does FreeTV Garden also have radio and webcams?
seo.homeFaq4Q.translated: Het FreeTV Garden ook radio en webkameras?

seo.homeFaq4A.en: Yes. FreeTV Garden also has a Radio tab with live stations across genres like Pop, Jazz, and Talk, and a Webcam tab with live camera feeds from around the world. Switch tabs above the globe.
seo.homeFaq4A.translated: Ja. FreeTV Garden het ook 'n Radio-oortjie met regstreekse stasies oor genres soos Pop, Jazz en Talk, en 'n Webkamera-oortjie met regstreekse kamerastrome van regoor die wêreld. Wissel oortjies bokant die aardbol.

seo.homeFaq5Q.en: How is FreeTV Garden different from radio.garden?
seo.homeFaq5Q.translated: Hoe verskil FreeTV Garden van radio.garden?

seo.homeFaq5A.en: FreeTV Garden is a separate, independently run project — not affiliated with radio.garden. It offers a simpler, more intuitive interface with easier navigation, and goes beyond radio with live TV and webcams built into the same free, one-tap tool.
seo.homeFaq5A.translated: FreeTV Garden is 'n aparte, onafhanklik bestuurde projek - nie geaffilieer met radio.garden nie. Dit bied 'n eenvoudiger, meer intuïtiewe koppelvlak met makliker navigasie, en gaan verder as radio met regstreekse TV en webkameras wat in dieselfde gratis een-tik-instrument ingebou is.

seo.homeFaq6Q.en: What happened to the old FreeTool TV Garden page on Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6Q.translated: Wat het geword van die ou FreeTool TV Garden-bladsy op Odoo?

seo.homeFaq6A.en: It relaunched here. The page that used to live at freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden is the same project, now running under its own name and domain: FreeTV Garden.
seo.homeFaq6A.translated: Dit het weer hier begin. Die bladsy wat vroeër by freetool.odoo.com /tv-tuin gewoon het, is dieselfde projek, wat nou onder sy eie naam en domein loop: FreeTV Garden .

seo.homeFaq7Q.en: Do I need to create an account?

seo.homeFaq7A.en: No account is needed. FreeTV Garden doesn't ask for an email, password, or any personal details to watch.
seo.homeFaq7A.translated: Geen rekening is nodig nie. FreeTV Garden vra nie vir 'n e-pos, wagwoord of enige persoonlike besonderhede om na te kyk nie.

seo.homeFaq8A.en: Yes — FreeTV Garden runs in any modern mobile browser on Android or iPhone, and can be added to your home screen for one-tap access (see the Install section above).
seo.homeFaq8A.translated: Ja — FreeTV Garden loop in enige moderne mobiele blaaier op Android of iPhone, en kan by jou tuisskerm gevoeg word vir toegang met een tik (sien die Installasie-afdeling hierbo).

seo.homeFaq9A.en: Channels are live streams sourced from public broadcasters, so some go offline temporarily due to the broadcaster's own server issues. Try another channel, or check back later — most come back within a few minutes to hours.
seo.homeFaq9A.translated: Kanale is regstreekse strome wat van openbare uitsaaiers verkry word, so sommige gaan tydelik vanlyn af weens die uitsaaier se eie bedienerkwessies. Probeer 'n ander kanaal, of kom kyk later weer - die meeste kom binne 'n paar minute tot ure terug.

seo.homeFaq10Q.en: Are the streams legal to watch?
seo.homeFaq10Q.translated: Is die strome wettig om te kyk?

seo.homeFaq10A.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams — primarily from the iptv-org community directory — and doesn't host or store any video files itself. See the Legal & Safety section below for more.
seo.homeFaq10A.translated: FreeTV Garden versamel publieke beskikbare regstreekse strome - hoofsaaklik vanaf die iptv-org gemeenskapsgids - en huisves of stoor self geen videolêers nie. Sien die Regs- en Veiligheidsafdeling hieronder vir meer.

seo.homeFaqMore.en: More questions are answered on the full {link1}.
seo.homeFaqMore.translated: Meer vrae word op die volledige {link1} beantwoord.

seo.homeLegal.en: FreeTV Garden aggregates publicly available live streams from free, public sources, including the iptv-org community directory. It doesn't host or store any video or audio files, and doesn't require an account to use.
seo.homeLegal.translated: FreeTV Garden versamel publiek beskikbare regstreekse strome vanaf gratis, publieke bronne, insluitend die iptv-org gemeenskapsgids. Dit huisves of stoor geen video- of oudiolêers nie, en vereis nie 'n rekening om te gebruik nie.

seo.homeContactP.en: Questions, feedback, or a channel to suggest? Email {link1}.
seo.homeContactP.translated: Vrae, terugvoer of 'n kanaal om voor te stel? E-pos {link1} .

seo.hubHowToHeadingWebcam.translated: Hoe om op jou toestel te kyk

seo.hubHowToBody.en: No app or account is needed. This page works directly in your browser on any device — just tap a {nounSingular} and press play. seo.hubHowToBody.translated: Geen toepassing of rekening word benodig nie. Hierdie bladsy werk direk in jou blaaier op enige toestel - tik net 'n {nounSingular} en druk speel. Op Android of iPhone, maak hierdie bladsy in Chrome of Safari oop en gebruik "Voeg by tuisskerm" vir een-tik-toegang volgende keer. Op 'n rekenaar werk enige moderne blaaier.
